articles.title: On the Diffusibility of High-Dimensional Latents
articles.content: Representation Autoencoders (RAEs) enable diffusion models to operate in the feature spaces of pretrained visual encoders. However, many off-the-shelf encoders are not optimized for faithful reconstruction, discarding fine-grained visual details. As expected, finetuning these encoders for image reconstruction recovers such details. However, perhaps counterintuitively, this procedure reduces the effective dimensionality of the resulting representation, and the altered geometry has downstream effects on generation. Specifically, we show that using the standard velocity prediction in flow matching in this high-dimensional space requires the model to fit orthogonal noise directions outside the low-dimensional signal manifold, making optimization inefficient. This motivates using the clean data parameterization ($\boldsymbol{x}_{0}$-prediction) instead, which focuses learning on the underlying signal manifold. Across experiments with multiple strong-reconstruction encoders, we show that $\boldsymbol{x}_{0}$-prediction consistently improves text-to-image generation performance.

articles.title_zh: 高显赫的后卫们
articles.content_zh: 代表自动编码器(RAEs)可以使扩散模型在预先训练的视觉编码器的特性空间中运行. 然而,许多现成的编码器并没有为忠实重建进行优化,丢弃了精细的视觉细节. 如预期,对这些编码器进行微调,以进行图像重建,可以恢复这些细节。 然而,也许相反的是,这一程序会减少由此而来的代表性的有效维度,而改变后的几何学对生成产生下游影响. 具体地说,我们显示,在这个高维空间的流量匹配中,使用标准速度预测需要模型在低维信号多维外配合正交噪声方向,使得优化效率低下. 这激励人们使用干净的数据参数化(\boldsymbol{x}_{0}$-project)代替,它侧重于学习基本的信号多元性。 通过多个强重重建编码器的实验,我们显示$\boldsymbol{x×××××××}$的预测持续改善文本到图像生成性能.

articles.title: The Past Frames the Future: Memory for Autoregressive Video Generation
articles.content: Advances in generative models have improved video fidelity, enabling long-horizon generation, interactive world modeling, and evolving visual environments. Autoregressive (AR) video generation extends visual sequences through causal rollouts. However, a fundamental bottleneck emerges: as the generated sequence expands, practical models must operate under strictly bounded context windows, storage, and computational limits. Consequently, critical historical information, e.g., entity identities, dynamic states, and intervention-induced causal changes, often leaves the active context long before its relevance diminishes. Overcoming this limitation and maintaining temporal persistence constitutes a fundamental memory problem. We present a systematic and comprehensive review of memory mechanisms in AR video generation. We formulate memory operationally as persistent historical information maintained across outer AR steps, capable of influencing future generation even after the originating evidence is no longer locally accessible. Building upon this unified framework, we organize the literature through five complementary perspectives: (I) Forms, the representational carriers of history; (II) Functions, the specific semantic and physical information requiring preservation; (III) Operations, the lifecycle of writing, reading, updating, managing, and integrating memory; (IV) Learning, the optimization of memory behaviors under closed-loop rollouts; and (V) Evaluation, the paradigms for diagnosing genuine memory capabilities. We conclude by synthesizing open challenges, including composable and resource-aware memory architectures, trustworthy state updating, self-rollout learning, and standardized evaluation. By bridging representations, mechanisms, and learning paradigms, this paper establishes a structured foundation for developing reliable, memory-conditioned video generation systems.

articles.title_zh: 过去框架的未来:自动回归视频生成的内存
articles.content_zh: 基因模型的进步改善了视频的忠诚度,使长视距生成、互动世界建模和不断发展的视觉环境成为可能。 自动递归(AR)视频生成通过因果推展扩展视觉序列. 然而,一个根本的瓶颈出现:随着生成的序列的扩展,实用模型必须在严格限定的上下文窗口,存储,和计算限制下运行. 因此,关键的历史信息,如实体身份、动态状态和干预引起的因果变化,往往在相关性减弱之前就离开了积极背景。 克服这一限制并保持时间持久性是一个根本的记忆问题。 我们对AR视频生成中的记忆机制进行了系统和全面的审查。 我们在操作上将记忆发展为持续的历史信息,保存在AR以外的步骤上,即使在原始证据不再能够在当地获取之后,仍能够影响后代。 在这个统一框架的基础上,我们通过五个互补的视角来组织文献:(一)形式,历史的代表载体;(二)功能,需要保存的具体语义和物理信息;(三)操作,写作,阅读,更新,管理和融合记忆的生命周期;(四)学习,在闭锁-滚动下优化记忆行为;(五)评价,诊断真实记忆能力的范式. 最后,我们综合了开放的挑战,包括可调和和资源感知的记忆架构、可信赖的状态更新、自我推广学习和标准化评价。 本文通过连接表述,机制和学习范式,为开发可靠,内存条件的视频生成系统奠定了结构化的基础.

articles.title: HaRP: High Dynamic Range Photosequencing through Dual Reversed Shutter Scanning
articles.content: The adoption of CMOS sensors in mobile photography is frequently compromised by the rolling shutter (RS) effect, which introduces geometric distortions and motion artifacts. Particularly, recent rolling shutter with global reset (RSGR) mode, while mitigating some RS issues, also incurs major limitations, including reduced capture speed and compressed dynamic range. To address these problems, we propose a novel dual reversed scanning setup utilizing both RSGR and inverted RSGR views. This solution not only handles the inherent flaws of RSGR by synchronizing complementary exposures to balance the dynamic range across the frames but also introduces an effective method for HDR photosequencing under highly dynamic scenes. Our proposed network first accommodates row-wise complementarity and manages visual shifts by row-adaptive feature alignment. Subsequently, the hallucination module, built upon a correlation-guided mixattention block, integrates the mutually reinforced features to recover missing details. In addition, we construct a coaxial imaging system to collect a real-world dataset, enabling robust training and evaluation beyond numerical simulation. Experimental results demonstrate the twofold benefits of our solution in mitigating RSGR limitations and advancing HDR reconstruction techniques.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: HARP: 高动态 通过双反向闭路电视扫描进行光序
articles.content_zh: 在移动摄影中采用CMOS传感器经常受到滚动百叶窗(RS)效应的影响,该效应引入几何扭曲和运动文物. 特别是最近采用全球重置模式的滚动百叶窗,虽然减轻了某些RS问题,但也产生了重大限制,包括捕获速度下降和动态范围压缩。 为了解决这些问题,我们提议采用新的双重反向扫描装置,同时使用RSGR和反向RSGR两种观点。 这个解决方案不仅通过同步互补曝光以平衡跨帧动态范围,处理RSGR的固有缺陷,而且还引入了HDR在高度动态场景下进行摄影的有效方法. 我们提议的网络首先兼顾到逐行的互补性,并且通过逐行调整功能来管理视觉转变。 随后,幻觉模块基于一个相关引导的混合意向块,整合了相互强化的特性以恢复缺失的细节. 此外,我们建造了一个同轴成像系统,以收集一个现实世界的数据集,从而能够进行超出数字模拟的强力训练和评价。 实验结果表明,我们的解决办法在减少登记册系统管理人和推进人类发展报告重建技术方面具有双重好处。

articles.title: MultiVENT-Raw: A Benchmark for Retrieval and Reasoning over Raw Videos
articles.content: Online information is increasingly consumed in video format. Much of this comes in the form of *raw video*: continuous footage taken on a cell phone, with a hand-held camera, or via CCTV, which is then directly uploaded to social media platforms and content sharing services. Whereas professional or even amateur-edited footage tends to feature scripted speech, chyrons, graphics, and metadata that help contextualize its subject matter, raw video typically contains none of these things, making it a much more challenging medium for information retrieval and machine understanding. To facilitate progress in this domain, we release MultiVENT-Raw, a multilingual collection of nearly 120,000 primarily raw videos (over 5,300 total hours), paired with 130 events and 222 event-centric queries, along with human-annotated video relevance judgments and human-extracted key facts for relevant videos. MultiVENT-Raw supports both a retrieval task---to identify videos in the collection relevant to a query event---and a generation task---to summarize event-related videos into a coherent report for a target user. We benchmark strong baselines on MultiVENT-Raw, showing both tasks to be challenging even for some of the latest multimodal models.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 多VENT-Raw:原始视频检索和理由基准
articles.content_zh: 在线信息越来越多地以视频形式使用。 大部分内容以*raw view*的形式出现: 连续的镜头拍摄在手机上,手持相机,或通过CCTV,然后直接上传到社交媒体平台和内容共享服务. 虽然专业的甚至业余编辑的镜头往往以脚本化的演讲,chyrons,图形,和元数据为特色,帮助其主题的上下文化,但原始视频一般不包含这些内容,使它成为信息检索和机器理解更具挑战性的媒介. 为了促进这一领域的进展,我们发布了MultiVENT-Raw,该多语种集主要为原始视频(总时数超过5 300小时),配对130个事件和222个以事件为中心的查询,以及人情描述的视频相关判断和人情描述的相关视频关键事实。 MultiVENT-Raw既支持检索任务——在收集中识别与查询事件相关的视频——又支持一代任务——将事件相关视频总结为目标用户的连贯报告. 我们以多VENT-Raw为基准确定强有力的基线,表明即使对一些最新的多式联运模式而言,这两项任务都具有挑战性。

articles.title: Predicting the Progression of Adolescent Idiopathic Scoliosis
articles.content: Adolescent Idiopathic Scoliosis is defined as a lateral curvature of the spine that develops during adolescence, without known cause. The condition can result in significant pain and disability, and often progresses rapidly during adolescence. The objective of this paper is to predict the progression of the condition in a temporal sequence from ages 9 to 24, as measured from a sequence of Dual X-ray Absorptiometry (DXA) scans. To this end, we train a transformer model that takes in the curve of the spine to predict curve progression. The model is trained using a large-scale synthetic dataset of spine curves and their time series, covering different curve types and different progression patterns. We show that the model is able to generalise from synthetic to real data by evaluating it on a dataset of real DXA scans covering multiple time points. We find that fine-tuning the model on real data gives a significant boost to performance. The model is able to accurately predict spine curve progression in both scoliosis and normal cases.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 预测青少年精神病病的发展
articles.content_zh: 青少年精神病患者 脊椎硬化被定义为脊椎在青春期发育的横向曲折,没有已知的原因. 病情可能导致严重疼痛和残疾,而且往往在青春期迅速发展。 本文的目的是预测从9岁到24岁的病情在时间序列中的进展,通过双X射线增压扫描(DXA)的序列测量. 为此,我们训练一个变压器模型,在脊椎的曲线中,用来预测曲线的进化. 该模型使用脊椎曲线及其时间序列的大规模合成数据集进行训练,涵盖了不同的曲线类型和不同的进化模式. 我们显示,该模型能够通过在覆盖多个时间点的DXA真实扫描数据集上评价它,从而从合成数据到真实数据进行概括. 我们发现,在真实数据上对模型进行微调能大大提升性能. 该模型能够准确预测脊椎曲线在骨灰化和正常病例中的进展。

articles.title: The Skin-Restricted Reinhard Transform:Uniqueness under a Lightness-Preserving Constraint
articles.content: Catalog skin recolouring has to change pigment and leave shading alone. The classical Reinhard map does not make that split: it rescales lightness by the ratio of standard deviations, and a flat reference swatch therefore flattens the limb. This paper formalises the correction used in our pipeline, the skin-restricted Reinhard transform. It is the diagonal affine map in CIE Lab that translates lightness, matches the chromatic mean, and clamps the chromatic gain to [0.72, 1.18], with moments taken on the central 84% of each channel. A diagonal affine map has six real parameters. The shading constraint forces the lightness gain to +1 and the lightness shift to the difference of means; one-dimensional quadratic optimal transport on each chromatic axis, followed by Euclidean projection onto the gain interval, fixes the other four. Inside that family the four conditions determine every parameter. The content of the result is the forced lightness gain; it is not a uniqueness claim outside the diagonal affine class. For Gaussian marginals the chromatic step is not merely the best affine map: it is the unrestricted Wasserstein-2 map. The same formulae with trimmed moments remain optimal because a positive affine image commutes with quantile trimming. On hands, arms, legs, and feet of nine photographs and three reference tones, the map keeps the lightness contrast ratio at 0.974 +/- 0.029 with chromatic error 0.77 CIE Lab units. Reinhard matching, the linear Monge map, and histogram matching reach a smaller chromatic error only by cutting lightness contrast to about half.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 皮肤限制的莱因哈德变形: 光线保护约束下的独特性
articles.content_zh: Catalog 皮肤整流必须改变色素,留下阴影。 古典莱茵哈德地图并没有使这种分化:它通过标准偏差的比例来调整光度,因此一个扁平的参考表使得四肢扁平. 这张纸将我们输油管中使用的校正, 皮肤受限制的Reinhard变形,正式化. 是CIE Lab中的对角芳香图翻译光度,匹配色素平均值,将色素增益夹在[0.72,1.18]上,每一通道的中央84%上都摄取了瞬间. 一条对角的affine地图有六个真正的参数. 阴影约束迫使光度增益到+1,光度转移到手段差异;每个色轴上的一维四极最佳迁移,然后欧几利得投射到增益间隔上,将其他四个修正. 在这个家庭里,四个条件决定了每个参数。 结果的内容是强制光度增益;这不是在对角芳类之外的独特性主张. 对高斯边际来说,色谱阶梯不仅仅是最好的芬美图:它是不受限制的瓦瑟斯坦-2地图. 同样的配方与修剪的瞬间依然最为理想,因为正向的亲缘图像与四分位的修剪相通。 在手,臂,腿,脚9张照片和3个参考音素上,地图将光度对比比保持在0.974+/-0.029,带有色差0.77 CIE Lab单位. 莱因哈德匹配,线性蒙格图,直方图匹配只能通过剪切光度与约一半的对比来达到较小的色度误差.

articles.title: Frozen Flows Forget: Diagnosing and Restoring Lost Motion in a Latent-flow World Model
articles.content: Latent world models that integrate a flow in a frozen self supervised latent space train stably and cheaply, yet silently lose the property manipulation depends on most: motion. The pretrained flow never moves the manipulated object; retraining it with latent-only losses only trades stillness for teleport-like motion. We trace the failure to the training signal, not the representation: anchor-sparse, latent-only supervision never says where along the horizon change belongs. Decode-augmented rollout training (DART) repairs this while keeping the representation frozen, retraining only the flow with decode-path supervision. DART outperforms its latent only parent on the full protocol, restores the temporal structure of motion, and re-couples predicted motion to the scene; at larger scale it further improves prediction quality, closing nearly half the remaining gap to an oracle-informed interpolation reference. Finally, we report an unexpected finding about evaluation: pixel error alone rewards frozen predictions.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 冻结流动 忘记:在后期流动的世界模式中诊断和恢复失落的运动
articles.content_zh: 后期世界模型将一股流融合在冰冻的自控潜伏空间列车中,这种流动是刺耳和廉价的,但沉默地失去地产操纵取决于大多数:运动. 预先调节的流从不移动被操纵的物体;再培训它时只使用潜在的损失,只用静态来换取电传port般的运动. 我们追踪失败到训练信号,而不是代表:锚-sparse,潜伏-唯一监督从来不说沿地平线的变化属于何处。 解码助推培训(DART)在保持代表冻结的同时进行修复,仅对流进行解码路径监督的再培训. DART在全协议上超越了它潜伏的唯一母体,恢复了运动的时间结构,并重新将预测的运动与现场连接起来;在更大的规模上,它进一步提高了预测质量,将剩余差距的近一半缩小到一个神谕知情的内插参考. 最后,我们报告一个关于评价的意外发现:光是像素错误就可以奖励冻结的预测.

articles.title: AnchorReasoning: A Visual Grounding and Causal Reasoning Dataset in Long-Tail Autonomous Driving Scenarios
articles.content: Vision-language models (VLMs) offer a promising approach to long-tail autonomous driving, but existing driving datasets provide limited supervision for connecting decision-critical visual evidence with reasoning and planning. We introduce AnchorReasoning, a visually grounded reasoning dataset built on WOD-E2E, containing 416,119 annotated frames and 395,379 decision-critical elements across four major categories and 19 fine-grained types. Each frame is organized as a visually grounded chain-of-thought (VG-CoT) that links decision-critical element identification and localization, element attributes and implications, driving-action rationale, and action and trajectory planning. We further develop a curriculum supervised fine-tuning strategy that progressively learns these hierarchical capabilities, together with an object-size-aware grounding metric for evaluating localization quality. Experiments across eight general-purpose, embodied-AI, and AV-specific backbones show that VG-CoT supervision improves grounded reasoning and trajectory prediction. Across models, 5-s ADE and FDE decrease by 7.84 and 11.86, while RFS Frame and Cluster improve by 1.66 and 1.70. These gains are achieved with 18.5 fewer reasoning tokens and 0.32 s/frame lower inference latency on average, demonstrating the value of visually grounded, decision-focused supervision for VLM reasoning and planning in long-tail autonomous driving.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: AnchorReasoning:长塔自主驾驶情景中的视觉地面和原因数据集
articles.content_zh: 远景语言模型(VLMs)为长尾自主驾驶提供了一个很有希望的方法,但现有的驱动数据集对于将决定关键视觉证据与推理和规划联系起来提供了有限的监督. 我们介绍了AnchorReasoning,这是一个基于WOD-E2E的视觉推理数据集,包含416,119个附加说明的框架和395,379个决定关键要素,分四大类和19个精细的种类。 每个框架都是作为视网膜思维链(VG-CoT)排列的,将决策关键要素的识别和本地化、要素属性和影响、驱动-行动原理以及行动和轨迹规划联系起来。 我们进一步制定有监督的微调战略,逐步学习这些分级能力,同时制定评价本地化质量的物体大小认识基数。 跨越8个一般用途的实验,内含-AI和AV特定骨干显示,VG-CoT监督改进了有根据的推理和轨迹预测. 在整个模型中,5s-ADE和FDE减少了7.84和11.86,而RFS框架和集群则改善了1.66和1.70. 通过18.5个推理符号和0.32 s/frame推论较低的推论平均延缓率,这些成就得以实现,这表明了视网膜、以决策为重点的监督在长尾自主驾驶中进行VLM推理和规划的价值。

articles.title: Privacy-Preserving Semantic Segmentation from High-Resolution Depth and Ultra-Low-Resolution RGB
articles.content: As mobile robots become increasingly integrated into everyday environments, privacy risks arising from onboard cameras have become a growing concern. Ultra-low-resolution (ULR) RGB can mitigate visual privacy exposure at the source, but ULR appearance alone substantially limits semantic and spatial understanding. We therefore introduce a privacy-preserving asymmetric sensing setting that combines high-resolution (HR) depth with ULR RGB, preserving dense geometry while restricting fine-grained visual information. To address the severe information imbalance between HR depth and ULR RGB, we propose a joint 2D framework using HR geometry to guide semantic-oriented RGB reconstruction and RGB-D segmentation. Despite reliable frame-level predictions, consistent scene-level understanding remains challenging under the asymmetric HR depth--ULR RGB setting. We therefore develop an end-to-end 2D-to-3D pipeline that consolidates 2D semantic features for 3D segmentation. Experiments on ScanNet show that our method achieves the best 2D and 3D segmentation performance among privacy-preserving approaches and delivers the strongest zero-shot transfer to SUN RGB-D and SceneNN. Privacy recoverability analysis shows that our proposed HR depth--ULR RGB input reduces the recoverability of sensitive data, and real-robot experiments demonstrate the utility of the resulting 3D semantics for object-goal navigation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从高分辨率深度和超低分辨率 RGB 保存隐私语义分割
articles.content_zh: 随着移动机器人日益融入日常环境,机载相机带来的隐私风险日益成为人们的关注. 超低分辨率(ULR)RGB可以减轻源头的视觉隐私暴露,但仅ULR外观就实质性地限制了语义和空间理解. 因此,我们采用了一种将高分辨率深度(HR)与ULR RGB相结合的保全隐私的不对称感知环境,在限制精致的视觉信息的同时,保护密度几何。 为了解决HR深度与ULR RGB之间的严重信息不平衡,我们提出一个使用HR几何来指导语义导向的RGB重建和RGB-D分割的联合2D框架. 尽管有可靠的帧级预测,但在不对称的HR深度-ULR RGB设置下,一致的场景级理解仍然具有挑战性. 因此,我们开发了一个端到端的2D至3D管道,将2D语义特征整合为3D分割. ScanNet上的实验显示,我们的方法在隐私保存方法中实现了最好的2D和3D分解性能,并向SUN RGB-D和ScenenNN提供了最强的零镜头传输. 隐私可回收性分析显示,我们提议的HR深度-ULR RGB输入降低了敏感数据的可回收性,而实际机器人实验显示由此产生的三维语义对物体目标导航的实用性.

articles.title: Zero-Shot Object Removal via Attention Masking, Latent Anchoring, and Refinement
articles.content: Removing an object from a real image requires more than synthesizing plausible content within a mask: the method must suppress residual object features, preserve the unedited scene, and generate replacement content that is consistent with the surrounding background. This paper approaches object removal from a stage-based perspective and proposes a zero-shot framework for constrained latent inpainting with a frozen pretrained Stable Diffusion model, requiring no task-specific training or model fine-tuning. The method integrates SAM-based mask construction, BLIP image-caption conditioning, DDIM inversion, background-weighted masked null-text optimization, decoder self-attention masking, hard outside-mask latent anchoring, and localized renoise--denoise refinement into a unified pipeline. The method is evaluated through qualitative examples, quantitative local-consistency metrics, and ablation studies. The results demonstrate effective object removal and context-consistent replacement content. The ablations indicate that background-weighted masked NTI is particularly beneficial for structurally complex backgrounds, whereas the no-NTI variant is sufficient in other evaluated examples. Repeated refinement further reduces object remnants and boundary artifacts remaining after the primary editing pass.

articles.title_zh: 通过注意面具、后期安打和精准化清除零热物体
articles.content_zh: 从真实的图像中移除一个对象需要的不仅仅是在面具中合成可信的内容:方法必须压制剩余对象特征,保存未经编辑的场景,并生成与周围背景一致的替换内容. 本文从阶段角度着手排除物体,并提议采用冷冻的预先训练的稳定扩散模型,对受限的潜在涂装采用零镜头框架,不需要针对具体任务的培训或模型微调。 该方法融合了基于SAM的面具构造,BLIP的图像封装配置,DDIM反演,背景加权的面具虚文本优化,解码器自觉的面具,硬化的外罩潜锚,本地化的renoise-denoise精炼成为统一的管道. 该方法通过定性实例、定量的当地一致性衡量尺度和消化研究加以评价。 结果显示有效的物体清除和符合上下文的替换内容。 浮标表明,背景加权蒙面NTI对结构复杂的背景特别有利,而在其他受评价的例子中,无NTI的变体就足够了。 多次完善,进一步减少主编辑通过后遗留的文物和边界文物.

articles.title: BronchoTop: Bronchoscopy Navigation via RGB-Only Topological Localization
articles.content: Accurate localization of the bronchoscope within the bronchial tree is essential for clinicians to be able to reach target lesions, perform biopsies and avoid misidentification of airway segments during diagnostic and therapeutic procedures. However, existing navigation systems typically rely on patient-specific CT scans or additional external sensors, increasing cost, setup time and patient radiation exposure. This work presents BronchoTop, a real-time, RGB-only framework for topological bronchoscopy localization that eliminates the need for patient-specific data. BronchoTop estimates scope location relative to a generic airway model through four modules: lumen detection and tracking, lumen-branch label association, probabilistic scope location estimation, and switch verification. By using only standard bronchoscopy video input, BronchoTop provides practical, real-time navigational assistance to physicians. Evaluation on phantom, simulated and real data demonstrates state-of-the-art accuracy, improving existing approaches performance by over 20% on real bronchoscopy sequences. BronchoTop is the first published framework including both the localization algorithms as well as all the real data used, together with code to generate additional simulations, encouraging and facilitating further developments and benchmarking. The results highlight BronchoTop's potential to enhance procedural safety, efficiency and accessibility in clinical and robotic bronchoscopy.

articles.title_zh: BronchoTop:通过 RGB- 唯一的地形本地化进行溴化镜像导航
articles.content_zh: 支气管树内支气管的准确本地化对于临床医生能够达到目标损伤,进行生物检查,避免在诊断和治疗过程中对气道部分进行误认至关重要. 然而,现有的导航系统一般依赖于患者特有的CT扫描或额外的外部传感器,增加了成本,设置时间和患者的辐射照射. 本作介绍了BronchoTop,这是一个实时的,只使用RGB的地形支气管校正局部化的框架,它消除了对患者特定数据的需求. 布朗乔 相对于通用气道模型,顶级估计范围位置通过四个模块: Lumen检测和跟踪, Lumen-branch 标签关联,概率估计范围位置,以及切换验证. BronchoTop通过只使用标准的支气管镜影视输入,为医生提供实用的实时导航协助. 对幽灵、模拟和真实数据的评价显示了最新精度,使现有方法在真正的支气管镜检查序列上的表现提高了20%以上。 布朗乔 Top是第一个公布的框架,既包括本地化算法,也包括所有使用的真实数据,以及生成更多模拟的代码,鼓励和促进进一步发展和基准化. 结果凸显了BronchoTop在临床和机器人支气管镜学中提高程序安全性,效率和可获取性的潜力.

articles.title: LightMIS: Ultra-Lightweight Medical Image Segmentation Without a Stage-Wise Decoder
articles.content: We present LightMIS, a scalable family of ultra-lightweight convolutional networks for 2D binary medical image segmentation without a learned stage-wise decoder. LightMIS aligns the outputs of a five-level encoder to a common resolution using Scale-Aligned Projection blocks, aggregates them once, and refines the fused representation with an Adaptive Fusion Cascade. The cascade combines Adaptive Kernel Fusion with the proposed Progressive Receptive Fusion module, which uses temporary channel expansion, complementary depthwise receptive fields, and progressive cross-branch information transfer. We evaluate LightMIS-T, LightMIS-S, and LightMIS using five-fold cross-validation under a common nnU-Net v2.3.1 protocol on DRIVE, Kvasir-SEG, DSB18, BUSI, ISIC-2017, and ISIC-2018. Full LightMIS contains 0.131 M parameters and requires 0.575 GFLOPs for a $3\times256\times256$ input, achieving modality-macro Dice and IoU scores of 86.71% and 78.99%, respectively. Mobile U-ViT obtains 86.75% Dice and 79.07% IoU, so the observed differences are 0.04 and 0.08 percentage points. Relative to Mobile U-ViT, nnWNet, and nnU-Net, LightMIS reduces parameter count by 90.58$-$99.61% and GFLOPs by 82.54$-$96.14%. On an Arm Mali-G52 MC2 GPU, all LightMIS variants achieve full GPU delegation, with median delegated latency ranging from 53.31 ms for LightMIS-T to 138.31 ms for LightMIS. These results demonstrate a favorable accuracy$-$complexity trade-off and on-device execution feasibility for the evaluated tasks. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/AndreiiArhire/LightMIS.

articles.title_zh: LightMIS:超轻量级医疗图像分解器,无阶段解码器
articles.content_zh: 我们介绍LightMIS,一个可扩展的家族,由超轻量级的转录网络组成,用于2D二进制医学影像分解,没有学习的舞台解码器. articles.title: VGM-VS: Rethinking Visual Geometry Model for High-Precision Visual Servoing
articles.content: We present VGM-VS, a visual servoing method built on a pretrained feed-forward visual geometry model. Given the current view and a reference image captured at the target configuration, we estimate the relative camera pose with a visual geometry model and apply it iteratively as the pose increment of a closed-loop pose-based visual servoing (PBVS) scheme. The geometry-aware representation acquired from large-scale pretraining keeps this estimate reliable when the target is occluded, weakly textured, or covers only a small part of the image. However, the scale ambiguity inherent to these models leaves the predicted translation defined up to an unknown scale, while the pose increment must be metric for robot control. We close this gap with a scene-specific metric adaptation: the robot autonomously records image--pose pairs along a predefined motion starting from the target pose, and we fine-tune the camera head on these data, jointly learning the hand--eye transform and thus removing the need for a dedicated calibration process. We evaluate our method on three real-world assembly tasks with demanding tolerances: USB-C cable picking, cable insertion, and RAM insertion. Running in real time at 30Hz, VGM-VS converges to submillimeter terminal accuracy on the cable tasks, and reaches success rates of 90--100\% when the target is moved during servoing. It converges in all trials under initial displacements of up to 30cm from the reference pose and with 50\% of the target object occluded, outperforming the compared visual servoing baselines.

articles.title_zh: VGM-VS:高精度视觉变速器视觉几何模型的反思
articles.content_zh: 我们介绍VGM-VS,一种视觉伺服法,它建立在预先训练的向导的视觉几何模型上. 鉴于当前视图和在目标配置中捕获的参考图像,我们用视觉几何模型来估计相对相机的姿势,并迭代应用它作为闭路式假象伺服器(PBVS)方案的姿势增量. 从大规模预训中获得的几何感知代表值,在目标被占据,纹理薄弱,或者只覆盖图像的一小部分时,保持了这一估计值的可靠性. 然而,这些模型所固有的尺度模糊性使得所定义的预测翻译达到一个未知的尺度,而姿势增量必须是机器人控制的尺度. 我们用一个特定场景的度量适应来弥补这个差距:机器人自主地记录了从目标姿势开始的预设运动上的图像-pose对,我们微调了这些数据上的相机头,共同学习手眼变换,从而消除了专用校准过程的需要. 我们评价我们三种现实世界装配任务的方法,要求容忍: USB-C电缆采样,电缆插入,以及RAM插入. 实时运行于30Hz,VGM-VS在电缆任务上与次毫米终端精度汇合,在伺服时目标移动时成功率达到90-100\%. 它在初始位置离参考位置30厘米以下的所有试验中,与目标物体的50+%相汇合,超过了相对的视觉服务基线。

articles.title: RoomLight: A 2.5D Illumination Prior for Indoor Environments
articles.content: Ill-posed inverse problems require priors to constrain the solution space toward plausible outcomes. In inverse rendering, learned priors modeling the distribution of natural illumination improve the recovery of scene properties. However, existing models rely on the distant-illumination assumption, representing lighting as a far-field environment map. This limits their applicability to indoor scenes, where illumination is highly spatially varying due to finite-distance emitters, visibility changes, and parallax, all of which are poorly approximated by a single environment map. To address this, we introduce a spatially-aware illumination prior trained on real-world indoor panoramas and their estimated depth. Our variational autoencoder model learns a compact, optimizable latent space that decodes into HDR radiance and depth, parameterizing an area light emitter for direct integration into standard differentiable rendering pipelines. This design bridges the plausibility guarantees of a learned prior with the gradient flow required for downstream optimization. Crucially, by jointly modeling radiance and depth, our prior captures the spatial structure of indoor illumination, instead of treating the light sources as infinitely distant. We demonstrate that this formulation enables spatially-varying illumination modeling and achieves higher-fidelity recovery of indoor lighting compared to existing approaches. Project page: https://andreead-a.github.io/RoomLight

articles.title_zh: 室光:室内环境前2.5D照明
articles.content_zh: 出现反面问题需要先验才能限制解决办法的空间,使其取得可能的结果。 在反向渲染中,学习到的先兆模拟自然照明的分布,改善了场景特性的恢复. 然而,现有的模型依赖于远射假设,代表照明作为远野环境图. 这限制了它们对室内场景的适用性,因为室内场景的照明因有限距离的发射器,能见度变化,以及抛射物而有很大的空间差异,而所有这些场景都与单一的环境图相差甚远. 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了空间意识照明,事先受过关于现实世界室内全景及其估计深度的培训。 我们的变异自编码器模型学习了一个紧凑、可选择的潜在空间,将代码解码为HDR的光度和深度,将一个区域光发射器参数化,以便直接融入标准的不同渲染管道。 这种设计桥梁是下游优化所需的梯度流之前所学的可信保证。 关键是,通过联合建模光度和深度,我们之前就抓住了室内照明的空间结构,而不是将光源视为无限遥远. 我们证明,这种配方能够进行空间变异的照明模型制作,比起现有方法,室内照明的恢复性更高。 项目网页:https://andreead-a.github.io/RoomLight

articles.title: PBLH Estimation from Satellite Radiances via a Dual-Encoder Transformer
articles.content: Estimating the Planetary Boundary Layer Height (PBLH) from satellite observations is a challenging regression problem due to the indirect relationship between top-of-atmosphere radiances and near-surface atmospheric structure. Progress has been limited both by the lack of architectures capable of handling the multimodal, spatially incomplete nature of satellite overpasses, and by the scarcity of suitable datasets. In this paper, we build upon the large-scale dataset pairing MetOp radiances with ERA5 PBLH labels that we introduced in our previous work, making three contributions. First, we establish a benchmark across eight approaches spanning pixel-wise regression, swath-wise sequence models, and convolutional and Transformer models operating on the full orbital passage. Second, we quantify what the resulting model actually relies on, using grouped Shapley decomposition over the input blocks. Third, we present the best-performing architecture found: a dual-encoder Transformer whose masked-input handling lets it operate in all weather conditions. The proposed model achieves MAE = 155.8 m on the held-out global test set, outperforming all baselines on every evaluation subset. On 30 out-of-distribution granules acquired on two days overlapping the TEAMx observational campaign, it achieves MAE = 165.3 m, outperforming a pixel-wise baseline trained on the same data (MAE = 197 m).

articles.title_zh: PBLH 通过双编码器变换器从卫星辐射得到的估计
articles.content_zh: 从卫星观测中估计行星边界层高度是一个具有挑战性的回归问题,因为顶层光度和近地层大气结构之间的间接关系。 由于缺乏能够处理卫星过山多式、空间不完整的建筑,以及缺乏适当的数据集,进展受到限制。 在本文中,我们借鉴了我们在先前的作品中引入的将MetOp光度与ERA5 PBLH标签配对的大规模数据集,做出了三项贡献. 首先,我们确定一个基准,涵盖八种方法, 包括像素级回归, 斯瓦思级序列模型, 以及演化和变形器模型 运行在全轨道通道上。 第二,我们用组合的沙普利分解法 来量化所形成的模型实际依赖的是什么。 第三,我们介绍所发现的绩效最佳的架构:一个双编码变形器,其掩码输入处理使其在所有天气条件下运作。 拟议模型在搁置的全球测试中达到MAE=155.8米,超过了每个评价子集的所有基线。 在与TEAMx观测运动重叠两天获得的30个分配外颗粒上,它实现了MAE = 165.3米,超过了在同一数据(MAE = 197米)上培训的像素基准。

articles.title: Benchmarking Hyperspectral Foundation Models for Hyperspectral Unmixing
articles.content: Several foundation models dedicated to hyperspectral images have recently been made available. These models are trained on large unlabeled datasets and exhibit strong performance on many hyperspectral imaging tasks, such as classification or denoising. Nonetheless, their performance for hyperspectral unmixing -- the task of separating mixed spectra of overlapping materials in a hyperspectral image -- remain understudied. This might partly be due to the fact that most of them rely on vision transformer backbones, including patchification, leading to a feature resolution problem. While hyperspectral unmixing already arises from the low resolution of hyperspectral images, this patchification step potentially makes the problem even more ill-posed. Therefore, in this work, we aim to answer two questions: 1) \emph{how do foundation models perform in hyperspectral unmixing?}; 2) \emph{how to tackle the feature-level loss of resolution?} To answer the first question, we benchmark foundation models for unmixing, showing that they can reach state-of-the-art performance on four hyperspectral unmixing datasets. To answer the second question, we compare several feature upsampling approaches and empirically show that using a simple one can lead to high performance results. The code is available at https://gitlab.telecom-paris.fr/ring/hfm-hsu.git.

articles.title_zh: 用于超光谱解密的超光谱基础模型
articles.content_zh: 最近提供了若干专门处理超光谱图像的基础模型。 这些模型都接受了大型无标签数据集的培训,并在许多超光谱成像任务(如分类或解析)上表现出很强的性能. 尽管如此,它们在超光谱解密方面的性能 -- -- 在超光谱图像中分离重叠材料的混合光谱 -- -- 仍然没有得到充分的研究。 其部分原因可能是,大多数都依赖于视觉变压器骨干,包括补丁,导致特征解决问题。 虽然超光谱解密已经产生于超光谱图像的低分辨率,但这一补丁步骤有可能使问题更难掌握. 因此,在这项工作中,我们的目标是回答两个问题: 1)\emph{ 基础模型如何在超光谱解密中运行?}; 2)\emph{如何解决特性级解析损失?} 为了回答第一个问题,我们把基础模型作为不混合的基准,表明它们可以在四个超光谱不混合数据集上达到最先进的性能. 为了回答第二个问题,我们比较了几种特征抽样方法,从经验上表明,使用简单的方法可以导致高性能结果。 该代码可见于https://gitlab.telecom-paris.fr/ring/hfm-hsu.git.

articles.title: RAMP: Robust Adaptive Mixed-Precision Quantization for Edge CPU Vision Models
articles.content: Deploying deep learning models on edge CPUs is bottlenecked by computational and memory constraints. Mixed-precision quantization promises to reduce inference latency while preserving accuracy. However, quantization affects different layer types in inconsistent ways, so identifying where accuracy loss is minimized and latency reduction is maximized is critical, as the effect accumulates over a full deployment into substantial savings or unacceptable task degradation. Such identification relies on sensitivity metrics, proxies that estimate layer-wise degradation without evaluating the task accuracy of every candidate policy. Nevertheless, widely used metrics fail systematically on modern architectures. We present a systematic empirical study of 13 sensitivity metrics for layer-wise INT8 quantization across four distinctly different neural networks, and validate the resulting policies on two ARM64 platforms. Gradient-based sensitivity methods fail on 4 out of 8 model-hardware configurations and weight-based statistics on 2. In contrast, the Jensen-Shannon Divergence achieves zero catastrophic failures, reliably isolating the layers that cannot be safely quantized. A sensitivity metric alone does not define a policy, and the fixed thresholds typically used for that step are fragile over the highly skewed distributions of modern architectures. We address this with K-Means clustering, achieving near-lossless accuracy and a mean speed-up of $1.81\times$ over the full-precision model. Finally, we reveal that excluding from quantization the layers whose speed-up is negligible, regardless of their sensitivity, can be counterproductive, as it induces computational graph fragmentation and disables operator fusion. Our results yield concrete allocation policies for practitioners and researchers deploying quantized vision models on heterogeneous edge CPUs, without GPU access or gradient computation.

articles.title_zh: RAMP:用于边际CPU视野模型的强适应性混合精度量化
articles.content_zh: 在边缘CPU上部署深层学习模型受到计算和内存限制的瓶颈. 混合精度量化有望减少推论延迟,同时保持准确性. 然而,量化以不一致的方式影响不同层的类型,因此,确定在哪些方面将准确性损失减少到最低程度,并最大限度地减少延迟,这一点至关重要,因为通过充分部署,这种效应将累积到大量节省或不可接受的任务退化中。 这种识别依赖于敏感性衡量标准,即不评估每个候选政策的任务准确性而估计分层退化的代词。 尽管如此,广泛使用的度量衡在现代建筑上还是系统失败. 我们提出了对13个敏感性度量度的系统经验研究,用于在四个截然不同的神经网络中进行分层INT8量化,并验证两个ARM64平台所产生的政策。 基于渐变的灵敏度方法在8个模型硬件配置和2个加权统计中4个失败. 与此相对照的是,詹森-沙农分化实现了零灾难性的失败,可靠地隔离了无法安全量化的层层. 光是敏感度衡量标准并不能确定政策,而这一步骤通常使用的固定阈值相对于现代建筑高度扭曲的分布来说是脆弱的。 我们用K-Means群集来解决这个问题,实现几乎无损失的精度,并在全精度模型上平均加速1.81美元。 最后,我们揭示,将速度可忽略不计的地层从数量中排除,不管其敏感性如何,都会产生反效果,因为它会诱发计算图分裂,使操作员聚变失效。 我们的成果产生了具体的分配政策,供从业者和研究人员在不同的边缘CPU上部署量化的视觉模型,而无需GPU访问或梯度计算。

articles.title: Generalizable Robotic Insertion with World Models
articles.content: Robotic assembly in high-mixture settings requires adaptable systems that can handle diverse parts, yet current approaches typically rely on policies specialized to each insertion task. Although this can reach high success rates, it makes the process of deploying systems for new problems tedious and time consuming. We present a framework for generalizable insertion using world models that combine robot proprioceptive information with raw visual observations captured by a wrist-mounted camera. Our model-based approach trains a single world model on up to 90 insertion tasks with geometrically diverse parts, achieving 56% zero-shot success on unseen objects with unknown geometry compared to just 7% with a model-free baseline. Importantly, performance improves as more objects are included in the training dataset, demonstrating strong scalability. Lastly, finetuning the generalist model on held-out objects significantly enhances data-efficiency compared to training from scratch and, in some cases, achieves better asymptotic performance. To our knowledge, this is the first system capable of assembling unseen objects in an entirely data-driven manner, and thus represents a significant step toward scalable, generalizable robotic assembly systems.

articles.title_zh: 通用机器人与世界模型插入
articles.content_zh: 高混合环境下的机器人组装需要能够处理不同部分的适应性系统,但目前的做法通常依赖于针对每项插入任务的专门政策。 虽然这可以达到很高的成功率,但它使部署新问题的系统的过程变得乏味和费时。 我们提出一个通用的插入框架,使用世界模型,将机器人自控信息与手腕式摄像机捕获的原始视觉观测相结合。 我们的基于模型的方法在最多90个包含几何多样性的插入任务上训练出一个单一的世界模型,在无模型基线的未见物体上实现了56%的零射成功率,而只有7%的无模型基线。 重要的是,随着培训数据集中包括更多的对象,表现了强大的可扩展性,性能得到改善。 最后,对被搁置物体的通用模型进行微调,大大加强了数据效率,而不是从零开始的培训,在某些情况下,还提高了不对称性能。 据我们所知,这是第一个能够完全以数据驱动的方式集合看不见的物体的系统,因此是朝着可扩展、可通用的机器人组装系统迈出的重要一步。

articles.title: MemBodied: Recurrent Associative Memory for Vision-Language-Action Models
articles.content: Vision-Language-Action models provide a strong foundation for general-purpose robot control, yet a vast majority of policies do not preserve and leverage episode-level information beyond the current observation. This limitation is consequential in history-dependent manipulation tasks that depend on information available only in past observations. Retaining past observations in context can aid in recovering this information, but at the significant cost of ever-growing, bloated context and inference latency. We thus introduce MemBodied, a fixed-size episodic memory with two complementary components: an associative state that records interactions across policy calls and an episode anchor that preserves a compact representation of the initial scene as a reference. At each policy call, the model conditions action generation on the current input and the memory components, rather than directly using past observations. Across five evaluated RMBench tasks requiring memory, MemBodied achieves $7.81\times$ the mean success rate of a stateless policy and $2.98\times$ of vanilla recurrent memory, while outperforming the strongest memory-augmented baseline by $1.3\times$ with $10\times$ fewer added parameters. On the fully observable LIBERO-Long suite, it reached 90.6%, a 5.4% improvement over the stateless $π_0$ policy. These findings support MemBodied as a practical alternative to expanding the policy context for history-dependent manipulation.

articles.title_zh: MemBodied:愿景-语言-行动模式的经常性关联记忆
articles.content_zh: 视觉-语言-行动模型为通用机器人控制提供了坚实基础,然而绝大多数政策并没有在目前观测之外保存和利用插曲级信息. 这种限制是依赖历史的操纵任务的结果,这些任务仅依赖于过去观测中掌握的信息。 从上下文中保留以往的观察有助于恢复这一信息,但以不断增长、膨胀的背景和推断延迟的巨大代价为代价。 因此,我们介绍了MemBodied,一种固定大小的零星记忆,有两个互补的组成部分:一种是记录政策呼吁之间相互作用的关联状态,另一种是作为参考保留最初场景的紧凑表述的插曲主播。 在每次政策呼吁中,模型都会为当前输入和内存组件的动作生成提供条件,而不是直接使用过去的观察. MemBodied在5个评估需要记忆的人民币交易任务中,实现了7.81\的无国籍政策平均成功率和2.98\的香草重复记忆率,同时在1.3\的时间内超过了最强的记忆增强基线,增加了10\的参数。 在完全可观察的LIBERO-Long套房中,该套房达到了90.6%,比无国籍人士的0.4美元政策有所改善。 这些调查结果支持MemBodied作为扩大依赖历史操纵的政策环境的切实替代办法。

articles.title: ODPure: Backdoor Purification for Object Detection via Ensemble Corruption Consensus
articles.content: With the development of applications like autonomous driving, object detection has gained significant attention, while also highlighting critical vulnerabilities like backdoor attacks that severely compromise model integrity. Specifically, such attacks involve altering the categories of objects (i.e., object misclassification), removing bounding boxes (i.e., object disappearance), or generating bounding box proposals for non-existent objects (i.e., object generation) when a predefined trigger is present in the input. Although backdoor defenses for image classification are well-established, the research for object detection remains comparatively underexplored. Existing defenses address these threats by scanning outputs or models for potential backdoors but require discarding either malicious data or models. This remedy fails to enable a continuous and accurate perceptual stream for the object detection pipeline. To address such limitations, we propose ODPure, a novel input-stage black-box defense for object detection, which is based on input purification that ensures stable perception flows. Tailored to the dense prediction nature of object detectors, our Corruption-Reconstruction-Selection (CRS) paradigm operates by neutralizing triggers through a diverse portfolio of corruptions to generate a massive pool of redundant proposals, then recovering fine-grained structural cues via generative priors, and finally employing voting to reach a consensus on the resulting detections. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that our method provides robust defense against diverse backdoor attacks and trigger types while preserving baseline accuracy. Our code is available at https://github.com/Alex66366/ODPure.

articles.title_zh: ODPure:通过隐蔽的腐败共识进行物品检测的后门净化
articles.content_zh: 随着自主驾驶等应用的发展,物体探测也获得了显著关注,同时也突出了后门攻击等严重危害模型完整性的关键弱点. 具体来说,这种攻击涉及改变对象的类别(即对象错误分类),去掉边框(即对象消失),或者在输入中存在预先定义的触发时,为不存在的对象(即对象生成)生成边框建议. 虽然对图像分类的后门防御已经确立,但是对物体探测的研究仍然相对未得到充分的探索. 现有防御手段通过扫描输出物或潜在后门模型来应对这些威胁,但需要放弃恶意数据或模型。 这一补救措施未能使物体探测管道有一个连续和准确的感知流。 为了解决这些限制,我们提出ODPure,一种新型的输入级黑盒防御,用于物体检测,它基于确保感知流动稳定的输入净化. 根据物体探测器的密集预测性质,我们的“腐败-重建-选择”(CRS)范式通过各种腐败来抵消触发因素,产生大量多余的建议,然后通过基因前科恢复微小的结构性提示,最后利用投票就由此产生的探测达成共识。 全面实验表明,我们的方法在保持基线准确性的同时,为各种后门攻击和触发类型提供了有力的防御。 我们的代码见https://github.com/Alex66366/ODPure。

articles.title: EmbodiedMemory-Bench: Benchmarking Embodied Memory for Long-Horizon Embodied Tasks
articles.content: Long-horizon embodied interaction requires agents to retain and continually update information about the environment as they observe, act, and encounter change. Yet current agents struggle to maintain such memory reliably. Our analysis traces this limitation to four key deficiencies: weak fine-grained visual memory, unreliable dynamic world-state tracking, failing to record world state revealed by interaction outcomes, and limited generalization from prior experience. However, existing benchmarks do not directly assess these memory capabilities during long-horizon embodied interaction. To address this gap, we introduce EmbodiedMemory-Bench (EMem-Bench), comprising 2,554 interactive episodes across four task families. EMem-Bench requires agents to build and update memory from interaction history, then use it to complete a later task by acting in the environment. We further present Embodied-Memorizer (EMem), an external memory system that organizes embodied experience into spatial, event, and scene memories. We also train EMem-8B, an 8B policy that manages and uses these memories. We evaluate a diverse range of open-source and proprietary MLLMs and representative multimodal memory systems. Results show that current models remain weak and uneven across the four challenges. Under matched backbones, EMem achieves the best overall performance among the evaluated memory systems and improves both open-source and proprietary models, while EMem-8B further improves over its backbone. Project page: https://zju-omniai.github.io/EmbodiedMemoryBench/

articles.title_zh: 健美记忆-奔驰:长期健美任务的健美记忆基准
articles.content_zh: 具有长视野的相互作用要求代理人在观察、行动和遇到变化时保留和不断更新有关环境的信息。 然而,现在的特工们却难以可靠地保持这种记忆。 我们的分析将这种局限性追溯到四个关键缺陷:微弱的精细视觉记忆,不可靠的动态世界状态跟踪,未能记录互动结果揭示的世界状态,以及以往经验的有限概括. 然而,现有基准并没有直接评估长期互动过程中的这些记忆能力。 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了“健康记忆-奔驰”(EMEM-Bench),由四个任务家庭的2 554个互动节目组成。 EMem-Bench要求代理从相互作用历史中建立和更新内存,然后用它通过在环境中的行动来完成后期的任务. 我们进一步介绍“健美记忆器”(EMem),这是一个外部记忆系统,将经验纳入空间、事件和场景记忆。 我们还训练EMem-8B,一种管理和使用这些记忆的8B政策. 我们评价多种开源和专有的MLLM和有代表性的多式联运内存系统。 结果表明,目前的模式仍然薄弱,而且四个挑战之间不平衡。 在匹配的骨干下,EMem在被评价的内存系统中实现最佳的整体性能,并同时改进开源模型和专有模型,而EMem-8B则在骨干上进一步改善. 项目网页:https://zju-omniai.github.io/Embody Memory Bench/

articles.title: Diff-RF: Mutually Reinforced Image Registration and Fusion via Degradation-Aware Learning
articles.content: Image registration and fusion aim to establish spatial correspondences from misaligned multi-modal source images, and integrate complementary information. However, in real-world imaging scenarios, source images are often affected by complex and diverse degradations, such as low illumination, noise, etc., which severely hinder the effectiveness of registration and fusion. To address this issue, we propose a mutually reinforced image registration and fusion diffusion framework via degradation-aware learning, termed Diff-RF. It explores the intrinsic coupling between registration-fusion and information restoration in the degradation conditions, enabling high-quality fusion of unregistered images under complex degradation conditions. First, the intra-modal restoration module is designed to alleviate modality-specific degradations by leveraging information within each modality, thereby providing more reliable structural representations for registration and facilitating subsequent cross-modal fusion. Second, we develop a cross-modal diffusion registration and fusion module that establishes bidirectional interaction between registration and fusion. By integrating fusion-derived visual cues and correspondence-based geometric conditions into the diffusion process, the proposed framework progressively refines spatial alignment and exploits cross-modal complementary information to achieve collaborative enhancement. Rather than treating them as independent components, degradation-aware information restoration and the collaborative optimization of registration and fusion are tightly coupled, achieving overall performance improvements. Extensive experiments on multiple extended datasets demonstrate that Diff-RF achieves superior registration accuracy and fusion quality under various degraded scenarios, exhibiting strong robustness and generalization ability.

articles.title_zh: Diff-RF:通过降解-智能学习相互加强图像登记和融合
articles.content_zh: 图像登记和组合旨在建立来自错配的多模式源图像的空间通信,并整合补充信息。 然而,在现实世界的成像情景中,源图像往往受到复杂多样的退化影响,如低照明,噪音等,严重妨碍了注册和聚变的有效性. 为了解决这一问题,我们建议通过了解退化的学习,建立一个相互加强的图像登记和聚变传播框架,称为Diff-RF。 它探索了在退化条件下登记与信息恢复之间的内在结合,从而能够在复杂的退化条件下对未登记的图像进行高质量的整合。 首先,模式内恢复模块旨在通过利用每种模式内的信息来缓解模式特有的退化,从而为登记提供更可靠的结构表述,并促进随后的跨模式组合。 第二,我们开发了一个跨模式扩散登记和聚变模块,建立登记和聚变之间的双向互动。 通过将聚变产生的视觉提示和基于通信的几何条件纳入扩散过程,拟议框架逐步完善空间配对,并利用跨模式互补信息实现协作增强。 退化意识信息恢复以及登记和核聚变的协作优化与其作为独立组成部分处理,而是紧密结合,实现整体性能改善。 对多个扩展数据集进行的广泛实验表明,Diff-RF在各种退化的情景下能达到更高的注册准确度和聚变质量,显示出强大的稳健性和通俗化能力.

articles.title: Do Center Biases Propagate? Robustness of Pathology Foundation Models in Whole-Slide Image Classification
articles.content: Pathology foundation models (PFMs) have transformed computational pathology through powerful representation learning from histopathological images. PFMs provide rich, discriminative representations for whole slide image (WSI) analysis, enabling tasks such as slide-level classification under multiple instance learning (MIL). However, these representations may also encode non-biological signals associated with acquisition centers, potentially introducing spurious shortcuts into downstream predictions. In this work, we evaluate center-associated robustness in WSI classification using a controlled training setting with increasing class-center correlations quantified by Cramér's V. We benchmark six PFMs across four datasets and two MIL aggregators, while evaluating ComBat as a robustification strategy. We further introduce the Area Under the Cramér's V Curve (AUCC) to jointly capture absolute classification performance and its degradation as spurious correlation increases. Results show that center-related information encoded by PFMs propagates to WSI-level predictions, with robustness depending on both the PFM representation and MIL aggregation strategy. Additionally, ComBat harmonization does not provide consistent robustness gains across datasets.

articles.title_zh: 中心比塞斯推进门? 全滑图像分类中的病理学基础模型的强性
articles.content_zh: 病理学基础模型(PFMs)通过从组织病理学图像中学习的强势表现,改变了计算病理学. PFM为全幻灯片映像分析(WSI)提供了丰富,具有歧视性的表示方式,在多实例学习(MIL)下可以实现幻灯片级分类等任务. 然而,这些表述还可能编码与收购中心有关的非生物信号,从而有可能在下游预测中引入虚假的捷径。 在这项工作中,我们利用控制的培训环境,评价与中心有关的WSI分类的稳健性,这种环境的班级和中心关联性由Cramér's V量化。 我们以6个PFM为基准,涵盖4个数据集和2个MIL聚合器,同时评价ComBat是强化战略。 我们进一步引入Cramer's V Curve(AUCC)下的区域,以联合捕捉绝对分类性能及其随着虚假相关性的增加而退化. 结果表明,由PFM编码的与中心有关的信息传播到WSI一级的预测,其强性取决于PFM的表示和MIL的汇总战略. 此外,ComBat的协调统一并不能提供各数据集一致的稳健性收益。

articles.title: A Unified Framework and Dataset for Oriented Object Visual Grounding in Remote Sensing
articles.content: Visual grounding in remote sensing images aims to locate objects described by referring expressions. Most existing methods predict horizontal bounding boxes, which are often inaccurate for objects with arbitrary orientations. To address this limitation, we introduce O$^2$-VG, a family of models for oriented object visual grounding with three complementary designs. Specifically, O$^2$-VG-Trans is a cross-modality transformer for oriented object visual grounding. It establishes a strong discriminative foundation for the model family. Building upon it, O$^2$-VG-Uni predicts universal oriented proposals for possible foreground objects without specific text prompts. It also supports object retrieval through cached proposal embeddings. Using these universal oriented proposals as input prompts, O$^2$-VG-VLM is an autoregressive vision-language model. It generates oriented box token blocks in parallel through multi-token prediction. In addition, we construct DIOR-R-RSVG, a dataset for oriented object visual grounding in remote sensing images. It provides image, expression, and oriented box triplets for training and evaluation. Together, the O$^2$-VG family provides a flexible framework that spans discriminative transformers and generative vision-language models. It achieves superior performance across multiple benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/wokaikaixinxin/ai4rs.

articles.title_zh: 遥感中面向对象的目视定位统一框架和数据集
articles.content_zh: 在遥感图像中可视定位的目的是通过引用表达式来定位描述的物体。 大多数现有方法都预测了水平边框,对于有任意方向的物体来说,这些边框往往不准确. 为解决这一限制,我们引进了O$^2$-VG,这是一组面向物体的视觉地面模型,有三个互补的设计。 具体来说,O$^2$-VG-Trans是面向对象视觉地面的跨模式变压器. 它为模范家庭奠定了牢固的歧视性基础。 在此基础上,O$^2$-VG-Uni预测,在没有特定文字提示的情况下,可能面向前景对象的普遍建议。 它还通过缓存建议嵌入支持对象检索. 利用这些面向普遍的建议作为输入提示,O$^2$-VG-VLM是一种自旋式视觉语言模式. 它通过多键预测并行生成面向的箱形符号块. 此外,我们还建造了DIOR-R-RSVG,这是一个数据集,用于遥感图像中面向对象的视觉定位。 它为培训和评价提供形象、表达和定向的三进制箱。 O$^2$-VG家族共同提供了一个灵活的框架,涵盖歧视性变压器和基因视觉语言模型. 它在多个基准方面都取得了优异的业绩。 代码见https://github.com/wokaikaixinxin/airs.

articles.title: From Alignment to Fusion in 3D Vision-Language
articles.content: Unified 3D vision-language systems must combine complementary geometry, scale, and appearance cues while supporting tasks from instance segmentation to language-guided reasoning. Existing methods often process point clouds, voxel grids, and multi-view images independently; directly combining these heterogeneous representations may leave substantial feature discrepancy unresolved, while subsequent unconstrained adaptation may distort their internal geometry. We propose an align-then-fuse framework that first applies triple pairwise cosine alignment to establish segment-level correspondence across the three representations and then retrieves task-conditioned features with a prompt-guided query decoder. Before fusion, representation-specific query features are transformed by learnable mappings constrained to the special orthogonal group. These mappings preserve inner products and Euclidean distances within each representation, permitting controlled representation-specific re-parameterisation without arbitrarily distorting its internal geometry. The transformed features are subsequently combined through Adaptive Fusion under downstream task supervision. Experiments cover eight datasets for instance segmentation, visual grounding, question answering, and dense captioning. Compared with PQ3D, the model improves average precision by 3.2 points on ScanNet200 and grounding accuracy by 2.9, 10.6, 4.6, and 4.1 points on ScanRefer, Nr3D, Sr3D, and Multi3DRefer, respectively, while also improving performance on ScanQA, SQA3D, and Scan2Cap. Ablations further support the complementary roles of alignment and orthogonal re-parameterisation and the effectiveness of Adaptive Fusion.

articles.title_zh: 从对齐到三维视野语言中的融合
articles.content_zh: 统一的3D视觉语言系统必须结合互补的几何、尺度和外观提示,同时支持从实例分割到语言指导推理的任务。 现有方法往往会独立处理点云,voxel网格,以及多视图图像;直接结合这些多样的表示可能留下大量特征差异未解决,而随后的不受约束的适应可能扭曲其内部几何. 我们提出一个对齐-当时的对齐框架,首先采用三对对齐的余弦对齐,在三个代表处建立分层的对应关系,然后检索具有任务条件的特性,并带有一个快速的引导查询解码器。 在聚变之前,代表特异性查询特征通过受特殊正交组制约的可学习绘图而转变. 这些绘图保存了内产物和每个代表物中的欧几里得距离,允许在不任意扭曲其内部几何的情况下进行控制下的特定代表物重新参数化。 随后,通过在下游任务监督下的适应性融合,将转变的特征结合起来。 实验涵盖8个数据集,例如分块、视觉地面、问答和密集字幕。 与PQ3D相比,该型号在ScanNet200上提高了平均精度3.2分,在ScanRefer,Nr3D,Sr3D,和Multi3Drefer上分别提高了2.9,10.6,4.6和4.1分,同时也提高了ScanQA,SQA3D和Scan2Cap上的性能. 配位进一步支持配位和正体再配位的互补作用以及适应融合的有效性.

articles.title: Geospatial embeddings detect old-growth forests but buffered spatial validation narrows their advantage over Sentinel features
articles.content: Old-growth forests develop over centuries under minimal anthropogenic disturbance, producing structurally complex and biodiverse stands. In Europe, protecting them requires mapping that is accurate for individual forest parcels yet deployable continent-wide. Geospatial foundation model (GFM) embeddings enable label-scarce land classification, but their value for old-growth detection remains unknown. Here, we map old-growth forests across 211,893 ha of Romania's Southern Carpathians, a beech-spruce landscape typical of the Alpine Biogeographic Region. We construct high-confidence, expert-informed reference labels for old-growth and non-old-growth parcels. We add AlphaEarth, TESSERA v2 and Sentinel-1/2 features to a common baseline of topographic and human-access predictors, then compare them under spatially blocked validation with and without 10 km train-test buffers to limit residual autocorrelation. With buffering, GFM and Sentinel-1/2 predictors increase precision-recall AUC by 0.21-0.25 [95% CIs: 0.15-0.34] relative to baseline, indicating spectral data contain a spatially robust old-growth signal. With a PR-AUC of 0.84 [0.79-0.88], TESSERA outperforms Sentinel-1/2 (+0.08 [+0.05 to +0.11]) and AlphaEarth (+0.08 [+0.04 to +0.12]) under unbuffered spatial validation. At a 10 km buffer, however, this advantage narrows to +0.04 [-0.01 to +0.11] and +0.03 [-0.04 to +0.10], intervals consistent with no difference. At 10 m resolution, convolutional neural networks add no benefit over pixel-based XGBoost. Comparisons with four national- and continental-scale products show the importance of non-old-growth labels, and reveal 81% agreement between our predictions and a field-calibrated map. We conclude that buffered spatial validation is vital when transferring old-growth detection models to unseen landscapes, and provide our labels and predictions for future work.

articles.title_zh: 地理空间嵌入物探测到老森林,但缓冲空间验证缩小了它们相对于哨兵特征的优势
articles.content_zh: 数百年来,古老的森林在人类活动最小的扰动下发展起来,产生了结构复杂和生物多样化的柱子。 在欧洲,保护森林需要绘制准确的地图,用于整个大陆的单个森林地块。 地理空间基础模型(GFM)嵌入使得标签稀缺的土地分类成为可能,但其对于旧生长探测值仍然未知. 在这里,我们绘制了罗马尼亚南部喀尔巴阡山脉211,893公顷的古老生长森林图,这是阿尔卑斯生物地理区典型的海鸟-斯普鲁斯地貌。 我们为老成长和非老成长的包裹建立了高自信、专家知情的参考标签。 我们把AlphaEarth,TESSERA v2和Sentinel-1/2等特征添加到地形和人类接入预测器的共同基线中,然后在空间屏蔽的验证下将它们与和没有10公里的列车测试缓冲器进行对比,以限制剩余自失能关系. 随着缓冲作用,GFM和Sentinel-1/2预测器将精确召回的AUC比基线增加0.21-0.25[95%的CIs:0.15-0.34],表明光谱数据含有空间坚固的老生长信号. PR-AUC为0.84 [0.79-0.8],TESSERA在无缓冲空间验证下超越哨兵-1/2(+0.08 [+0.05至+0.11])和α地球(+0.08 [+0.04至+0.12]). 然而,在10公里缓冲中,这种优势缩小到+0.04 [-0.01至+0.11]和+0.03 [-0.04至+0.10],间隔不差. 在10m解析度,革命神经网络比基于像素的XGBoost没有任何好处. 与4个国家级和大陆级产品的比较显示非老式生长标签的重要性,并揭示出我们预测和实地校准地图之间81%的一致度. 我们的结论是,在将老的生长探测模型转移到看不见的景观时,缓冲空间验证至关重要,并为今后的工作提供我们的标签和预测。

articles.title: From Change Captions to Change Detection: Semantic-Appearance Agreement Framework for Remote Sensing Change Detection
articles.content: Remote sensing change detection (RSCD) is essential for monitoring land-cover changes and urban development. However, most methods demand pixel-level change masks, which are costly and time-consuming to annotate. Weakly supervised methods reduce this cost by using image-level change labels. Yet these labels indicate only whether a change occurs, leaving models to recover the location of the change and semantic meaning through additional and complex mechanisms. This missing information can be supplied directly by change captions, which describe what changes, what it becomes, and where it occurs. Therefore, we introduce change-caption-guided RSCD, using change captions as the sole task-specific supervision to learn change masks without manually annotated change masks. Our framework has two components: a caption-driven generation pipeline that produces bi-temporal remote sensing image pairs at scale with controlled changes matching each caption, and a change detector guided by the caption's transition semantics. The detector uses our Semantic-Appearance Agreement Framework (SAAF) to combine caption-grounded semantic responses with RGB differences for change localization, while text conditioning guides dense prediction. Experiments on our newly constructed Flair-RSGen dataset and WHU-CDC show that SAAF outperforms the closest reproduced limited-supervision baselines in macro-averaged IoU and F1 under the evaluated protocols. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/qianyuancs/SAAF.

articles.title_zh: 从变化说明到变化探测:遥感变化探测语义-应用协议框架
articles.content_zh: 遥感变化探测对监测土地覆盖的变化和城市发展至关重要。 然而,大多数方法都需要像素级变化口罩,对注释来说,这些口罩既昂贵又费时. 受弱监督的方法通过使用图像级别改变标签来降低这一成本. 然而这些标签仅表明是否发生了变化,留下模型通过额外的复杂机制来恢复变化的位置和语义意义. 这种缺失的信息可以通过更改标题直接提供,这些标题描述什么变化,它变成什么,以及它在哪里发生. 因此,我们采用了变化封装制导的RSCD,使用变化标题作为唯一针对特定任务的监督来学习改变口罩而无需手动附加说明的改变口罩. 我们的框架有两个组成部分:一个由标题驱动的生成管道,在比例上产生双时遥感图像对,其中可控变化与每个标题相匹配;另一个由标题的过渡语义指导的改变探测器。 探测器使用我们的语义-语义协议框架(SAAF),将字幕基于语义的响应与RGB差异结合起来,用于改变本地化,而文本条件则指导密集预测. 对我们新构建的Flair-RSGen数据集和WHU-CDC的实验显示,SAAF在经过评价的协议下,在宏观平均IoU和F1中超过了最接近复制的有限监督基线。 守则可在https://github.com/qianyuancs/SAAF上公开查阅。

articles.title: Two Global Crops Suffice: Locating Semantic Emergence in DINO-Style Self-Supervised Learning
articles.content: Self-supervised vision transformers trained with DINO-style objectives exhibit striking emergent semantic representation quality across visual tasks, yet the mechanisms underlying this behavior remain unclear. We present a systematic empirical dissection of the DINO family and show that semantic representations arise primarily from enforcing consistency between geometrically distinct global views of the same image instance. This instance-specific global alignment acts as the semantic anchor of DINO-style learning. Across controlled retraining experiments evaluated on semantic correspondence and a diverse suite of 2D and 3D downstream tasks, we find that patch-level masking objectives enhance semantics only when trained jointly with this global alignment, indicating that the iBOT objective refines and densifies existing semantic structure rather than creating it independently. In contrast, local-to-global view alignment does not substantially improve semantic qualities at fixed compute beyond a purely global alignment. Beyond training design, we revisit how semantic representation quality should be evaluated: while classification accuracy is the standard validation score, semantic correspondence provides a complementary axis that more reliably predicts downstream task performance. Together, these findings provide a functional decomposition of DINO-style learning and represent an important step toward understanding how semantic representations emerge in self-supervised vision models.

articles.title_zh: 两个全球作物充足:DINO-Style自导自演的学习中定位语义的出现
articles.content_zh: 接受过DINO式目标培训的自我监督的视觉变压器在视觉任务中表现出惊人的新兴语义表现品质,然而这种行为背后的机制仍然不清楚. 我们提出了DINO家族的系统的经验解析,并表明语义表述主要产生于对同一图像实例的几何特征不同的全球观点之间的一致性。 这种针对具体案例的全球校正,是DINO式学习的语义主干. 在语义函授和多种2D和3D下游任务评价的受控再培训实验中,我们发现,补丁水平的遮盖目标只有在与这种全球对接联合训练时才能增强语义,这表明iBOT目标完善并去化了现有的语义结构,而不是独立创建. 相比之下,地方与全球观点的相接并没有大大地提高固定计算时的语义素质,超出了纯粹的全球相接。 除了培训设计外,我们重新审视应如何评价语义表达质量:虽然分类精度是标准验证分数,但语义对应提供了一个补充轴,能更可靠地预测下游的任务性能. 这些调查结果共同为DINO式的学习提供了功能分解,是了解自我监督的视觉模型中如何出现语义表现的一个重要步骤。

articles.title: VLMs Can Describe, But Not Measure: Object-Centric Scene Understanding for Robotic Manipulation
articles.content: Robotic operation in previously unseen environments requires both semantic understanding and reliable metric information. While vision--language models (VLMs) provide strong semantic capabilities, their geometric estimates remain less reliable. In this paper, we propose a VLM-driven, modular perception framework for scene understanding using off-the-shelf approaches. Starting from a single RGB-D observation, the scene is segmented into object-level regions, annotated by a VLM, and grounded with depth information to construct a task-independent object-centric representation. Experiments on 151 tabletop scenes show that the proposed decomposition preserves strong semantic performance while substantially improving localization and depth estimation over direct VLM inference. The resulting representation is also integrated with a task-planning framework for robotic execution.

articles.title_zh: VLMs 可以描述,但不是度量:机器人操纵对象-场景理解
articles.content_zh: 机器人在先前所未见的环境下的操作,既需要语义的理解,也需要可靠的量子信息. 虽然视觉-语言模型(VLMs)提供了很强的语义能力,但其几何估计仍然不太可靠. 在本文中,我们提出一个由VLM驱动,模块化的感知框架,用于采用现成的方法进行场景理解. 从一个单一的RGB-D观测开始,场景被分割成对象级区域,由VLM作注释,并基于深度信息来构建一个任务独立的以对象为中心的代表. 对151个平面场景的实验显示,拟议的分解保留了强烈的语义性能,同时比直接的VLM推论大大改进了局部化和深度估计. 由此产生的代表性还与机器人执行的任务规划框架相融合。

articles.title: From ECG Signals to Representative-Morphology Heatmaps for Biometric Recognition
articles.content: Electrocardiography (ECG) contains subject-specific morphology that supports biometric recognition, yet image-based performance depends on how the waveform is rendered. We introduce representative-morphology heatmaps, a deterministic ECG-to-image representation adapted from ECGXtractor. Within each block of ten aligned beats, the five beats closest to the block mean are averaged into a 400 by L matrix and rendered either as a conventional trace or as a dense cardiac-time-by-lead heatmap. Since both representations contain identical physiological samples, their comparison isolates the effect of rendering. We evaluate verification and closed-set identification on PTB, ECG-ID, and MIMIC-IV-ECG-DEMO. Five compact models, including ZACH-ViT, are trained from scratch, while six ImageNet-pretrained CNN and transformer backbones assess model scale and visual transfer. Heatmaps improve both FNMR operating points and both identification ranks in all 15 compact model-dataset comparisons, while EER improves in 14. Across the matched experiments, EER decreases by 9.59 percentage points and Rank-1 increases by 24.69 points on average. ConvNeXt-Tiny reaches 2.43% EER on PTB and 5.79% on ECG-ID, whereas DeiT-Base reaches 14.92% on MIMIC-DEMO. ImageNet initialization clearly benefits the two multilead datasets but has a mixed effect on ECG-ID, and performance does not increase monotonically with model size. The best heatmap systems approach the strongest signal-domain EER on PTB and ECG-ID, while DeiT-Base provides the strongest evaluated performance on MIMIC-DEMO. Lead-channel ablation further shows that useful channel combinations depend on the cohort and biometric task. Overall, representative-morphology heatmaps provide an effective image representation for ECG verification and identification.

articles.title_zh: 从ECG信号到生物计量识别的代表性-肿瘤热图
articles.content_zh: 电心学(ECG)包含支持生物鉴别的特有主题形态学,而以图像为基础的性能则取决于波形是如何得到的. 我们引入了具有代表性的形态热图,一种由ECGXtractor改编的确定性ECG-to-image代表. 在每块10个对齐的节拍中,最接近区块平均值的5个节拍被L矩阵平均变成400个,或者作为常规的跟踪,或者作为密集的心动时间逐一加热图得到. 由于这两种表述都包含相同的生理样本,因此它们的比较隔离了渲染的效果. 我们评价关于PTB、ECG-ID和MIMIC-IV-ECG-DEMO的核查和封闭式识别。 包括ZACH-ViT在内的5个紧凑型号从零开始训练,而6个被ImageNet预先训练的CNN和变压器主干线则评估模型规模和可视化传输. 在全部15个紧凑的模型-数据集比较中,热图改进了FNMR操作点和两个识别分级,而EER则改进了14个. 在整个配套试验中,平均平均平均平均平均平均平均ER下降了9.59个百分点,而Rank-1平均增长了24.69个百分点。 ConvNEXt-Tiny在PTB上达到2.43%的EER和在ECG-ID上达到5.79%,而Deit-Base在MIMIC-DEMO上达到14.92%. ImageNet初始化显然使两个多铅数据集受益,但对ECG-ID有好坏参半的影响,性能不会单调地与模型大小相提并论. 最好的热映射系统接近PTB和ECG-ID上最强的信号域EER,而Deit-Base则在MIMIC-DEMO上提供最强的评价性能. 铅道减压进一步表明,有用的道道结合取决于组群和生物鉴别任务。 总体而言,代表性-形态热图为ECG验证和识别提供了有效的图像表现.

articles.title: Depth-Guided Contrastive Learning for 2D Representations with 3D Spatial Awareness
articles.content: Standard contrastive learning frameworks are mainly designed from a semantic perspective, yet learning 2D visual representations that preserve 3D spatial structure is also important for scene understanding. In this work, we propose Depth-Guided Contrastive Learning (DGCL), a simple auxiliary objective that injects 3D spatial awareness into 2D contrastive representation learning. Our key idea is to use depth to convert local 3D proximity into contrastive similarity: pixels that are closer in 3D space are encouraged to have more similar representations than pixels that are farther apart. Instead of relying on absolute depth values, DGCL formulates supervision through relative 3D distance comparisons among randomly sampled pixels, making the objective invariant to depth scale, efficient to compute, and easy to integrate into existing contrastive frameworks. Experiments across different datasets and models show that DGCL consistently improves 2D representation learning and benefits semantic downstream tasks by stronger spatial and geometric understanding. The code is available on https://github.com/LeungTsang/DGCL.

articles.title_zh: 2D 表现和3D 空间意识的深度指导对比学习
articles.content_zh: 标准对比性学习框架主要从语义角度来设计,然而学习保留了3D空间结构的2D视觉表现对于场景理解也很重要. 在这项工作中,我们提出"深度指导对比性学习"(DGCL),这是一个简单的辅助目标,将3D空间意识注入了2D对比性表达性学习中. 我们的关键想法是使用深度将本地的3D相近性转换为相近相近性:鼓励在3D空间更相近的像素具有比相距更相近的像素更相近的表示. DGCL不依赖绝对深度值,而是通过随机抽样像素的相对3D距离比较来制定监督,使目标变异到深度尺度,计算效率高,容易被整合到现有的对比框架. 跨越不同数据集和模型的实验表明,DGCL通过更强的空间和几何理解,持续地改进了2D表达式学习并有利于下游的语义任务. 该代码可在https://github.com/LeungTsang/DGCL上查阅.

articles.title: A comparative assessment of global building and settlement datasets across geographic and settlement contexts
articles.content: Global building and settlement datasets increasingly support population mapping, exposure assessment, urban monitoring, and other analyses of the built environment, yet comparative evidence remains fragmented across products, geographic regions, reference datasets, spatial scales, and evaluation methods. We benchmark seven global or near-global products, including Overture Maps, Global Building Atlas, 3D-GloBFP, Google Open Buildings 2.5D Temporal (OBT), Microsoft TEMPO, GHSL, and WSF Tracker, against harmonized reference footprints across 135 study areas. The evaluation combines complementary measures of detection, geometric agreement, and aggregate quantity accuracy, together with stratified analyses of settlement characteristics and diagnostic experiments on error size and temporal alignment. Overture achieved the highest median city-level vector F1 (0.786). Raster rankings were resolution-dependent: OBT achieved the highest median F1 at 10m (0.642), whereas WSF Tracker led at 100m (0.862). However, WSF Tracker substantially overestimated built-up area, emphasizing that when using raster products, it is important for the user to understand whether the raster identifies only buildings or includes additional impervious surfaces. Raster accuracy increased consistently with building density (Spearman \r{ho} = 0.58-0.75), while small candidate buildings were disproportionately associated with false positives in the vector products. Temporally aligning WSF Tracker with reference imagery increased mean F1 by 0.060 (median +0.037), indicating that the reported accuracies are conservative in rapidly growing areas. The study establishes a reproducible benchmark for comparing heterogeneous global urban and settlement layer datasets across geographic and settlement contexts.

articles.title_zh: 对照地理和住区情况对全球建筑和定居点数据集进行比较评估
articles.content_zh: 全球建筑和住区数据集日益支持人口测绘、接触评估、城市监测以及对已建成环境的其他分析,但比较证据在产品、地理区域、参考数据集、空间尺度和评价方法方面仍然支离破碎。 我们以135个研究领域的统一参考足迹为基准,衡量7个全球或近全球产品,包括Overture Maps、Global Building Atlas、3D-GloBFP、Google Open Building 2.5D Timperal(OBT)、Microsoft TEMPO、GHSL和WSF Tracker。 评价结合了检测、几何协议和总量准确性等补充措施,以及对结算特征的分层分析和关于误差大小和时间相接的诊断实验。 overture实现了城市一级最高中位矢量F1(0.786). 拉斯特排名依赖分辨率:OBT在10米(0.642)时实现了最高中位数F1,而WSF Tracker则领先于100米(0.862). 然而,无国界医生组织 跟踪器大大高估了已建成区,强调在使用光栅产品时,用户必须了解光栅是只识别出建筑物,还是包含额外的不透水面. raster精度随着建筑密度的不断提高(Spearman\r{ho}=0.58-0.75),而小候选建筑则不成比例地与矢量产品中的假阳性有关. 暂时将WSF跟踪仪与参考图像相匹配,平均F1增加了0.060 (中位数+0.037),表明所报道的速成区在快速增长地区是保守的. 该研究确立了一个可复制的基准,用于比较不同地理和住区的全球城市和住区层数据集。

articles.title: Field-of-View Extension in Dental Cone-Beam CT via Implicit Neural Representations and Diffusion Model-Based Refinement
articles.content: Dental cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) systems often employ detector configurations that provide a truncated field of view (FOV) that only captures a small part of the patient's anatomy. In this work, we aim to reconstruct an extended FOV using projections of truncated FOV scans. To this end, we propose a three-stage framework that consists of (1) an implicit neural representation (INR) for estimating missing parts of the truncated projection data, (2) an iterative reconstruction for generating a secondary volumetric image with improved anatomical consistency and (3) a fast diffusion model for image enhancement. The proposed approach combines the strengths of continuous representations, physics-based reconstruction and generative refinement within a unified pipeline for truncated CBCT imaging. Experimental results demonstrate that the method effectively reduces truncation artifacts, improves the reconstruction of structures extending beyond the original FOV and produces images with enhanced quality. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/SusanneSchaub/CBCT-FOV-Extension.

articles.title_zh: 通过隐形神经表达和分泌模型在牙科 Cone-Beam CT的视场扩展
articles.content_zh: 牙科圆锥束计算成型成像(CBCT)系统经常采用能提供短视场(FOV)的探测器配置,只能捕捉到患者的一小部分解剖. 在这项工作中,我们的目标是利用短程FOV扫描的预测重建一个扩展的FOV. 为此,我们提出由以下三个阶段构成的框架:(1) 用于估计短线投影数据缺失部分的隐性神经表达(INR),(2) 用于生成二次体积成像并改进解剖一致性的迭代重建,(3) 用于图像增强的快速传播模型. 拟议方法结合了连续表达、以物理为基础的重建和基因改良等优势,在中断CBCT成像的统一管道内进行。 实验结果显示,该方法能有效减少分流文物,改善结构的重建,超越了原来的FOV,并产生了质量更高的图像. 我们的代码可在https://github.com/SusanneSchaub/CBCT-FOV-Extension上公开查阅。

articles.title: Visual Tripwires: Anticipating Failure in Deep Vision Systems
articles.content: Deep vision systems remain vulnerable to corruption, occlusion, and distribution shift despite strong benchmark performance. Existing reliability methods typically evaluate uncertainty at individual time steps and do not explicitly model how a system progresses toward failure. We introduce Visual Tripwires, a predictive reliability framework that uses temporal instability in model behaviour to anticipate impending failure. Our central hypothesis is that predictive degradation develops progressively through measurable changes in latent representations, prediction trajectories, and attention structure. Visual Tripwires captures these changes using representation drift, prediction oscillation, trajectory curvature, and attention entropy. A lightweight tripwire predictor aggregates these signals over a temporal window to estimate the probability of failure within a future prediction horizon. Experiments across multiple datasets, architectures, and progressive perturbation settings show that the proposed instability signals emerge before predictive degradation and provide earlier and more accurate failure warnings than conventional uncertainty estimation methods. These results demonstrate that temporal instability contains useful information about future model reliability and provides a practical basis for early warning in deep vision systems.

articles.title_zh: 视觉三线:深视系统预期失败
articles.content_zh: 尽管基准业绩良好,但深层次的愿景系统仍然容易受到腐败、排斥和分配转移的影响。 现有的可靠性方法通常在单个时间阶段评估不确定性,而没有明确模拟系统如何走向失败。 我们引入了Visual Tripwires,一种预测可靠性的框架,它利用模型行为中的时间不稳定性来预测即将发生的故障. 我们的中心假设是,预测性退化通过潜在表现、预测轨迹和注意力结构的可衡量变化而逐步发展。 视觉Tripwires利用表现漂移,预测振荡,轨迹曲率,和注意力 en来捕捉这些变化. 轻量级的绊线预测器通过时间窗口来汇总这些信号,以估计未来预测地平线内发生故障的概率. 跨越多套数据集,架构,和渐进扰动设置的实验显示,所拟议的不稳定信号在预测退化之前出现,比常规的不确定性估计方法提供更早和更准确的故障警告. 这些结果表明,时间不稳定含有关于未来模型可靠性的有用信息,并为深视系统预警提供了实际依据。

articles.title: MotionSpec: Spectral Trajectory Supervision for Motion-Consistent Video Generation
articles.content: Recent advances in text-to-video generation have enabled high-fidelity visual synthesis, yet realistic motion remains challenging. Generated videos may exhibit temporal discontinuities, inconsistent action progression, and structural distortions during complex movements. Even when individual frames appear realistic, the underlying motion may evolve in inconsistent or implausible ways. Standard generative objectives provide limited motion-specific supervision, leaving motion evolution insufficiently constrained. In this paper, we propose MotionSpec, a motion supervision framework centered on Spectral Trajectory Consistency (STC). STC constructs dense anchor-relative motion trajectories and transforms them into motion spectral volumes via a temporal Fourier transform. By aligning the spectral amplitude and phase of predicted and target trajectories, STC constrains both motion strength across temporal frequencies and the temporal organization of motion. To complement this trajectory-level supervision, we introduce Local Flow Consistency (LFC), which aligns consecutive-frame optical flow between predicted and target videos to stabilize local motion transitions. Experiments demonstrate that MotionSpec consistently improves motion consistency, temporal coherence, and plausibility while preserving visual fidelity.

articles.title_zh: MotionSpec: 运动-持续视频生成的光谱轨迹监督
articles.content_zh: 文本到视频生成的最新进展使得能进行高真实度的视觉合成,但现实运动仍然具有挑战性. 生成的视频可能显示时间不连续,动作进度不一致,在复杂的运动过程中结构扭曲. 即使单个框架看起来是现实的,其基础运动也可能以不一致或难以置信的方式演变. 标准基因目标提供了有限的运动特定监督,使得运动进化不够受限. 在本文中,我们提出MotionSpec,一个以光谱轨迹一致性(STC)为中心的运动监督框架. STC构造了密集的锚相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 通过将预测和目标轨迹的光谱振幅和相位相对齐,STC既会限制跨时间频率的运动强度,也会限制运动的时间组织. 为了补充这种轨迹层面的监督,我们引入了"局部流相一致性"(LFC),它将预测与目标视频之间的相接帧光学流相协调,以稳定局部运动过渡. 实验表明,MotionSpec在保持视觉忠诚的同时,一贯地提高运动一致性,时间一致性和可信度.

articles.title: LAYERSCOPE: A Layerwise Characterization of Video and Multimodal Learned Representations
articles.content: We propose LAYERSCOPE, a label-free, layerwise framework that aims to characterize a model's learned representations in video and multimodal settings. Evaluating downstream performance using representations from final or intermediate layers typically requires large amounts of labeled data, repeated task-specific evaluations, and substantial computation. To address these limitations, LAYERSCOPE uses local, global, distributional, and correspondence-based geometric metrics to compare layerwise representation structure within and across models without requiring task-specific labels. We evaluate seven architecturally diverse models across video and multimodal classification, clustering, and text-to-video retrieval tasks from MVEB/MVEB+. We find that intermediate-layer representations can outperform final-layer and model-default outputs. We also find that no single geometric metric consistently predicts downstream performance, but note that distinct layerwise geometric signatures emerge across model families. LID shows task-dependent relationships with performance, while RankMe provides the strongest measure for classification and clustering, but is not a universal layer selector. We also find that pairing-aware metrics explain retrieval better than distributional distances alone. LAYERSCOPE therefore offers a framework for comparing representations across models and layers, enabling a more systematic evaluation in video and multimodal settings.

articles.title_zh: LAYERSCOPE: 视频和多式联运代表的分层特征
articles.content_zh: 我们提议使用LAYERSCOPE,这是一个无标签的分层框架,旨在描述一个模型在视频和多模式环境中学到的表述。 利用最终或中间层的表述来评价下游的业绩,通常需要大量贴有标签的数据、重复进行具体任务的评价和大量的计算。 为了克服这些局限性,LAYERSCOPE使用本地的,全球的,分布的,以及基于函证的几何度量衡来比较模型内部和模型之间的分层表示结构,而不需要特定任务的标签. 我们从MVEB/MVEB+中评估了七种不同结构的模型,包括视频和多模式分类、集群以及文本到视频的检索任务。 我们发现,中间层的表示可以超过最终层和模型-默认输出。 我们还发现,没有一个单一的几何测量标准能够一致地预测下游的性能,但请注意,不同的分层几何特征出现在模型家族中。 LID显示任务依赖关系与性能的关系,而RankMe为分类和集群提供了最强的度量,但不是通用的地层选择器. 我们还发现,配对认识的衡量标准比单是分布距离更能解释检索。 因此,LAYERSCOPE提供了一个框架,可以比较不同模型和层次的表述,从而能够在视频和多模式环境中进行更系统的评价。

articles.title: ZoomDiff: A High-Fidelity Diffusion Model for Dual-Camera Smooth Zooming
articles.content: Digital zoom transitions between dual cameras often exhibit conspicuous discontinuities in geometric structure and chromatic consistency, degrading the user experience. While recent dual-camera smooth zoom (DCSZ) methods attempt to mitigate this by fine-tuning frame interpolation (FI) models on DCSZ data, they struggle with the large cross-view disparities and complex geometric transformations. Considering that the generative prior of diffusion models is suitable for addressing this problem, we explore their application to DCSZ. However, naively applying existing diffusion-based FI models still yields low-fidelity transitions due to insufficient conditional guidance, high-frequency information loss during VAE encoding, as well as inadequate temporal consistency. To address this, we propose ZoomDiff, a high-fidelity diffusion model that leverages dual-camera inputs in both latent and pixel spaces for photo-realistic transitions. Specifically, we first strengthen dual-image conditional guidance during the multi-step denoising process to improve geometric consistency. Then we inject flow-aligned multi-scale features from the VAE encoder into the VAE decoder to recover high-frequency details, where flow-guided temporal consistency supervision are introduced to produce more smooth transitions. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that ZoomDiff outperforms state-of-the-art methods quantitatively and qualitatively. Project page: https://jiayi-hit.github.io/ZoomDiff.github.io/.

articles.title_zh: 缩放Diff:用于双卡美拉平滑缩放的高密分化模型
articles.content_zh: 双重相机之间的数字缩放过渡往往在几何结构和色相一致性方面显示出明显的不连续性,从而降低了用户的经验。 虽然最近的双相机平滑缩放(DCSZ)方法试图通过在DCSZ数据上微调帧内插(FI)模型来缓解这种情况,但它们却与巨大的交叉视差和复杂的几何变换相相挣扎. 考虑到传播模式之前的遗传性适用于解决这一问题,我们探索将其应用于DCSZ。 然而,天真地应用了现有的以扩散为基础的FI模型,由于条件引导不足,在VAE编码过程中出现高频信息丢失,以及时间一致性不足等原因,仍然产生出低可靠性的过渡. 为了解决这个问题,我们提出ZoomDiff,一种高可靠性的传播模型,利用双相机在潜在和像素空间中的输入,进行相片现实化的过渡。 具体地说,我们首先在多步骤去诺化过程中加强双象条件指导,以提高几何一致性. 然后从VAE编码器中将流量相通多尺度特性注入到VAE解码器中以回收高频细节,其中引入了流导时间一致性监督来产生更平稳的过渡. 对合成和现实世界数据集的广泛实验表明,ZoomDiff在数量和质量上都超过了最新方法。 项目网页:https://jiayi-hit.github.io/ZoomDiff.github.io/.

articles.title: Recursive Uncertainty-Gated Image Registration for Learning-based Algorithms
articles.content: Conventional image registration algorithms are robust to domain shifts and achieve low errors, but they are slow and computationally expensive. Deep-learning methods are efficient at inference-time, but face challenges in out-of-domain samples. We propose Recursive Uncertainty-Gated Image Registration (RUGI), an algorithm for iteratively refining deformation fields predicted by learning-based registration models. At each iteration, the registration model predicts an incremental deformation, and a gating map modulates the update. Refinements are hence concentrated in regions that remain difficult to register. We explore two gating strategies: a learned uncertainty-based approach and an image residual error approach. We evaluate RUGI on cardiac MRI and echocardiography datasets and show consistent improvements over single-step inference. Ablation experiments demonstrate that iterative refinement alone improves registration, but informative spatial gating provides a significant additional benefit. The error-gated variant of RUGI can also be applied directly to existing pretrained models; applied to VoxelMorph, TransMorph, and CycleMorph, it yields MSE reductions of 27-37% with no modification to the original training procedure. The improvements in registration performance are reflected in decreased errors in ejection fraction estimation relative to ground truths. These results demonstrate that spatially selective iterative refinement provides an effective strategy to improve registration accuracy at inference-time.
