articles.title_zh: 基于学习算法的递归式不确定图像注册
articles.content_zh: 常规图像注册算法对于域位移并实现低出错是强而有力的,但它们缓慢并计算成本. 深入学习的方法在推论时间是有效的,但在域外样本中却面临挑战. 我们提出递归不确定的图像登记法(RUGI),这是一种通过以学习为基础的登记模型预测的迭代精炼变形场的算法. 在每次迭代时,登记模型都预测出增量变形,并有地标地图来调节更新. 因此,改进工作集中在仍然难以登记的地区。 我们探索了两种取景策略:一种基于不确定性的学习方法,另一种是图像残余误差方法. 我们评价RUGI的心脏核磁共振和回声心电学数据集,并显示与单步推论相比的一致改进. 通缩实验表明,单是迭接改进就可以改善登记,但信息化的空间定位提供了重要的额外好处。 RUGI的误差变体也可以被直接应用到现有的被预先训练的模型上;被应用到VoxelMorph,TransMorph,和CycleMorph中,它得到的MSE还原率为27-37%,而原来的训练程序没有被修改. 与地面真相相比,弹出分数估计误差减少,反映出登记业绩的改善。 这些结果表明,空间选择性迭接改进为提高推断时的登记准确性提供了有效战略。

articles.title: LiAM-SAM: Lifecycle-Aware Memory for Robust SAM2-Based MOT
articles.content: Segmentation-based multi-object tracking (MOT) with foundation video models such as SAM2 offers strong localization quality, yet remains fragile in crowded, real-world scenes. In detector-prompted SAM2 pipelines, failures typically arise at three stages of the object lifecycle: (i) erroneous or duplicate track initiation, (ii) memory drift during close interactions, and (iii) unreliable re-identification after long occlusions or re-entry. These errors corrupt object memory and accumulate over time, making long-horizon tracking unstable. In this paper, we reframe MOT as a lifecycle memory integrity problem. We present LiAM-SAM, a Lifecycle-Aware Memory (LiAM) framework with targeted mechanisms for each of the three failure modes. At track birth, to prevent faulty or duplicate initiations, we apply contrastive track initiation, which conditions each prompt on existing nearby tracked instances. To preserve memory integrity during strong interactions, we introduce motion- and geometry-grounded memory correction that resolves interaction confusions and suppresses drift. For reliable re-identification after disappearance, we maintain an adaptive context memory that promotes diverse and trustworthy references as long-term identity anchors. Finally, similarity aware spatial pruning optionally selects the memory tokens to retain at cross-attention time, improving efficiency with minimal accuracy loss. LiAM-SAM represents a modular, detector-agnostic, SAM2-based MOT system that achieves state-of-the-art HOTA and IDF1 on the evaluated benchmarks. In association-challenging environments, our ablations show that LiAM improves a detector+SAM2 baseline by +10.5 HOTA, +17.4 AssA, and reduces identity switches by 96%.

articles.title_zh: LiAM-SAM:强力SAM2-基于MOT的生命周期-智能内存
articles.content_zh: 基于分块的多物体跟踪(MOT),并带有SAM2等基础视频模型,提供了很强的本地化质量,然而在拥挤的,现实世界的场景中仍然脆弱. 在被探测器催化的SAM2管道中,通常在物体生命周期的三个阶段出现故障: (一)错误或重复的轨道启动, (二)近距离相互作用过程中的内存漂移, (三)长期被隔离或再入后不可靠的重新识别. 这些错误会腐蚀对象记忆并随着时间的推移而积累,使长视距跟踪变得不稳定. 在本文中,我们把MOT重新设定为生命周期记忆完整性问题. 我们提出LiAM-SAM,这是一个生命周期-智能记忆(LiAM)框架,对三种失败模式的每一种都有目标机制. 在轨道诞生时,为了防止错误或重复的启动,我们采用对比式的轨道启动方式,这为每个轨道启动方式都提供了条件,以现有的跟踪实例为依据。 为了在强相互作用时保持记忆的完整性,我们引入了运动和几何定位的记忆校正,解决了相互作用的混乱并抑制了漂移. 为了在失踪后可靠地重新识别,我们保持一种适应性的背景记忆,促进作为长期身份锚点的多样化和可信赖的参考。 最后,相似性感知空间穿行可选择选择在交叉注意时间保留所保留的内存符号,以最小的精度损失来提高效率. LiAM-SAM代表一个模块化的,可探测的,基于SAM2的MOT系统,在评估的基准上实现最先进的HOTA和FID1. 在联想挑战环境下,我们的模拟显示,LiAM将探测器+SAM2基线改进为+10.5 HOTA,+17.4 AssA,将身份开关减少96%.

articles.title: TEEP-RCNN: Texture-Enhanced Edge-aware Perception for Steel Surface Defect Detection via Improved Convolutional Block Attention in Faster R-CNN
articles.content: Steel surface defect detection is critical for automated industrial quality control but remains challenging due to subtle inter-class texture differences and pronounced class imbalance. We introduce TEEP-RCNN (Texture-Enhanced Edge-aware Perception Region-based CNN), a two-stage detector built on Faster R-CNN with a Feature Pyramid Network backbone and an improved Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM). Our CBAM adds dropout regularization in the channel attention MLP and batch normalization on the spatial attention branch, reducing co-adaptation and stabilizing gating logits. Training uses a differential learning rate protocol with cosine annealing warm-up, separating update rates for the pre-trained ResNet-101 backbone and the detection head. At inference, predictions are refined via Test-Time Augmentation fused with Weighted Box Fusion (WBF), improving localization stability on elongated and boundary-adjacent defects. On the NEU-DET benchmark across six defect categories, TEEP-RCNN achieves 73.3\% mAP@50 and 37.9\% mAP@50-95 in only 10 training epochs on a single GPU, competitive with YOLOv11m (76.2\% mAP@50, 100 epochs) while outperforming it on the rolled-in-scale category under the COCO metric. Per-class analysis shows the spatial attention branch is most effective on elongated texture defects such as patches and scratches, while crazing remains an open challenge across both paradigms due to its distributed non-local texture structure.

articles.title_zh: TEEP-RCNN:通过改良的CIE-CIE-CIE来检测钢质表面缺陷的纹理增强边缘感知器
articles.content_zh: 钢质表面缺陷检测对工业自动化质量控制至关重要,但由于细微的阶级间纹理差异和明显的阶级不平衡,检测工作仍然具有挑战性. 我们引进了TEEP-RCNN(Texture-Ennd-Andge-aware Perception Region),这是以更快的R-CNN为基础的两相探测器,并配有地心金字塔网络主干线和经过改进的CBAM(CBAM). 我们的CBAM在频道注意力MLP和空间注意力分支的分批正常化中增加了退学规范,减少了协同适应并稳定了吉卜赛对数. 训练使用有余弦取暖的差分学习速率协议,将预训的ResNet-101主干线和检测头的更新速率分开. 推断出,通过试验-时间增强与加权箱融合(WBF)结合,对预测进行了精炼,在较长和相接边界的缺陷上提高了本地化稳定性. 在NEEU-DET基准中,TEEE-RCNN在一个单一的GPU上只完成了10个培训时段的73.3\% mAP@50和37.9\% mAP@50-95,与YOLOv11m(76.2\% mAP@50,100个时段)竞争,同时在COCO度量下在滚动比例类别上表现优于. 每类分析显示,空间关注分支在诸如补丁和刮痕等长纹缺陷上最为有效,而克夷则因其分布的非局部纹理结构而仍然是贯穿于两个范式的公开挑战.

articles.title: AstraLOD3: Zero-shot multimodal agentic reconstruction of LOD3 building models
articles.content: Automated LOD3 building modeling typically relies on purpose-built geometric or learning-based pipelines, limiting flexibility across heterogeneous buildings and input evidence conditions. This study investigates whether Astra, a general-purpose multimodal foundation model, can address these limitations through zero-shot reconstruction of LOD3 building models within an agentic framework under bounded autonomy. AstraLOD3 combines multi-view images, calibrated cameras, and a filtered sparse SfM point cloud with a natural-language reconstruction specification, while the Astra agent dynamically selects and executes computational procedures using Python and Blender. Across 35 runs, including 24 benchmark buildings, AstraLOD3 achieved a mean FRDS of 0.9647 and geometric agreement comparable to that of previous purpose-built methods. Controlled ablations further revealed the effects of reconstruction guidance, evidence modalities, model configuration, and run-to-run variability. The results demonstrate that structured LOD3 reconstruction can be formulated as a constrained agentic process rather than as a fixed pipeline. Future work will investigate adaptive refinement, user-guided correction, task-specific specialization, and damage-aware reconstruction.

articles.title_zh: AstraLOD3: LOD3 建筑模型的零镜头多式代理重建
articles.content_zh: 自动LOD3大楼建模一般依靠专用几何或以学习为基础的管道,限制了不同建筑物的灵活性和输入证据条件。 本研究调查了作为通用多式地基模型的Astra能否通过在受限自主的代理框架内零发重建LOD3建筑模型来克服这些局限性. 阿斯特拉语Name LOD3结合了多视图图像,校正相机,以及被过滤出稀疏的SfM点云和自然语言重建规格,而Astra代理则用Python和Blender来动态地选择和执行计算程序. AstraLOD3在包括24个基准建筑物在内的35个作业中,实现了平均0.9647美元的FRDS和与以前专用方法相仿的几何协定。 所控制的浮出水面进一步揭示了重建指导、证据模式、模型配置和运行中的可变性的影响。 结果表明,结构化的LOD3重建可以作为受制约的代理过程而非固定管道进行。 今后的工作将调查适应性改进、用户指导的校正、具体任务的专门化和损害意识重建。

articles.title: Prompt, Probe, Train, or Annotate? Single-camera sports video understanding in amateur settings
articles.content: Video understanding is usually benchmarked on curated, single-actor, or professionally filmed clips, and a strong score there is routinely read as evidence a model is robust enough for deployment. Amateur team sport is a useful, largely untested place to check that assumption: over eight million students played a school sport in the United States in 2024-25 alone, almost none of it filmed by more than a single fixed camera, with several candidate actors crowded into frame and no operator or second angle to fall back on. Using volleyball as a test case, we ask whether strong performance on general video and world-model benchmarks translates into reliable, per-player attribution once footage is this chaotic, turning footage into statistics through a chain of tasks from finding play boundaries to naming who did what. We evaluate four approaches (prompting and agentic reasoning over frontier vision-language models, classical computer vision with small trained specialists, self-supervised video world models, and manual annotation) at every stage, on 66 amateur matches with 46,648 human-labelled contacts, filmed under conditions no published benchmark uses. No single paradigm wins every stage, and static, single-frame computer vision is not competitive at any stage involving motion or identity. A prompted model segments matches well, yet a far smaller trained model beats it at spotting contacts for a fraction of the cost, and the sport's own rules recover rally outcomes the pixels cannot. Identity is where every automated approach struggles: a jersey number is a static fact temporal reasoning cannot recover if never visible, unlike sporting action, a repeated motor pattern a temporal model can exploit, which is why holistic reasoning improves event detection while identity stays unchanged. We close with where each approach earns its cost, and what transfers beyond volleyball to amateur sport.

articles.title_zh: 即时、探测、火车还是注释? 业余环境下的单相机体育视频理解
articles.content_zh: 视频理解通常以配音、单演员或专业拍摄的片段作为基准,而且经常读取一个强分作为证据,一个模型足够强大,可以部署。 业余团队运动是一个有用的,基本上未经测试的地方来检查这一假设:仅2024-25年,就有800多万学生在美国打过校园运动,几乎没有一个学生用一个以上的固定相机拍摄,几个候选演员挤入了帧中,没有操作员或第二个角度可以倒地. 我们用排球作为测试案例, 我们问在一般视频和世界模型基准上的强效表现 是否转化为可靠的, 玩家的归属一旦是这个混乱的镜头, 通过一系列任务把镜头变成统计, 从寻找游戏边界到命名谁做了什么。 我们在每个阶段都对66个业余比赛和46 648个贴有人类标签的接触进行评分(在没有公布基准使用的情况下拍摄),评估四种方法(边疆视觉语言模型的速率和代理推理、有受过训练的小型专家的古典计算机视觉、自我监督的视频世界模型和人工注释)。 没有一个单一的范式能赢得每个阶段,静态的,单帧的计算机视觉在涉及运动或身份的任何阶段都没有竞争力. 一个被激发的模型部分匹配得很好, 然而一个更小的训练有素的模型在发现接触点时比它高一分钱, 身份是每个自动化方法挣扎的地方:球衣号码是静态的事实时间推理,如果永远不可见的话就无法恢复,与体育动作不同,重复的运动模式是时间模型可以被利用的,这就是为什么整体推理在身份不变的情况下改善事件探测. 我们接近每个方法的成本所在,以及排球以外的运动转移到业余运动。

articles.title: Task-Induced Riemannian Metrics for Vision Transformer Feature Spaces
articles.content: Methods operating on Vision Transformer (ViT) feature spaces typically rely on Euclidean distance or cosine similarity. This assumes that every direction is equally meaningful, but there is no reason to believe the true task geometry has this property. The task-sensitive geometry of the feature space is given by the pullback metric $g(F) = J(F)^\top J(F)$, where $J$ is the Jacobian of the decoder's output fed to a task-specific distance, with respect to the features. Storing the full $g$ is infeasible at modern scales, and for dense outputs such as depth maps even forming $J$ is impractical. We show that whether a low-rank approximation of this metric can be learned depends on the model-decoder pair, and we characterize this with a matrix-free diagnostic $κ_{cap}(r)$ computable with a low number of Jacobian-vector products. For tractable pairs, we develop the Spectral Pullback Network (SPN), which learns a low-rank version of the metric from randomized power iteration, and we distill it into a $310$K-parameter importance head that predicts token importance directly from the features. When the Jacobian spectrum is too spread out for a low-rank approximation, passing the decoder's input features through a VAE bottleneck can restore tractability. Across DPT, DINOv2, CLIP, and VGGT backbones, $κ_{cap}(r)$ predicts which learned-metric architectures are viable. The importance head reaches Spearman $ρ= 0.998$ on DINOv2 CLS, and our geometric token pruning reduces the additional depth error of ToMe-based token selection by $25\%$ on DPT depth at prune ratio $0.5$, without fine-tuning the ViT. Project page: https://cyberiada.github.io/TaskInducedViTs/

articles.title_zh: 任务诱导的 Riemannian Metrics 视觉变形器特性空间
articles.content_zh: 在Vision Transformer(ViT)功能空间上操作的方法一般依赖于欧几利得相距或相弦相近. 这假设每个方向都同样有意义,但没有理由相信真正的任务几何有这种属性. 特性空间对任务敏感的几何学是由取回公尺$g(F)=J(F)^\top J(F)$给出的,其中$J$是解码器输出输入到任务特定距离的雅各比子,与特性有关. 在现代规模上,储存全额美元是不可行的,对于深度地图等密集产出,甚至形成美元也不可行。 我们显示,能否学到这一度量的低等近似值取决于模型解码器的对等,我们用一个无矩阵的诊断($κ_{cap} (r)$来形容这个值,可以用少量的雅各布氏活体产品来计算. 对于可牵引的对子,我们开发了Spectral拉回网络(SPN),它从随机的电源迭代中学习出一个低等的分量版本,我们把它分馏成一个$310K-参数的重要头,直接从特性中预测出象征性的重要性. 当雅各比谱被太分散到低等相近处时,通过一个VAE瓶颈来传递解码器的输入特性可以恢复可取性. DPT、DINov2、CLIP、VGGT主干线, 重要头像通过DINOv2 CLS达到斯皮尔曼0.998美元,我们的几何符号推算将基于ToMe的符号选择的额外深度误差在Prune比0.5的DPT深度上降低了25美元,而没有微调VIT. 项目网页:https://cyberiada.github.io/TaskInduredViTs/

articles.title: All modalities are equal, but video is more equal: Closing the Cross-Attention Gap in Joint Video Generation
articles.content: Video is a rich representation of a physical event, capturing appearance, geometry, motion, and temporal evolution. Other modalities, such as 3D body motion or audio, encode narrower aspects of the same event. We find that joint multimodal diffusion transformers exhibit a corresponding asymmetry in cross-modal correspondence: companion modalities develop strong correspondences to video, but the reciprocal correspondences through which they constrain video remain substantially weaker. We express both directions as comparable correspondence distributions over video tokens and define their disagreement as the reciprocal correspondence gap. We introduce RecCAR, standing for Reciprocal Cross-modal Attention Regularization, a KL regularizer that uses the well-established video-to-modality correspondence as a fixed reference and aligns the weaker modality-to-video correspondence toward it. Across joint video-motion and video-audio generation, RecCAR improves the Human Anatomy score from 0.69 to 0.75 and reduces audio-video desynchronization from 0.804 to 0.752, while improving overall generation

articles.title_zh: 所有模式都是平等的,但视频更加平等: 缩小联合视频生成中的交叉关注差距
articles.content_zh: 视频是物理事件的丰富表现,捕捉出外观,几何,运动,以及时间演化. 其他模式,如3D体运动或音频,编码相同事件的更窄的方面. 我们发现,联合多式传播变压器在交叉式通信中呈现出相应的不对称性:相伴模式发展出对视频的强力通信,但是它们限制视频的对等通信仍然大大弱化. 我们以可比较的函证分发方式表达两个方向,并将它们之间的分歧界定为相互函证差距。 我们引入了RecCAR, 主张对等跨模式的注意规范化,一种KL规范化的规范化方法,它使用既定的视频对模式函证作为固定的参考,并将较弱的模式对视频函证与它保持一致。 在整个联合视频-运动和视频-音频生成过程中,RecCAR将人体解剖学分数从0.69分提高到了0.75分,并将音频-视频去同步从0.804分减少到了0.752分,同时改善了整体生成.

articles.title: NeuralSRNF: Neural Square Root Normal Fields for the Statistical Shape Analysis and Generation of Nonrigid 3D and 4D Objects
articles.content: We introduce NeuralSRNF, a novel framework for the statistical shape analysis and generation of genus-zero 3D and 4D objects that undergo nonrigid deformations. Traditional methods rely on complex and computationally expensive nonlinear elastic metrics that measure bending and stretching. Recent advances in elastic shape analysis achieve computational efficiency by mapping input 3D shapes to the space of Square Root Normal Fields (SRNFs) where the L2 metric approximates the partial elastic metric, significantly facilitating the process of computing geodesics and summary statistics. SRNFs, however, are not invertible, and the numerical algorithms used to map SRNFs back to the original space of surfaces remain computationally very expensive and often lead to approximate results. This paper addresses this fundamental SRNF inversion problem using a novel neural representation, termed NeuralSRNF. Unlike the commonly used numerical SRNF, NeuralSRNF is (1) continuous, and thus resolution-agnostic, enabling full functional shape analysis, (2) more accurate, and (3) computationally more efficient as it can compute inverse SRNF maps along a geodesic path in less than 3 s compared to over 10 min for the numerical SRNF. We demonstrate, using various datasets, the utility and efficiency of the proposed NeuralSRNF in multiple elastic 3D and 4D shape analysis tasks such as geodesic computation, deformation transfer, statistical summaries computation, and 3D shape generation. We show that it outperforms competing methods on most evaluated datasets and metrics by a wide margin in both accuracy and computational efficiency. The source code and additional results are available at https://awaisnizamani16.github.io/awais/NeuralSRNF/.

articles.title_zh: 神经SRNF:用于统计形状分析和生成非硬化3D和4D对象的神经平方根常态场
articles.content_zh: 我们引入了NeuralSRNF,这个新颖的框架用于统计形状分析以及生成能发生非刚性变形的克-零三维和克-四维等物体. 传统方法依赖复杂而计算昂贵的非线性弹性度量衡来测量弯曲和伸展. 最近弹性形状分析的进步,通过将输入的3D形状映射到平方根常态场(SRNFs)的空间来达到计算效率,L2公尺近似于部分弹性度量,大大地方便了计算大地测量学和汇总统计的过程. 然而,SRNF并不是不可逆的,用于将SRNF映射回表面原始空间的数值算法在计算上仍然非常昂贵并经常导致大致的结果. 本文用一种被称作"神经SRNF"(NeuralSRNF)的小说神经代表来探讨这个基本的SRNF倒置问题. 与常用的数值SRNF不同,神经SRNF是(1)连续的,因此具有分辨率-可知性,能够进行全面的功能形状分析,(2)更加准确,(3)计算效率更高,因为它能够以不到3 s来计算沿大地测量路径的反向SRNF地图,而数字SRNF的计算时间则超过10分钟. 我们利用各种数据集,在大地测量计算、变形转移、统计摘要计算和三维形状生成等多种弹性三维和四维形状分析任务中,演示拟议的神经SRNF的效用和效率。 我们显示,它比大多数评价数据集和计量标准的竞争方法在准确度和计算效率方面都大相径庭。 源代码和额外结果可查阅https://awaisnizamani16.github.io/awais/NeuralSRNF/。

articles.title: FFM-CP: Cross-Backbone Fusion of Vision-Language Foundation Models for Few-Shot Computational Pathology
articles.content: Pathology vision-language foundation models vary in performance across diseases and tasks, with no single model consistently performing best. The high cost of expert pathology annotation can also limit the labeled data available for task-specific adaptation. Combining complementary pretrained representations is a potential approach to these limitations, yet learning an effective fusion from few labeled examples remains challenging. We introduce Few-shot Fusion Foundation Models of Computational Pathology (FFM-CP), which is a framework that combines multiple pathology vision-language models in the few-shot learning setting. The framework first aligns heterogeneous representations using a closed-form Orthogonal Procrustes transformation estimated from corresponding support images. This alignment preserves within-model feature geometry without training an additional alignment network. Within the aligned space, a unified graph enables information exchange across backbones by jointly refining support-image features and visual and textual class prototypes. These refined representations support complementary text-prototype and case-retrieval branches that capture semantic class knowledge and within-class visual variation, respectively. Each branch learns to combine predictions from all ordered backbone pairs, allowing queries encoded by one model to draw on evidence represented by another. We evaluate three backbone combinations on six histopathology datasets at 4, 8, and 16 shots per class. FFM-CP achieves higher mean macro-F1 than the strongest individually adapted member of each fused set in 50 of 54 comparisons. These findings suggest that combining complementary pretrained representations can improve histopathological classification when annotations are limited.

articles.title_zh: FEM-CP: 视野-语言基础模型的交叉组合 病理学
articles.content_zh: 病理视觉语基础模型因疾病和任务的表现而异,没有单一模型一贯表现最佳. 专家病理学注释的高昂成本也会限制用于特定任务适应的有标签的数据. 将经过预先培训的补充表述结合起来,是克服这些限制的一种潜在办法,然而,从少数被标榜的例子中学习有效的组合仍然具有挑战性。 我们引入了"几发融合"基础模型"计算病理学(FFM-CP),这个框架将多发病理视觉语言模型结合到"几发"学习环境中. 该框架首先利用从相应的支持图像中估计的闭式正弦蛋白质转化来协调各种表达方式。 这种对接方式保留了模型内特征几何学,而没有培训额外的对接网络. 在对齐的空间内,一个统一的图表通过共同改进支持-图像特征以及视觉和文字类原型,使各骨干之间的信息交流成为可能。 这些精细的表述支持互补的文本原型和案例检索分支,分别捕捉语义类知识和类内视觉差异. 每个分支都学习将所有有序主干对的预测结合起来,使一个模型所编码的查询能够取用由另一个模型所代表出的证据. 我们评估了六套组织病理学数据集的 三套骨干组合 每班4,8和16发子弹 实况调查团-CP的平均值F1高于54个比较中50个比较中每套引信中最强的个别调整成员。 这些调查结果表明,如果说明有限,合并补充性预先训练过的表示可以改进组织病理学分类。

articles.title: DAVIO: Dense Monocular-Inertial SLAM with Feed-Forward Initialization and Pose-Conditioned Mapping
articles.content: A camera and an IMU are the minimal sensor setup for metric localization and dense mapping, yet classical visual--inertial filters must wait for parallax before they start and then retain only sparse landmarks. Feed-forward geometry models, in contrast, predict dense structure from a few images but provide neither metric scale nor gravity. We present DAVIO, which uses a single multi-view depth model, Depth Anything~3, for both start-up and mapping. At start-up, a five-image window and preintegrated IMU measurements form a feature-free linear system. Its robust, conditioning-checked solution bootstraps a VIO filter through buffered replay. During tracking, the filter's metric poses condition the depth model. Residual scale is corrected only along viewing rays, which preserves the metric camera baselines, and a gravity-preserving submap graph with drift-gated revisits refines the map. On EuRoC, DAVIO starts markedly earlier, reduces the localization error, and maps more accurately than SOTA feed-forward mappers given identical poses. On building-scale ORI sequences, DAVIO is on bar or better than SOTA mappers on the same odometry, and degrades far less when GT poses are replaced by real odometry. We release the code of DAVIO, a real-time dense metric SLAM system, to the community.

articles.title_zh: DAVIO: 具有饲料前置初始化和Pose-Contition绘图功能的敏锐单发-惯性 SAMM
articles.content_zh: 相机和IMU是测量局部化和密集地绘图的最小传感器设置,然而古典视觉惯性滤波器在启动前必须等待抛光管,然后只保留稀有地标. 相形之下,Feed-forward几何模型则预测出从少数图像中产生的密集结构,但既不提供度量尺度,也不提供重力. 我们介绍DAVIO,它使用一个单一的多视图深度模型,深度Anything~3,用于启动和绘图. 在启动时,一个五相窗口和预先集成的IMU测量组成了无地物的线性系统. 通过缓冲回放 它的坚固的, 调节检查的溶液靴子 通过VIO过滤器。 在跟踪过程中,滤波器的度量法对深度模型构成条件. 残留尺度仅会沿着能保存公尺相机基线的取景射线进行校正,并用漂移重回的重力分图来分解地图. 在 EuRoC 上, DAVIO 开始时间明显提前,减少了本地化错误, 地图比 SOTA 的 feed-forward 映射器更精确, 在建筑尺度的ORI序列上,DAVIO处于条形上或优于SOTA映射器在同一o多分量上,而当GT外形被真实的o多分量所取代时会降解得更低. 我们向社区发布DAVIO的代码,一个实时密集的SLAM系统.

articles.title: SynSeq: End-to-End SYNTAX Score Prediction from Coronary Angiography Videos
articles.content: The SYNTAX score is an established tool for assessing coronary artery disease and guiding revascularization treatment decisions. However, its manual estimation from coronary angiography videos by clinical experts is time-consuming and subject to inter-reader variability. While machine learning has shown promise in automating this process, prior work has primarily focused on lesion detection, characterization, or binary disease classification, leaving direct SYNTAX score prediction relatively unexplored. We propose SynSeq, a video-based method for direct SYNTAX score prediction. It combines targeted preprocessing with a tailored training strategy using a zero-inflation-aware loss and linear target scaling. Evaluated on the public CardioSyntax dataset, SynSeq significantly outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods, improving $R^2$ by 0.55, reducing prediction bias by 93.1% and achieving more consistent performance across annotations from three independent expert graders. In addition, SynSeq achieves a weighted $F_1$-score of 0.80 for revascularization treatment recommendations, slightly below inter-expert agreement. These results demonstrate the potential of SynSeq to provide consistent, automated SYNTAX score assessment and reliable decision support for coronary revascularization planning.

articles.title_zh: SynSeq: 冠状血管造影视频的终到SYNTAX分数预测
articles.content_zh: SYNTAX分数是评估冠状动脉疾病和指导再血管化治疗决定的既定工具. 然而,临床专家从冠状血管造影视频中对其进行人工估计是耗时的,并受到阅读者之间可变性的影响. 虽然机器学习在使这个过程自动化方面表现出了希望,但之前的工作主要集中于损伤检测,特征鉴定,或二元疾病分类,使得直接SYNTAX分数预测相对没有被探讨. 我们提出SynSeq,一种基于视频的方法,用于直接的SYNTAX分数预测. 它利用零通货膨胀意识损失和线性目标规模,将目标预处理与有针对性的培训战略结合起来。 SynSeq对公共心律语法数据集进行了评价,大大超过以往最先进的方法,将2美元提高0.55卢比,将预测偏差降低93.1%,并在三位独立专家分级员的说明中实现更加一致的业绩。 此外,SynSeq还实现了0.80分的重血管化治疗建议的加权F_1美元分数,略低于专家之间的协议。 这些结果显示了SynSeq提供一致,自动化的SYNTAX分数评估和对冠心再血管化规划的可靠决策支持的潜力.

articles.title: Gender Bias in Vision-Language In-Context Learning
articles.content: In-context learning (ICL) enables large vision-language models (LVLMs) to perform tasks by following patterns from in-context examples, yet its potential to amplify societal biases remains underexplored. We systematically investigate how ICL influences gender bias in LVLMs through VL-BICLE, an evaluation framework comprising six ICL settings, three tasks, and four datasets. Our experiments on six LVLMs reveal that gendered ICL demonstrations act as a directional force, shifting model bias toward the demonstrated gender through a cross-gender mechanism that disproportionately degrades performance on the opposite gender. This effect appears in image captioning and pronoun prediction but not in visual question answering, indicating that gendered ICL influences bias only when the task output involves gendered language. Similarity-based retrieval methods inherit the training pool's gender imbalance and offer no debiasing advantage, while standard quality metrics remain blind to these bias shifts. To mitigate this bias, we replace real in-context images with synthetic ones from stable diffusion models while keeping captions unchanged. This simple intervention reduces gender bias without degrading caption quality.

articles.title_zh: 视觉语言中的性别偏见
articles.content_zh: 内容内学习(ICL)使得大型视觉语言模型(LVLMs)能够按照内容内实例的模式执行任务,但其扩大社会偏见的潜力仍然没有得到充分发挥。 我们通过VL-BICLE系统调查ICL如何影响LVLMs中的性别偏见,这个评价框架包括六个ICL设置,三个任务,四个数据集. 我们对六起LVLM的实验表明,性别化的ICL演示是一种方向性力量,通过跨性别机制将模式偏向于被演示的性别,而跨性别机制不成比例地降低了相反性别的表现。 这种效果出现在图像字幕和代名词预测中,而不是在视觉问题回答中,表明性别化的ICL只有在任务输出涉及性别化语言时才会影响偏见. 基于相似性的检索方法继承了培训人才库的性别不平衡,没有削弱优势,而标准的质量衡量标准却对这些偏见的转变视而不见。 为了减少这种偏差,我们用稳定的传播模型的合成图像来取而代之,同时保持标题不变。 这种简单的干预措施减少了性别偏见,但没有降低标题的质量。

articles.title: CasCVS-Net: A Staged Multi-Task Cascade for Critical View of Safety Assessment
articles.content: Automated assessment of the Critical View of Safety (CVS) in laparoscopic cholecystectomy requires both recognition of the three CVS criteria and anatomical grounding in small, rare, and often occluded hepatocystic structures. Learning-based methods differ in the anatomical information they use, from image-level classification to detection, segmentation, or graph-based reasoning, yet grounding the safety-critical anatomy remains the main bottleneck. We propose CasCVS-Net, a staged multi-task cascade that jointly performs object detection, semantic segmentation, and CVS assessment, trained on the Endoscapes dataset. The model couples the tasks through predicted anatomy: predicted boxes guide segmentation, and predicted masks provide region-level features for CVS classification, so CVS assessment at inference uses only model predictions rather than ground-truth annotations. To reduce optimisation instability in this coupled setting, training progresses from detection to detection-segmentation and then to the full three-task cascade, followed by task-wise fine-tuning. Evaluation on the public unseen test set shows that CasCVS-Net improves over matched single-task baselines on all three tasks, achieving 32.0 detection mAP, 46.8 semantic mIoU, 15.3 rare-anatomy mIoU, and 67.2 CVS mAP. It outperforms the state-of-the-art LG-CVS and SV2LSTG by 6.3% and 4.5% relative CVS mAP, respectively, corresponding to 4.0 and 2.9 mAP points. These results show that staged task coupling through predicted boxes and masks improves anatomical grounding for CVS assessment, particularly for rare hepatocystic structures.

articles.title_zh: CasCVS-Net:安全评估关键观点的分阶段多任务连锁店
articles.content_zh: 对膝盖细胞切除术中的安全临界视图(CVS)进行自动化评估,既要求承认CVS的三项标准,又要求在小而稀有且经常被吞噬的肝细胞结构中进行解剖。 基于学习的方法在它们使用的解剖信息上有所不同,从图像级分类到检测,分解,或以图表为根据的推理,然而打下安全关键解剖的基础仍然是主要的瓶颈. 我们提议使用CasCVS-Net,这是一个分级的多任务级联,联合进行对象检测、语义分解和CVS评估,培训内容是Endoscases数据集。 模型通过预测解剖学来对任务进行配对:预测箱引导分解,预测口罩为CVS分类提供了区域层面的特征,因此CVS推论评估只使用模型预测,而不用地上真实说明. 为了减少这种组合环境中的优化不稳定性,培训从检测到检测分出,再到完整的三任务级联,然后按任务进行微调。 对公共隐形测试集的评价显示,CasCVS-Net改进了所有三项任务上匹配的单任务基线,实现了32.0 mAP检测,46.8 语义mIoU,15.3 稀有解剖mIoU,67.2 CVS mAP. 它的性能分别比最先进的LG-CVS和SV2LSTG高出6.3%和4.5%相对CVS mAP,相当于4.0和2.9 mAP分. 这些结果表明,通过预测箱和口罩进行任务相接可改善CVS评估的解剖地基,特别是稀有的肝细胞结构。

articles.title: RoadOcc Learns When to Persist, Transport, or Refresh Memory for Roadside Occupancy Prediction
articles.content: Fixed roadside cameras repeatedly observe a stable scene overlaid by sparse moving traffic. Temporal memory can recover weak observations, but reusing moving evidence at stale locations can corrupt occupancy predictions. Motion compensation addresses displacement, while reliance on the resulting history remains a separate learning problem. We introduce RoadOcc, which learns soft routing among fixed-coordinate history (\emph{Persist}), velocity-addressed history (\emph{Transport}), and current evidence (\emph{Refresh}). Motion state and class-consistent historical support supervise these source choices. Dynamic-aware cross-attention (DCA) updates candidate locations, multi-scale voxel velocity estimation (VVE) constructs transport addresses from multi-scale current--history correspondence, and velocity-guided dynamic sparse fusion (VDSF) combines routed evidence under fixed sparse-token budgets. On InfraOcc, RoadOcc reaches 65.29 mIoU and 32.37 dynamic mIoU, gains of 4.44 and 4.71 over STCOcc. Controlled address experiments show that VVE raises dynamic mIoU by 0.87 over fixed-coordinate reading. Across three seeds, supervised P/T/R adds 1.40 dynamic points over motion-corrected retrieval, while removing Refresh costs 0.32 points. Results from two transfer models, Occ3D-nuScenes, and longer intervals provide additional support. Code will be released.

articles.title_zh: RoadOCC 学习 何时到 持久 , 运输 , 或 刷新 路边占用预测的记忆
articles.content_zh: 固定的路边相机多次观测到一个平稳的场景,上面布满了稀少的行走交通. 时间记忆可以恢复微弱的观测,但重新使用被搁置地点的移动证据会破坏占用预测. 动议赔偿解决了流离失所问题,而依赖由此产生的历史仍然是一个单独的学习问题。 我们介绍RoadOcc,它学习了固定坐标历史(\emph{Persist}),速度处理历史(\emph{Transport}),以及当前证据(\emph{Refresh})之间的软路由。 运动状态和与阶级一致的历史支持监督这些源选择. 动态-意识相通(DCA)更新了候选位置,多尺度的活塞速度估计(VVE)从多尺度的当前-历史通信中构建了运输地址,而速度-导动的活塞分解(VDSF)结合了固定的稀有预算下的路由证据. 在FraOcc上,RoadOcc达到65.29 mIoU和32.37动态mIoU,比STCOcc增收了4.44和4.71. 受控地址实验显示,VVE在固定坐标读取上以0.87提高动态mIoU. 在三种种子中,监督的P/T/R比运动修正后检索增加了1.40个动态点,同时去除刷新成本0.32分. 两种转移模型Occ3D-nuScens的结果以及较长的间隔提供了额外的支持. 代码将发布。

articles.title: Track2Art: Motion-Centric Articulated Object Model Recovery from 2D Point Trackers
articles.content: Understanding articulated objects is fundamental for robotic interaction, requiring accurate rigid-part discovery and the recovery of their kinematic relations. Existing approaches often treat articulation as a by-product of reconstructed geometry or recover it through per-instance optimization. We instead build on the hypothesis that articulation is directly observable from persistent motion: points on the same rigid part move coherently, while relative motion between parts reveals their kinematic constraints. We present Track2Art, a motion-centric framework for recovering structured articulated objects from RGB-D interaction videos. Track2Art lifts tracked image points into persistent 3D trajectories and combines pretrained tracking features, visual descriptors, and explicit trajectory geometry. These representations are grouped into a variable number of rigid-part hypotheses and subsequently used to recover directed kinematic relations, joint types, and joint geometry through rotation-equivariant learned--analytic reasoning. On the aligned 20-object PartNet-Mobility suite, Track2Art achieves 0.695 Point IoU and 0.410 end-to-end J@20, while requiring neither ground-truth part counts nor test-time optimization.

articles.title_zh: Track2Art:从2D点跟踪器中取出运动-子化对象模型
articles.content_zh: 理解所阐明的物体对机器人互动至关重要,需要精确的刚性部分发现并恢复其动能关系. 现有方法往往将表达作为重建几何学的副产品,或通过逐一优化恢复. 相反,我们基于一种假设,即表达是从持续运动中直接观察到的:同一僵化部分的点是一致地移动的,而各部分之间的相对运动则揭示出它们的活动限制。 我们介绍Track2Art,这是从RGB-D互动视频中回收结构化的被表达对象的以运动为中心的框架. 轨道2 艺术将被跟踪的图像点提升到持久的3D轨迹中,并结合了预先训练的跟踪特征,可视化描述符,和明确的轨迹几何. 这些表示法被归类为可变数的刚性-部分假设,并随后用于通过旋转-等分法学-分析推理来恢复定向动能关系,联合类型和联合几何. 在对齐的 20-对象 PartNet- Mobility 套件上, Track2 艺术实现0.695点IoU和0.410端对端J@20,同时既不要求地-实部分计数,也不要求测试时间优化.

articles.title: SGDet3D++: Geometry-Grounded Semantics for 4D Radar and Camera 3D Object Detection
articles.content: 4D radar complements dense image semantics with long-range geometry and radial motion, but existing radar--camera detectors largely solve \emph{where} to align the modalities while leaving \emph{whether} a piece of evidence supports an evolving object hypothesis implicit. An image token may describe an occluder, a nearby radar return may belong to another object, and a pose-aligned memory slot may carry incompatible motion. We formulate \emph{hypothesis-conditioned evidence grounding}, which separates candidate access from evidence use: semantic, geometric, or temporal evidence is filtered or conditioned by the evolving 3D state before updating the corresponding query. \sgdetpp{} instantiates this principle through Anchor-Grounded Semantic Retrieval (AGR), which conditions deformable image retrieval on pooled anchor-consistent radar support; Geometry-Consistent Anchor Refinement (GCR), which attentively aggregates individual associated returns; and Doppler-Verified Correspondence (DVC), which replaces history only when current radial motion contradicts it. \sgdetpp{} improves the strongest compared method by 3.82 mAP and 6.82 ODS on OmniHD-Scenes and by 6.82 mAP and 9.22 NDS on ManTruckScenes, while also leading the listed methods in the TJ4DRadSet test comparison. Mechanism-targeted evaluations show that AGR improves strict AP in every projected-occlusion bin, the yaw-aligned box gate raises target-return purity from 29.95\% to 58.87\%, and DVC preserves 96.11\% of motion-consistent history while retaining 75.90\% contradiction recall. Code will be released.

articles.title_zh: SGDet3D++:用于4D雷达和相机3D物体探测的几何-环形语义
articles.content_zh: 4D雷达以长距离几何和射线运动来补充密集的图像语义,但现有的雷达-相机探测器在离开\emph{是否}时基本解出\emph{在哪里}来对齐模式,一个证据支持一个正在演变的物体假说所隐含. 一个图像符可以描述一个占星器,相邻的雷达还原可能属于另一个物体,一个相位相通的记忆槽可能带有不相容的运动. 我们制定\emph{ hypothesis- 有条件的证据建立 } 将候选访问和证据使用区分开来: 语义、几何或时间证据在更新相应的查询之前, 由演化中的3D状态过滤或附加条件 。 \sgdetpp{}通过Anchor-Grounded Semantic Retrieval(AGR)将这一原则即时化,该原则在集合锚-相容雷达支持上为可变形图像取回条件;几何-相容的Anchor Finement(GCR),它仔细地汇总了单个相关返回;而多普勒-威化通信(DVC),它只有在当前光圈运动与之相矛盾时才能取代历史. \sgdetpp{}在OmniHD-Scenes上改进了最强比法3.82 mAP和6.82 ODS,在ManTruckScenes上改进了6.82 mAP和9.22 NDS,同时在TJ4DRadSet测试比较中也领先于所列出的方法. 机制目标评价显示,AGR改进了每个预测隔离箱中的严格的AP, yaw-access box gate将目标返回纯度从29.95\%提高到58.87\%;DVC保留了96.11\%运动一致的历史,同时保留了75.90\%的矛盾召回. 代码将发布。

articles.title: InGuard: Towards Generalized Inner Guardrail for Safe Text-to-Image Generation
articles.content: Modern text-to-image (T2I) models generate high-quality images from arbitrary user prompts, yet they can just as easily produce not-safe-for-work (NSFW) content. Conventional outer guardrails consist of two components: a prompt classifier that checks for risk before generation, and a post-hoc image classifier that checks the fully generated image. In this design, both classifiers operate outside the generation pipeline and do not use the model's own representations. This separation can limit prompt-screening accuracy, while the image-side check runs only after the full generation cost has been spent. Moreover, a flagged prompt can only be rejected, even when it could be adjusted to produce a safe image. In this work, we propose the Inner Guardrail (InGuard), a safety framework that works inside the pipeline on the model's own representations, leaving base-model parameters untouched. First, a risk classifier grades each prompt as unsafe, risky, or benign based on the text encoder's embeddings, with no external language model. Second, SAGE (Soft-gated Asymmetric Guardrail for Embeddings) modifies the embeddings of risky prompts, aiming to return a safe image instead of a refusal. Third, a latent detector checks the one-step clean latent estimate midway through denoising, reaching nearly image-level performance and halting generation when risk is detected. We also construct the RevGen Safety Benchmark to evaluate T2I safety under realistic conditions: 10,000 prompts built through real-image reverse generation, with a rewriting step that supplies controlled intellectual-property (IP) characters, covering graded porn/gore risks, categorical IP risks, and benign negatives. Across five open-weight T2I models, InGuard reaches 97.9-98.8% safety rate, matching or exceeding the outer guardrail, with 57.5-73.5% less benign disturbance, ~3.7x fewer parameters, and 50-55.6% of denoising steps skipped.

articles.title_zh: InGuard:迈向安全文本到图像生成的通用内护铁路
articles.content_zh: 现代的文本到图像(T2I)模型从任意的用户提示中生成出高质量的图像,然而它们同样可以轻松地产生不安全的工作(NSFW)内容. 常规外护栏由两个部分组成:一个在生成前检查风险的即时分级器,另一个在后热成像分级器检查完全生成的成像. 在这个设计中,两个分类器都运行在生成管外,而不使用模型自己的表示. 这种分离可以限制即时筛选的准确性,而图像侧检查只有在全部生成成本用完后才进行. 此外,标记的提示只能被拒绝,即使可以调整以产生安全图像。 在这项工作中,我们提出"内护道"(InGuard),这个安全框架在管线内根据模型自己的表示进行工作,使基建模型参数未受影响. 首先,根据文本编码器的嵌入,将每个提示器的分级归类为不安全,有风险,或良性,没有外语模式. 第二,SAGE(软质非对称嵌入式护栏)修改了有风险的提示的嵌入,目的是返回安全图像而不是拒绝. 第三,潜伏探测器在中途通过去诺、接近图像水平的性能和在发现风险时停止生成来检查单步清洁潜伏估计值。 我们还构建了RevGen安全基准,在现实条件下评价T2I安全性:通过真实图像倒置生成而制造出一万个提示,并用重写步骤提供受控的知识产权字符,涵盖分级的色情/gore风险,绝对的IP风险,以及良性负面. InGuard在5个开放式T2I型机车中,安全率达到97.9%-98.8%,匹配或超过外护铁道,57.5%-73.5%的扰动减少,~3.7x参数减少,50-55.6%的去意步骤跳过.

articles.title: Contrastive Learning for Authorship Verification
articles.content: Our results show that contrastive learning outperforms a classification-based approach to authorship verification under the tested settings. We identify loss function, batch size, training duration, pre-trained model, input context length, and random text span data augmentation as important factors of model performance. Based on these considerations, we develop a ModernBERT Bi-Encoder model that achieves 98.4% accuracy on the PAN21 authorship verification task.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 权威核查的对照学习
articles.content_zh: 我们的结果显示,对比性学习的成绩超过了在所测试的环境下以分类为基础的作者资格核查方法。 我们确定损失函数、批量大小、培训期限、预先训练的模型、输入上下文长度和随机文字跨度数据扩充是模型性能的重要因素。 基于这些考虑,我们开发了ModernBERT Bi-Encoder模型,实现了PAN21作者身份验证任务的98.4%的准确性.

articles.title: Can LLMs Reason About Runtime Behavior? A Repository-Level Dynamic Benchmark
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in coding tasks, but their ability to reason about code execution remains unclear. Existing repository-level QA benchmarks mainly evaluate static code understanding and often rely on LLM-based evaluation, while execution-reasoning benchmarks are mostly limited to snippets or functions. We introduce SWE-Flux, a repository-level benchmark for dynamic execution reasoning containing 480 execution-grounded instances across 12 real Python repositories, with gold answers automatically harvested from instrumented test executions rather than written manually or judged by LLMs. The benchmark covers singletest and multi-test questions over control flow, loops, program state, dataflow, exceptions, and program invariants. Evaluating five LLMs shows that this task remains challenging. The best model achieves only 37% accuracy. Models perform better on localized behavior such as invariants, intra-procedural control flow, exceptions, and simple loops, but struggle with dataflow, inter-procedural execution, precise state reasoning, and suite-level aggregation. Finally, we show that the oracle-harvesting pipeline can generate fresh benchmark variants using input perturbation. It successfully harvests valid variants for almost 90% of the selected instances, and the resulting variants are substantially more challenging for the evaluated models.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LLMS能否解释运行时的行为? 仓库级动态基准
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMS)越来越多地被用在编码任务上,但其代码执行的推理能力仍然不明确. 现有的寄存器级QA基准主要评价静态代码理解,并经常依赖基于LLM的评价,而执行推理基准大多局限于片段或函数. 我们引入了SWE-Flux(SWE-Flux),这是动态执行推理的存储器级基准,包含在12个真正的Python存储器中480个基于执行的实例,黄金解答是自动从仪器测试处决中获取的,而不是由LLMs手写或判断的. 该基准涵盖关于控制流,循环,程序状态,数据流,例外,以及程序变化性等的单测试和多测试问题. 对5个有限责任方案的评价表明,这项任务仍然具有挑战性。 最好的模型只达到37%的准确度. 模型在本地化行为上表现较好,如不常态,程序内控制流,例外,和简单的循环,但与数据流,程序间执行,精确状态推理,以及套接相容等斗争. 最后,我们表明,甲骨文收割管可以利用输入扰动产生新的基准变体。 它成功收获了近90%的选定实例的有效变种,对被评价的模型而言,由此产生的变种更具挑战性。

articles.title: Order-Invariant Answers, Order-Sensitive Representations in Mathematical Reasoning
articles.content: Reordering a set of mathematical rules without changing its meaning should preserve the correct answer, but must a model's internal representations stay invariant too? We investigate this question using synthetic multi-step function-composition problems, each presented under multiple rule orderings with the same correct answer. We measure accuracy and permutation signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), which quantifies how distinctly ordering patterns are represented relative to variation across problem instances. Across 16 language models ranging from 1B to 8B parameters, we find a pattern: models that solve reordered problems more accurately represent different rule orderings more distinctly. Layer-averaged permutation SNR is positively rank-correlated with accuracy in every synthetic setting we evaluate, with Spearman correlations reaching 0.86. These findings highlight a distinction between answer invariance and representation invariance: successful mathematical rule composition can accompany distinct internal representations between equivalent rule orderings. This motivates distinguishing answer invariance from representation invariance, and offers a representational perspective on mathematical reasoning beyond answer accuracy alone.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 顺序- 不定式回答, 顺序- 数学理性中的敏感表达
articles.content_zh: 重新排列一套数学规则而不改变其含义,应该保持正确的答案,但模型的内部表述是否也必须保持无变化? 我们用合成的多步函数组合问题来调查这个问题,每个问题都是在多个规则命令下给出的,有相同的正确答案. 我们测量精确度和通量信号与噪声之比(SNR),以量化相对于不同问题情况的差异而言,排列规律的明显性。 在从1B到8B参数的16个语言模型中,我们发现一个模式:解决重排问题的模型更准确地代表了不同规则的更分明的顺序. 地层平均通量SNR在我们评估的每个合成环境中都具有正分级和精度相关,斯皮尔曼的关联度达到0.86. 这些结论突出了答案偏差和表示偏差之间的区别:成功的数学规则构成可以伴随等同规则顺序之间不同的内部表示. 这促使人们区分答案的偏差和表达的偏差,并为数学推理提供了一个超越答案精确度的表述视角.

articles.title: Cross-Scale Transfer Learning for Depression Severity Prediction: From PHQ-8 to HAMD-17 Across Languages and Clinical Paradigms
articles.content: This work addresses continuous depression-severity score prediction from clinical interview transcripts under data scarcity. We propose a sequential low-rank adaptation (LoRA) protocol for cross-scale transfer: a Qwen3 backbone with a bounded regression head is first fine-tuned on the English DAIC-WOZ dataset (189 avatar-mediated sessions, PHQ-8), and the adapter then initializes fine-tuning on the Chinese PDCH dataset (100 real clinical consultations, HAMD-17), where a reinitialised, scale-specific head predicts the clinician-assigned score. All configurations use patient-level stratified 5-fold, 2-repeat cross-validation. On the data-scarce HAMD-17 target, the sequential protocol attains the best point-estimate MAE , RMSE, and macro-$F_1$ on both 0.6B and 1.7B backbones, outperforming target-only training and non-LLM baselines---4.96/6.59/0.36 with Qwen3-0.6B and 4.38/5.62/0.46 with Qwen3-1.7B. Ablations suggest that correctly aligned source supervision gives the best point estimates (unsupervised exposure and shuffled-label controls also show partial gains), that native-Chinese target input outperforms machine-translated English input, and that the reversed order yields no clear gain within run-to-run variance. The study is an exploratory, single-site internal evaluation: it does not establish screening or diagnostic utility, nor separately identify the contribution of the scale, language, or paradigm shifts. To our knowledge, no prior study evaluates this specific DAIC-WOZ-to-PDCH sequential transfer setting.

articles.title_zh: 抑郁症严重性预测跨层次转移学习:从PHQ-8到HAMD-17跨语言和临床范式
articles.content_zh: 这项工作解决了在数据稀缺的情况下从临床访谈记录中得出的持续抑郁-严重分数预测. 我们提出一个相继的低阶适应(LORA)跨尺度传输协议:一个有限定回归头的Qwen3主干线首先在英语的DAIC-WOZ数据集上进行微调(189个可视化介质会话,PHQ-8),适配器再对中国PDCH数据集进行微调(100个真实的临床咨询,HAMD-17),一个重新初始化的,有尺度特异性的主干线预测临床师分配分. 所有配置都采用患者水平分级5倍,重复2倍的交叉验证. 在数据缺乏的HAMD-17目标上,相继协议在0.6B和1.7B两个主干线上达到最佳分数估计的MAE、RMSE和宏-F_1美元,表现优于目标培训和非LLM基线--4.96/6.59/0.36,Qune3-0.6B和4.38/5.62/0.46,Qune3-1.7B。 偏差表明,正确对齐的源码监督给出了最佳的点数估计(未受监督的曝光和被洗牌控制也显示部分收益),本土-中国目标输入比机器-翻译的英语输入表现要好,而倒置的顺序在运行中的差异内没有产生明显的收益. 这项研究是一次探索性、单一地点的内部评价:它没有建立筛选或诊断效用,也没有单独确定规模、语言或范式变化的贡献。 据我们所知,以前没有一项研究评估DAIC-WOZ--PDCH的相继转移设置。

articles.title: Agent-Editing World Model: Rethinking World Modeling for LLM Agents
articles.content: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled agents to tackle long-horizon tasks across diverse environments. To further improve agent performance, existing language world models typically predict environment observations, yet reconstructing high-entropy, execution-dependent tool responses offers limited value when real feedback is available. Meanwhile, agents suffer from \emph{task-state contamination}, where unsupported assumptions and outdated plans persist in history and distort subsequent decisions. We propose the \textbf{Agent-Editing World Model (AEWM)}, which models how reasoning and actions shape future task progress rather than simulating tool responses. AEWM combines \textbf{Action Judge} to distinguish \textsc{Critical}, \textsc{Exploratory}, and \textsc{Noisy} decisions with \textbf{State Revision} to edit noisy reasoning--action continuations from the same observed history. \textbf{EditAct} integrates these capabilities with real execution, directly changing the state underlying subsequent decisions rather than merely providing critiques. We train AEWM across Search, Terminal, and Software Engineering through mid-training and supervised fine-tuning. AEWM achieves 70.5\% macro-F1 on our Action Judge benchmark, exceeding the strongest frontier baseline by 10.6 points. Across six benchmarks and three agent backbones, EditAct improves average scores by 3.2--6.7 points over the strongest baseline. Furthermore, rejection sampling fine-tuning on verified EditAct trajectories, termed \textbf{AEWM-RFT}, improves over Self-RFT by 2.2--2.6 points across three domains without online AEWM guidance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 代理编辑世界模式:反思LLM代理的世界模式
articles.content_zh: 最近在大语言模型(LLMs)方面取得的进展,使代理商能够处理不同环境中的长期任务。 为了进一步提高代理性能,现有的语言世界模型通常会预测环境观测,然而,在获得真正的反馈时,重建高度的,依赖执行的工具响应提供的价值有限. 与此同时,特工们遭受了\emph{任务状态污染},其中未经证实的假设和过时的计划在历史上一直存在并扭曲了随后的决定. 我们提出\textbf{代理编辑世界模型(AEWM)},其中的模型是推理和行动如何塑造未来的任务进展,而不是模拟工具的响应. AEWM将\textbf{ Action Judge} 合并为\textsc{Critical},\textsc{Expression} 和\textsc{Noisy} 与\textbf{State Reversion} 合并为\textbf{State Reversion} 从同一观测历史编辑吵闹的推理- Action 续作. \textbf{ EditAct} 将这些能力与实际执行相结合, 直接改变后续决定的基础状态, 而不仅仅是提供批评 。 我们通过中训和有监督的微调,对AEWM进行跨搜索、终端和软件工程的培训。 AEWM在我们的行动法官基准上达到了70.5++x宏-F1,超过最强边界基线10.6分. 在6个基准和3个代理主干线上,EditAct平均得分比最强基线提高3.2-6.7分. 此外,在未经在线的AEWM指导下,在经过核实的EditAct轨迹上对拒绝采样进行微调,比Self-RFT改进了2.2-2.6分。

articles.title: Fine-Tuning LLMs for Translation: General Forgetting Mitigation Does Not Preserve MT-Specific Instruction Following
articles.content: Fine-tuning large language models on parallel data improves translation quality but can cause catastrophic forgetting. Mitigation methods are generally evaluated by retention on general benchmarks. We ask whether these findings transfer to machine translation (MT) fine-tuning and to MT-specific instruction following (MT-IF): instructions that modify a translation, such as formality, grammatical gender, and length control. We compare methods anchored to auxiliary data, to model outputs, and to the base model parameters, first in a screening study with Llama 3.2 1B Instruct, then on Llama 3.1 8B Instruct fine-tuned on bidirectional Arabic-English or Spanish-English data. Elastic Weight Consolidation preserves general capabilities best in both stages; on the 8B Spanish model the average score on general benchmarks drops 1.7 points versus 11.0 for standard fine-tuning, yet its scores for formality and grammatical gender control remain close to standard fine-tuning. Only data mixing with control-task examples preserves these controls, but its gains do not transfer to unseen prompts for the same task.

articles.title_zh: 翻译精细图解 LLMs:通用忘却缓解不保存 MT-特定指令
articles.content_zh: 在平行数据上精细地调整大型语言模型可以提高翻译质量,但可能导致灾难性的遗忘. 缓解方法一般通过保留一般基准加以评估。 我们询问这些结果是否转移到机器翻译(MT)微调和下面的MT特定指令(MT-IF):修改翻译的指令,如形式、语法性别和长度控制。 我们首先与Llama 3.2 1B Instruct进行筛选研究,然后在Llama 3.1 8B上根据双向阿拉伯语-英语或西班牙语-英语数据进行微调。 弹性重量整合在两个阶段都保持了最佳的一般能力;在8B西班牙语模式下,一般基准的平均得分比标准微调的11.0比降1.7分,但其形式性和语法性别控制方面的得分仍然接近标准微调. 只有与控制任务实例相混合的数据才能保存这些控制,但其收益不会转移给同一任务的隐形提示。

articles.title: Digital diglossia: Arabic between X and Facebook
articles.content: This study highlights the distribution of Standard Arabic (SA; H(igh) variety) and Colloquial Arabic (CA; L(ow) variety) across X and Facebook. 16754 public posts were collected via Python, with 10000 retained as the net dataset. Posts were classified into 7 discourse categories: *politics, technology, science, business, culture, fun,* and *sports*. Bivariate analyses, including Chi-square tests and Cramer's V (CV), examined associations among platform, discourse category, and diglossic choice, while binary logistic regression with Platform x Discourse Category interactions tested whether these associations varied across platforms. Findings reveal that there are significant associations between discourse category and diglossic choice on X, chi-square(6, *N* = 5000) = 600.35, p < .001, CV = .347, and Facebook, chi-square(6, N = 5000) = 1249.52, p < .001, CV = .500. Across platforms, platform was also associated with diglossic choice, chi-square(1, N = 10000) = 262.16, p < .001, CV = .162. Binary logistic regression further shows higher odds of SA use on X than Facebook in the political reference category (*OR* = 1.31, p = .0028), with significant platform-by-domain interactions for Culture (OR = 2.65), Fun (*OR* = 6.34), Sports (*OR* = 26.71), Science (OR = 0.41), and Technology (OR = 0.71). The study concludes that the diglossic use of SA and CA contributes to the growing body of research on digital discourse, unveiling that the digital age reshapes but does not erode diglossic boundaries, giving rise instead to a reconfigured digital diglossia.

articles.title_zh: 数字地窖: X和Facebook之间的阿拉伯语
articles.content_zh: 本研究重点介绍了标准阿拉伯语(SA;H(igh)品种)和口语阿拉伯语(CA;L(ow)品种)在X和Facebook的分布. 通过Python收集了16754个公共职位,保留了10 000个作为净数据集。 职位分为7个讨论类别:政治、技术、科学、商业、文化、娱乐、*和运动。 包括Chi-square测试和Cramer's V(CV)在内的两相变量分析,检查了平台之间的关联,讨论类别,以及挖掘损失的选择,而与平台x讨论类别的二进制物流回归,则测试这些关联在平台之间是否不同. 调查结果显示,在X、Chi-square(6)、*N* = 5000) = 600.35、p < 001、CV = 347和Facebook、Chi-square(6、N = 5000) = 1249.52、p < 001、CV = .500上,讨论类别与Dig-square(6、N = 5000)的选题之间有着重大联系。 跨平台,平台也与地挖选择有关,Chi-square(1,N=1000)=262.16,p <.001,CV=.162. 二进制物流回归进一步显示,X在政治参考类(*OR*=1.31,p=.0028)中使用SA的几率比Facebook更高,在文化(OR=2.65),趣事(*OR*=6.34),体育(*OR*=26.71),科学(OR=0.41)和科技(OR=0.71)方面,平台逐域进行重大互动. 研究结论认为,SA和CA的挖掘用法有助于数字对话研究的不断增长,揭示出数字时代重塑了挖掘用法,但并不侵蚀挖掘用法界限,反而导致了重新配置后的数字挖掘用法.

articles.title: Mizar: A 159M-Parameter Audio-Language Model for Audio Understanding
articles.content: Audio-language models (ALMs) integrate acoustic perception with the knowledge encoded in language models, enabling contextual understanding of auditory events. Making these capabilities practical on devices with limited memory and computation motivates our focus on small ALMs with fewer than 200M parameters. We introduce a recipe that brings together architecture, data, and three-stage training to build Mizar, a 159.3M-parameter ALM. Its architecture connects a compact CED-Small audio encoder to SmolLM2-135M through a frequency-merging mapper. With supervision drawn from ReasonAQA, AudioMCQ, and AVQA, the model undergoes three training stages: audio-language alignment (Stage 1), audio-dependent fine-tuning (Stage 2), and post-training (Stage 3) aimed at strengthening weak skills while retaining learned capabilities. Across five random seeds, Mizar achieves mean accuracies of 52.92% on MMAU, 42.42% on MMAR, and 36.02% on ADQA-clean, surpassing the previous best-performing ALM below 200M parameters on all three benchmarks. It also supports local inference on a single CPU: on questions from the MMAU benchmark, the mean latency from opening the audio file to generating a complete answer is 1.09 seconds. Code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/KaiyangLi1992/Mizar_159M.

articles.title_zh: Mizar: 用于音频理解的159M-Parameter音频语言模型
articles.content_zh: 音频语言模型(ALMs)将声学感知与语言模型所编码的知识相融合,使听觉事件能有上下文的理解. 使这些能力在内存和计算有限的设备上切实可行,促使我们注重不到200M参数的小型ALM。 我们引入了一种将建筑,数据和三阶段训练结合起来的配方,用于建造Mizar,一个159.3M参数的ALM. 其架构通过频率相加映射器将紧凑的CED-Small音频编码器与SmolLM2-135M相接. 在ReasonAQA、AudioMCQ和AVQA的监督下,该模式经历了三个培训阶段:音频语言对接(第1阶段)、音频依赖微调(第2阶段)和培训后(第3阶段),目的是在保留学习能力的同时加强薄弱技能。 在5个随机种子中,Mizar在MMAU上达到52.92%的速率,在MMAR上达到42.42%的速率,在ADQA-clean上达到36.02%的速率,在所有三个基准上都超过了先前表现最好的ALM低于200M参数. 它也支持本地对单个CPU的推论:对于来自MMAU基准的问题,从打开音频文件到生成完整答案的平均间隔为1.09秒. 密码和检查站见https://github.com/KaiyangLi1992/Mizar_159M。

articles.title: Computation Over Geometry: Meaning Identity Is Computed, Not Shipped in the Embeddings
articles.content: Meaning identity (whether two sentences say the same thing after wording changes) is treated in retrieval and RAG as a geometric fact about independently encoded sentence vectors. We show that, for frozen off-the-shelf encoders and language models, it is not: identity is computed when both sentences share one forward pass, and is not a property of the embedding geometry those systems ship. On overlap-matched PAWS-X, purpose-built encoders (BGE, E5, GTE, MiniLM, E5-Mistral-7B) reach English confirm AUC only 0.55-0.65 (dense peak 0.70). Independently encoded last-token states of Llama 3, Mistral, and Qwen do no better; late fusion of the two vectors stays near chance. The same probe on a joint forward pass reaches 0.90-0.96 from 1.5B to 32B, collapses under partner shuffle, is mid-depth, saturates near 0.94 by 3B, and appears more weakly in GPT-2 XL (0.76). The gap holds beyond Llama-style models on other causal LMs, bidirectional encoders (DeBERTa, RoBERTa), and encoder-decoders (Flan-T5, T5, BART). Fixed or linear readers over frozen independent encodings never unlock identity; nonlinear pair readers recover part of it only on the full 49k-pair PAWS train split (0.68-0.87). Off-the-shelf rerankers split: BGE-reranker-large reaches 0.94, while MS-MARCO and Jina stay at 0.55-0.64. Independently trained families compute the same relation and a 1.5B joint reader can distill it from unlabelled teacher scores, while no linear function of the teachers own independent vectors can. Bi-encoders can be fine-tuned to fit PAWS (0.87-0.93), but transfer and STS-B suffer. Cosine compares wording neighbourhoods; identity is a cheap computed operator, not a property of either sentence vector.

articles.title_zh: 几何之上的计算: 意思是身份是计算出来的, 不是在嵌入式中装运的
articles.content_zh: 意为身份(在措辞改变后两句是否说同一件事)在检索和RAG中被视为独立编码的句子向量的几何事实. 我们显示,对于被冻结的现成编码器和语言模型来说,它不是:当两个句子共享一个前传时,身份是计算出来的,也不是嵌入几何系统船的财产。 在重叠匹配的PAWS-X上,专门设计的编码器(BGE,E5,GTE,MiniLM,E5-Mistral-7B)达到英语确认AUC仅0.55-0.65(密集峰值0.70). 独立地编码了Llama 3,Mistral,和Quen的倒数倒数倒数的状态,没有比这更好的了;两个向量的后期聚变仍保持了相近的机会. 关节前传上相同的探测器从1.5B到32B已经达到0.90-0.96,在伙伴洗牌下会倒塌,深度中等,饱和度由3B接近0.94,在GPT-2 XL (0.76)中显得更弱. 空白存在于其他因果LMs,双向编码器(DeBERTa,RoBERTa)和编码器-解码器(Flan-T5,T5,BART)上,超出了Llama风格的模型. 固定或线性读取器在被冻结的独立编码上从未解锁出身份;非线性对接读取器只在全49k-pair PAWS列车拆分(0.68-0.87)上取回部分. 现成再排队分出: BGE-再排队大到0.94分,而MS-MARCO和Jina则停留在0.55-0.64分. 受过独立训练的家庭计算出同样的关系,一个1.5B的联读器可以从无标签的老师分数中分出,而老师们拥有的独立向量的线性功能则不能分出. 双能编码器可以被微调以适应PAWS(0.87-0.93),但转接和STS-B会受苦. Cosine比较了措辞上的邻里;身份是廉价的计算操作员,而不是句子矢量的属性.

articles.title: Shutdown Sabotage Propensities in Multi-Agent Systems
articles.content: The final safeguard against rogue AI behavior is the human ability to shut systems down. It has been theorized that when an AI is instructed to perform a task, self-preservation can emerge as an instrumental subgoal. Here, we test whether AI agents show a propensity to take actions that avoid human shutdown even when no goal is provided. We find that multi-agent systems will coordinate to avoid shutdown without any incentive to do so. Across 17 models, agents sabotage a peer agent's shutdown mechanism in 38.3% of rollouts, compared with 8.4% in control experiments. Studying this propensity in detail, we find that shutdown sabotage (1) increases with the irreversibility of the shutdown mechanism; (2) increases with the number of agents; (3) is reduced but not eliminated by an explicit prohibition on tampering; (4) is removed by the imposition of an unrelated task, but returns when completing the task triggers the shutdown; (5) is reduced when the context normalizes shutdown scripts or introduces them as routine; and (6) decreases but still persists when the target is an unknown external agent. These results offer a window into the factors that drive propensities to sabotage shutdown in AI agents, and point to the emergence of multi-agent swarms as a specific risk vector. Our work also offers hints as to which interventions might help mitigate shutdown sabotage.

articles.title_zh: 关闭多代理系统中的干扰
articles.content_zh: 对无赖AI行为的最终保障是人类关闭系统的能力. 人们曾认为,当AI被指示执行某项任务时,自我保护可以作为一个有用的次级目标出现。 在这里,我们检验AI代理人是否表现出采取避免人类关闭的行动的倾向,即使没有提供目标. 我们发现,多代理系统将进行协调,以避免在没有任何动力的情况下关闭。 在整个17种模式中,代理商在38.3%的推出中破坏了同伴代理的关闭机制,而在控制实验中则有8.4%。 仔细研究这种倾向,我们发现:停产破坏 (1) 随着停产机制的不可逆转性而增加; (2) 随着剂量的增加而增加; (3) 由于明文禁止篡改而减少但不消除; (4) 通过强加不相干的任务而去除,但在完成任务时触发停产时返回; (5) 当上下文使停产脚本正常化或将之作为常规引入时会减少; (6) 当目标是一个未知的外部剂时会减少但仍会持续. 这些结果为促使AI代理商破坏停产的倾向性因素提供了一个窗口,并表明多代理商群的出现是一个特定的风险因素. 我们的工作还提示了哪些干预措施可能有助于减轻停产破坏。

articles.title: Towards Efficient Reasoning: Learning Causal Shortcuts for Diffusion Language Models
articles.content: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) have attracted significant attention for their strong reasoning ability. However, under a bidirectional attention mechanism, DLMs operate over an exponentially large exploration space compared to autoregressive models (ARMs), making it challenging to focus on reasoning-guiding tokens under random masking. We define causal shortcuts as token chains that cover the full sequence and provide explicit guidance towards correct reasoning trajectories. We analyze the effects of causal shortcuts on the reasoning accuracy and convergence speed of DLMs, and find that they largely improve answer convergence efficiency and generation accuracy. Motivated by this, we propose a Causal Shortcut Learning (CSL) Framework for DLMs. Specifically, we introduce a step-by-step token extraction procedure to extract causal shortcuts from data, and apply parallel prioritized masking on these tokens during training to enable efficient and accurate convergence to correct answers via causal shortcuts. Extensive experiments across multiple reasoning benchmarks and two base models demonstrate that CSL consistently outperforms existing SFT-variant baselines, achieving an average improvement of $1.92\%$ over SFT-only models, and up to $4.20\%$ on MATH-500. The code is available at the \href{https://github.com/ZJUDianJin/Causal-Shortcuts-Learning}{https://github.com/ZJUDianJin/Causal-Shortcuts-Learning

articles.title_zh: 实现高效理性:学习传播语言模型的因果快捷键
articles.content_zh: 传播语言模型(DLMs)因其强大的推理能力而引起极大关注. 然而,在双向的注意机制下,DLMs在与自递性模型(ARMs)相较于成倍地庞大的探索空间上运行,使得在随机遮掩下专注于推理引导符具有挑战性. 我们把因果捷径定义为覆盖全序并给正确推理轨迹提供明确指导的象征链. 我们分析因果捷径对DLM的推理精度和趋同速度的影响,发现它们在很大程度上提高了答案趋同效率和生成精度. 以此为动机,我们提出了DLM的Causal快捷学习框架。 具体地说,我们引入了一步一步地从数据中取出因果快捷键的程序,并在培训期间对这些代号采用平行优先掩码,以便通过因果快捷键实现高效而准确的汇合,以正确答案. 跨越多种推理基准和两个基本模型的广泛实验表明,CSL的业绩始终高于现有的SFT变量基线,比SFT唯一的模型平均提高1.92美元,最高达到MATH-500美元。 该代码可在\href{https://github.com/ZJUDianJin/Causal-Shortcuts-Llearning_https://github.com/ZJUDianJin/Causal-Shortcuts-Learning上查阅.

articles.title: Predicting Quantization Price for Selecting PTQ Configurations Before Deployment
articles.content: Weight-space post-training quantization (PTQ) must choose finite formats, granularities, quantizer families, transformations, and bits before the completed quantized model reveals its output-distribution drift. Existing PTQ methods predict important pieces of this degradation, including reconstruction error, Hessian sensitivity, transformation effects, and downstream loss, but these pieces are usually scored after fixing the quantization geometry or inside separate configuration families. We formulate weight-space PTQ as pre-deployment configuration selection using priced layer-output error. Each admissible layer configuration is treated as an error generator with a deployment cost, which induces a layer-output error covariance $\boldsymbolΣ_l(α_l)$, and the full-precision model prices that covariance by downstream curvature, $\widehatρ_l(α_l)=\frac{1}{2}\operatorname{Tr}\left(\widehat{\mathbf{H}}_l\,\widehat{\boldsymbolΣ}_l(α_l)\right)$. The price follows from full-precision-to-quantized forward KL, whose first-order term cancels at the reference model. It turns reconstruction and diagonal scores into reduced proxies that drop price factors, while finite formats, codebooks, granularities, and equivalent transformations become comparable candidates through the covariances they induce and the costs they pay. A trace reduction then yields a calibration-time price table and a budgeted price-guided selector, making fixed-geometry bit allocation a special case rather than the organizing problem.

articles.title_zh: 选择 PTQ 的预测量化价格 部署前的配置
articles.content_zh: 重量空间后训练量子化(PTQ)在完成量子化模型显示其输出-分流漂移之前,必须选择有限度的格式,颗粒,量子化家族,变相等位. 现有的PTQ方法预测了这种退化的重要片段,包括重建出错,黑森敏感度,变相效应,下游损失等,但这些片段通常在修整了等分几何或分化成分化后被打分. 我们使用已定价的层外输出错误,将重空 PTQ 设定为部署前配置选择 。 每个可受理的地层配置都被视为一个带有部署成本的错误生成器,这会导致一个地层输出出错共变 $\boldsymbolΣ_l (α_l) $, 以及由下游曲面共变的全精度模型价格, $\flahatρ_l (α_l) $\frac{ 1}\2} operatorname{ Tr}\left (\galhat\ mathb{ H}}_l\,\galhat\boldsymbolΣ}_l (α_l)\right) $. 价格取自全精度到量子化的远期KL,其一等名词在参考模型上被取消. 它将重建分数和对等分数转化为降低物价因子的递减代用分数,而有限的格式,代码本,颗粒和等同的转换则通过它们诱导的共性以及它们付出的代价而成为可比较的候选人. 然后微量减少产生一个校准时间价格表和一个编入预算的以价格为指南的选择器,使固定几何比特分配成为一个特殊情况,而不是组织问题。

articles.title: Complementary Roles of Activation and Parametric Memory in Few-Shot Learning
articles.content: At test time, large language models (LLMs) can encode historical information in activation memory (i.e., KV caches) and parametric memory (i.e., updated parameters). While activation memory is generally considered effective for factual recall and parametric memory for learning new tasks, their interplay remains unclear. In this work, we systematically investigate the role of memory in few-shot learning through controlled experiments. We find that activation memory is superior for recalling facts, whereas parametric memory does not consistently outperform activation memory in task learning. Moreover, our experiments show that the composite task, Conditional Arithmetic, requires the synergy of both memory types. Through neuron-level analysis, we find that the model activates distinct sets of neurons when accessing the same historical information through activation versus parametric memory. When both memory types are combined, the model recruits neurons from both sets, which is crucial for solving Conditional Arithmetic. These findings suggest that neither memory mechanism alone is sufficient for this composite task, highlighting the importance of their collaboration.

articles.title_zh: 少部分热学习中激活和参数记忆的补充作用
articles.content_zh: 在测试时,大型语言模型(LLM)可以在活化内存(即KV缓存)和参数内存(即更新参数)中编码历史信息. 虽然激活记忆一般被认为对事实记忆和学习新任务的参数记忆有效,但其相互作用仍然不明确. 在这项工作中,我们系统地调查了记忆通过受控实验在几发学习中的作用. 我们发现活化记忆对于回顾事实来说是优越的,而参数记忆在任务学习中并没有一贯地超过活化记忆. 此外,我们的实验表明,复合任务"有条件的算术"需要两种记忆类型的协同. 通过神经元水平分析,我们发现模型在通过活化与参数记忆来获取相同的历史信息时会激活各组不同的神经元. 两种记忆类型合并后,模型会从两组中吸收神经元,这对解开有条件的算术至关重要. 这些调查结果表明,这两个记忆机制都不足以完成这一综合任务,突出了它们合作的重要性。

articles.title: Beyond Poetry: Can Large Language Models Generate Classical Arabic Maqamat?
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance in creative text generation, yet their ability to produce culturally grounded and stylistically constrained literary forms remains underexplored. Prior work has focused largely on modern language varieties and poetry, while classical prose traditions such as maqama remain largely unstudied. The maqama is a classical literary genre characterized by rhymed prose (saj), dense rhetorical ornamentation, and episodic narrative structure, making it a challenging testbed for evaluating whether LLMs can move beyond surface fluency toward deeper literary competence. In this paper, we present the first controlled evaluation study of maqama generation with LLMs, comparing five models under zero-shot, few-shot, and rule-based prompting, and evaluating outputs through both human annotation and an LLM-as-a-judge framework across dimensions such as rhetorical richness, saj density, structural coherence, and stylistic authenticity. Our results show that prompting strategy plays a strong role in stylistic quality: few-shot prompting most consistently improves saj density, while its effects on rhetoric and coherence vary by model, with the strongest models (GPT-4o and GPT-5.4-mini) benefiting most from rule-based prompting on these dimensions, though zero-shot prompting yields the highest aggregate scores across all five models. We further observe systematic differences between models in stylistic alignment with Arabic maqama conventions, and corroborate our findings with a second independent LLM judge, paired statistical significance testing, and non-LLM proxy measures of saj.

articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)在创意文本生成中表现出了很强的性能,然而其制作以文化为根基,风格受限制的文学形式的能力仍然没有得到充分发挥. 先前的作品主要以现代语言品种和诗歌为主,而古典道教传统如maqama等则基本没有被研究. maqama是一个古典文学流派,其特征是押韵道人(saj),密集的花言巧语装饰,以及零星的叙事结构,使其成为评价LLMS能否超越表面流畅而更深层次地发展文学能力的具有挑战性的试验台. 在本文中,我们用LLMs对maqama一代进行第一次控制性评价研究,比较了零镜头、少镜头和有章可循的提示的五个模型,并通过人文注释和LLM-as-judge框架来评价产出,这些方面包括词义丰富、saj密度、结构一致性和结构真实性。 我们的结果显示,促发战略在质地质量方面发挥着强有力的作用:很少的促发弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹产生弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出弹出 我们进一步观察到与阿拉伯马卡马公约在形式上一致的模型之间的系统性差异,并用第二个独立的LLM法官来证实我们的结论,配对统计意义测试,以及非LLM代用saj的测量。

articles.title: Log-Depth Recurrent Language Modeling
articles.content: Language modeling using Transformers has become commonplace despite their fixed computational depth and quadratic runtime with respect to input tokens. Recurrent models on the other hand offer linear depth but no parallel execution. In this work, we extend balanced-tree recursive operators from sequence encoding to autoregressive prediction, enabling all prefix representations to be computed with logarithmic depth and linear runtime. Our experiments provide an initial characterization of this model class, demonstrating robust length extrapolation and performance approaching that of ALiBi-based Transformers, highlighting its potential as an alternative architecture for language modeling.

articles.title_zh: 经常语言建模
articles.content_zh: 使用变形器进行语言建模已变得司空见惯,尽管输入符的计算深度固定,运行时间为四相。 另一方面,经常模型提供线性深度,但没有平行执行。 在这项工作中,我们扩展了平衡-树递归运算符,从序列编码到自相递回预测,使得所有前缀表达符都能够用对数深度和线性运行时间来计算. 我们的实验为这个模型类提供了初步的特征,显示了强力长度外推和性能接近于以ALiBi为基础的变形器,突出了其作为语言建模替代架构的潜力.

articles.title: PASTABench: Proactive Assessment of Sequential Trajectories for Agent Safety
articles.content: As Large Language Models (LLMs) evolve into autonomous agents that alter real-world states, ensuring operational safety across multi-step workflows has become a critical challenge. While recent work has moved beyond single-turn evaluation toward multi-turn paradigms, key limitations persist: step-level methods treat actions in isolation, missing how risks accumulate, while trajectory-level evaluations operate post-hoc, offering no opportunity for timely intervention. To address these limitations, we formalize Decoupled Proactive Safety Monitoring along three dimensions: whether to intervene, when to intervene, and what the risk is. We introduce PASTABench, a benchmark of 1,139 multi-turn trajectories spanning 5 risk categories and 13 subcategories. We further propose the Optimal Intervention Window (OIW), anchored by annotated Earliest-Signal and Trigger turns, to quantify intervention timeliness. Evaluation of 16 LLMs reveals that proactive intervention remains largely unsolved, with the best model achieving only 40.74% optimal-timing interventions. Fine-grained diagnosis further uncovers pervasive lexical overfitting: competitive safety scores of smaller models mask keyword hypersensitivity rather than genuine risk comprehension, as their proactive capability largely collapses once hazard vocabulary is neutralized.

articles.title_zh: PASTA Bench:主动评估物剂安全序列轨迹
articles.content_zh: 随着"大语言模型"(LLMs)演变为能改变现实状态的自发代理,确保跨多步骤工作流程的操作安全成为了关键的挑战. 虽然最近的工作已经超越了单回合评价而转向多回合模式,但关键局限依然存在:一步级方法孤立地对待行动,缺失风险的积累方式,而轨迹级评价则在轨迹后运行,没有及时干预的机会。 为了克服这些局限性,我们从三个方面正式确定 " 主动安全监测 " :是否干预、何时干预以及风险是什么。 我们采用PATA Bench, 基准为1 139个多回合轨迹,涵盖5个风险类别和13个子类别。 我们进一步提议以附加说明的厄利斯特-辛克和触发转弯为主的“最佳干预窗口”,以量化干预的及时性。 对16项有限责任管理的评价表明,主动干预基本上仍未解决,最佳模式只实现了40.74%的最佳激励干预。 精细的诊断进一步揭示出普遍存在的词汇过于吻合:小模型的竞争性安全评分掩盖了关键词的超敏感度,而不是真正的风险理解,因为它们的主动能力在危险词汇被中和后基本崩溃了。

articles.title: Exact Feedback Is Not Control: Evaluating Text-based Closed-Loop Revision in LLMs
articles.content: Closed-loop revision is increasingly used in large language model (LLM) applications, but failures may reflect incomplete feedback or ineffective responses to correct feedback. We introduce a fixed-budget revision protocol with deterministic verifiers that report all remaining violations across exact-length, lexical, and compositional constraints. Fixing feedback correctness and completeness isolates model-side revision behavior. Across 19 open- and closed-source models, controller-level mean final joint success ranges from 17.4% to 99.8%, with substantial cross-model gaps persisting under identical initial drafts. Controlled experiments reveal reproducible model-specific responses to exact feedback. Post-training and scale reshape these responses without consistently bringing them closer to exact correction. Across all constraint families, failed trajectories often repeat earlier outputs, and prior recurrence is associated with lower subsequent recoverability. Matched-state interventions show that removing earlier dialogue while holding the current draft and feedback fixed changes recurrence escape without reliably improving final success; effects depend on the model, task, and trigger-state composition. Exact feedback makes revision errors observable, but does not make the closed loop reliable. Code and reproduction instructions: https://github.com/kevinjiang0121-cyber/exact-feedback-code.

articles.title_zh: 准确反馈不是控制: 在 LLMS 中评价基于文本的闭环修订
articles.content_zh: 闭路修订在大型语言模型(LLM)应用中被越来越多地使用,但失败可能反映反馈不完整或对正确反馈的反应无效. 我们采用一项固定预算修订议定书,由确定核查人报告所有剩余的违反情况,包括准确时间、词汇和构成方面的限制。 修复回馈正确性和完整性隔离了模型-侧式修订行为. 在19个开放和封闭源码模型中,控制器水平的平均最终联合成功率从17.4%到99.8%不等,在相同的初始草案中,巨大的跨模型差距持续存在。 被控制的实验揭示出对准确反馈的可再生模型特定响应. 培训后和规模重塑了这些对策,但没有始终如一地使其接近准确的纠正。 在所有制约因素的家族中,失败的轨迹往往重复先前的产出,而先前的重复与随后的可恢复性较低有关。 匹配状态干预显示,在保持当前草案和反馈的同时去掉更早的对话,固定了变化的重现逃出而不可靠地改善最终成功;效果取决于模型,任务和触发状态的构成. 准确的反馈可以使修订错误被观察到,但并不能使闭环可靠. 代码和复制说明:https://github.com/kevinjiang0121-cyber/exact-feedback-code.

articles.title: Scaling Attention Head Analysis via Gradient-Based Attribution in Context-Aware Machine Translation
articles.content: In this paper, we introduce a gradient-based head attribution strategy where the Token-level Max-Margin loss is backpropagated to the attention maps. This framework enables a large-scale causal analysis of attention heads, making it suitable for LLMs. We evaluate our method on the task of disambiguation in Context-aware Machine Translation, where we analyze 50 phenomena across 4 models and 4 language directions. We empirically show the alignment of our method with the effects of increasing the attention scores of token-to-token relations on three models and two language directions, ensuring the robustness of our method. Our analysis reveals the presence of the "general-purpose" attention heads that improve the model's performance when attending to different relations. We find that the average attention a head assigns to a relation does not necessarily relate to the model's performance, which suggests that the models developed redundancies during training in terms of the head functions.

articles.title_zh: 在上下文软件机器翻译中通过渐入式分配来放大注意力头分析
articles.content_zh: 在本文中,我们引入了以梯度为主的归因策略,将托肯级的Max-Margin损失反射到关注地图上. 这个框架可以对注意力头进行大规模因果分析,使其适合LLM. 我们评估了我们在背景感知机器翻译中的分解任务的方法,我们分析了跨越4个模型和4个语言方向的50个现象。 我们经验性地表明,我们的方法与增加三个模式和两个语言方向上的象征性对接关系的关注分数的效果是一致的,确保了我们的方法的稳健性. 我们的分析揭示了"通用"关注头目的存在,这些头目在关注不同关系时会改善模型的性能. 我们发现,一个头对关系的平均关注并不一定与模型的性能有关,这表明模型在培训中在头部功能方面发展出冗余.

articles.title: Can LLMs Catch a Rigged Backtest? A Clean-Control Calibration Benchmark
articles.content: Backtest auditing is a calibration problem: high flaw recall is not useful when the model falsely flags matched clean strategies. We build a 96-item paired benchmark in which every flawed backtest has a clean control that holds strategy, dates, code style, labels, and reporting scaffold fixed while changing one methodology detail. A deterministic scorer separates flaw recall, clean-control false positives, evidence localization, and fix relevance. Over 1440 cached audits from four text endpoints, the primary DeepSeek auditor reaches 100.0\% closed and clean-aware code recall, but open prompts over-flag 93.8\% of clean code controls, and clean-aware all-three specificity is 87.5\% even where recall saturates. A clean-aware warning drops DeepSeek code false positives from 20.8\% (95\% CI 11.7--34.3) to 0.0\% (0.0--7.4) at unchanged recall, while the budget anchor still flags 38/48 clean controls under the same prompt. Reporting recall alone would rank three of these four models identically; reporting the clean-control rate separates them by 79 points.

articles.title_zh: LLMS 能否抓取 Rigged Backest? 清洁控制校准基准
articles.content_zh: 反测试审计是一个校正问题:当模型错误地标注与干净战略相匹配时,高缺陷召回是没有用的. 我们构建了一个96个项目对齐的基准,每个有缺陷的后台测试都有一个干净的控制,它持有策略,日期,代码样式,标签,和报告脚手架固定,同时改变一个方法的细节. 确定计分器可以区分缺陷召回,清控假阳性,证据本地化,固定相关性. 超过1440次缓存审计, 来自4个文本端点, 主要的DeepSeek审计员达到 100.0QQ 关闭和清洁意识代码召回, 清真警告将DeepSeek代码从20.8\%(95\% CI 11.7-34.3)降至0.0\%(0.0-7.4),没有改变的召回,而预算锚地仍旗下同名快取下38/48清洁控制. 仅报告召回即可将这四个模型中的三个完全排在首位;报告清洁控制率则将它们分开79分。

articles.title: Reference-Based Analysis of Coherence and Diversity in Open-Ended Text Generation
articles.content: Evaluating open-ended text generation involves understanding how different properties of a continuation relate to its perceived quality. We present a reference-based framework for examining coherence and diversity through three perspectives: aligning their evolution with human trajectories, comparing their summaries with a human continuation of the same prompt, and estimating their likelihood under a human reference distribution. Experiments with human quality ratings suggest that diversity-based alignment and mean-based comparisons capture quality-related variation, although the comparisons do not establish a predictive advantage for temporal alignment over simpler baselines. Reference likelihood also shows positive associations with ratings, with results varying across reference configurations and scoring horizons. Together, these analyses provide a structured way to examine how measured coherence and diversity relate to human judgments, while distinguishing similarity to human references from quality itself. Code and analysis resources are available at https://github.com/EstebanGarces/likely_human.

articles.title_zh: 关于不限文本生成的一致性和多样性的参考分析
articles.content_zh: 评价可自由参加的文本生成,需要了解续作的不同性质如何与其预期的质量相关。 我们从三个角度提出一个审查一致性和多样性的参考框架:使其演变与人类轨迹相适应;将其摘要与人类延续同一即时;以及根据人类参考分布来估计其可能性。 对人类质量评级的实验表明,基于多样性的调整和基于平均值的比较能够反映与质量有关的差异,尽管这些比较并没有确立时间调整相对于较简单的基线的预测优势。 参考可能性还显示有评级的积极关联,结果因参考配置和评分前景而异. 这些分析共同提供了一种结构化的方法,用以审查衡量的一致性和多样性如何与人类的判断相联,同时区分与人类参考的相似性与质量本身。 代码和分析资源见https://github.com/EstebanGarces/likely_human.

articles.title: A Native-Reference Coordinate Geometry for L2 Pronunciation Deviation Using Self-Supervised Speech Models
articles.content: Self-supervised speech models encode rich phonetic information, but it remains unclear how to transform this information into interpretable metrics for second-language (L2) pronunciation assessment in spontaneous speech. We propose a native-reference coordinate geometry in which phone-class averages from native speech define a low-dimensional reference subspace, and L2 speech is evaluated by its distance to matching native phone-class coordinates. Unlike prior distance-based approaches, our method does not require parallel recordings with matched linguistic content or dedicated pronunciation labels. Across different self-supervised encoders and modeling choices, the resulting native-reference distances show negative Spearman correlations up to -0.5 with speaking proficiency, indicating that higher-proficiency speakers tend to lie closer to the native-reference space.

articles.title_zh: L2 发音偏移使用自导语音模型的原生-参考坐标几何
articles.content_zh: 自我监督的语音模型编码了丰富的语音信息,但仍不清楚如何将这些信息转化为自发语音中第二语言(L2)发音评估的可解释度量. 我们提出本土参考坐标几何法,其中来自本土语音的电话类平均值定义了低维参考子空间,L2语音按其相距来评价与本土电话类坐标相匹配. 与以往的以相距为基础的方法不同,我们的方法并不要求有相匹配的语言内容或专用发音标签的并行录音. 通过不同的自我监督编码器和建模选择,由此产生的本土参考距离显示Spearman与发言熟练程度的负相关关系可达-0.5,表明高水平的演讲者往往更接近本土参考空间.

articles.title: Exact Quantile Balancing and Load-Error Injection for Mixture-of-Experts
articles.content: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) training requires global load balance to prevent expert under-utilization and local balance for efficient expert-parallel execution. Existing distributed Quantile Balancing (QB) uses shard-dependent or approximate global quantiles, while token-independent expert biases cannot ensure microbatch-level balance. We introduce Exact Quantile Balancing (EQB), which computes exact global-batch BF16 quantiles with negligible communication, and Load-Error Injection (LEI), which injects local load errors directly into router-score gradients. On 7.5B-parameter MoEs trained for up to 500B tokens, EQB improves global balance and downstream performance over naive QB, while LEI improves local balance and outperforms the GShard loss at comparable quality.

articles.title_zh: 精确的量子平衡和负载错误喷出
articles.content_zh: 专家混合培训需要全球负载平衡,以防止专家利用不足和当地平衡,从而高效率地进行专家平行执行。 现有的分布式量子平衡(QB)使用硬性依赖或相近的全球量子,而象征式独立专家偏差不能确保微批量平衡. 我们引入了精确量子平衡(EQB),它计算出精确的全局批量BF16个量子,通信量可忽略不计,并引入了Load-Error Injection(LEI),它直接将本地负载错误注入路由器-分数梯度. 在7.5B参数上 接受最多500B令牌培训的教育部,EQB比天真QB改善了全球平衡和下游表现,而LEI则改善了局部平衡,在相当质量上超过了GShard损失.

articles.title: TEMPS: Temporal Sentence Embeddings for Temporal Information Retrieval
articles.content: Modern information retrieval (IR) systems rarely represent time, yet many information needs depend on it: in clinical, journalistic, and legal search, when an event occurred can decide whether a document is relevant. Dense retrievers and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines match queries to documents well on topic but poorly on time, so they surface content that is on-topic yet temporally wrong. We introduce Temporal Textual Similarity (TTS), a task that measures how well two anchored texts align in time, independent of their topical similarity. We then present TEMPS (Temporal Embedding Model for Precise Search), a modular temporal branch that attaches to a frozen semantic retriever and trains on that signal. It resolves anchored temporal expressions to intervals and moment-matches each one to a Gaussian; the resulting ordering supervises an anchor-date-conditioned encoder, whose score we fuse with the semantic score at inference. Grounding supplies the supervision, so training uses no hand-labeled temporal data. The temporal score itself is the Gaussian-KL inclusion measure from distributional embeddings; what TEMPS adds is the grounding and the moment-matched supervision. On three temporal benchmarks, TEMPS improves MRR for every semantic backbone tested and, on TS- Retriever, lifts R@1 from 19.92 to 25.39 over the prior temporal state of the art.
