articles.title_zh: TEMPS: 临时信息检索嵌入式判决
articles.content_zh: 现代信息检索(IR)系统很少代表时间,然而许多信息需求依赖于它:在临床,新闻,和法律搜索中,当一个事件发生时可以决定一个文件是否相关. Dense Referers和Retrival-Augmented Generation(RAG)管道将查询与专题文件匹配,但及时性差,因此显示内容在专题上,但时间上是错误的。 我们提出了 " 临时文本相似性 " (TTS),这项任务衡量两个定点文本在时间上如何一致,而不考虑其主题的相似性。 然后,我们介绍TeEMPS(精密搜索的瞬间嵌入模型),这是一个模块化的时空分支,它连接在被冻结的语义检索器上,并在该信号上进行列车. 它解决了锚定的时间表达方式,将每个间隔和瞬间比对到高斯人;由此产生的命令监督一个锚定日期条件的编码器,我们在推断时将其分数与语义分数相接. 定位提供监管,所以训练没有使用手贴时间数据. 时间分数本身是高斯-KL从分布式嵌入的包容度量;TEMPS所添加的是地平分和瞬间相配的监管. 在三个时间基准上,TEMPS改进了每个经测试的语义主干线的MRR,在TS-Retriever上,将R@1从19.92提升至25.39,高于之前的时态.

articles.title: How Much Were You Told? Measuring External Information in Peer Reviews
articles.content: Conference policies distinguish using Large Language Models (LLMs) to polish one's own review from delegating the critique, but current Artificial Text Detection (ATD) methods largely measure surface form rather than the origin of its content. We instead measure the external information carried by a review: information not explained by the reviewed paper and a generic reviewing instruction. We propose Self-Conditioning, an unsupervised information-theoretic estimator that compares the likelihood of a review under its production context with its likelihood when that context is augmented with hints extracted from the review itself. On the IntelLabs peer-review benchmark, Self-Conditioning separates fully-delegated from machine-polished reviews with AUC up to $1.0$ while remaining largely insensitive to surface rewriting. Moreover, as generators receive increasing amounts of externally-provided information, their scores move monotonically towards the human regime, unlike standard ATD baselines. High-temperature sampling can evade the estimator, but at the cost of output quality.

articles.title: Tensor Decomposition of Transformer Key-Value Caches: Spectral Structure and Format Comparison
articles.content: The key-value (KV) cache of autoregressive transformers can be viewed as a fourth-order tensor spanning attention heads, tokens, features, and grouped layers. We measure the singular-value spectra of all four mode unfoldings on Mistral-7B-v0.3 and LLaMA-2-13B and compare four standard tensor decompositions: Tucker, CP, tensor train, and t-SVD, at matched storage. The spectra partition the four axes into two classes. The token and feature modes carry low-rank structure, particularly for keys. The head and layer modes are nearly full-rank and resist compression at any practical error level. Among the four decompositions, Tucker achieves the lowest reconstruction error at every compression ratio from $2\times$ to $5\times$, because it can leave the full-rank modes untouched. Comparisons with two-dimensional unfolding baselines show that the preferred representation differs between keys and values: 2D methods achieve lower key error, while four-way Tucker achieves lower value error at matched storage. A mode-pinning theorem certifies the full-rank preservation from the measured spectra alone. Two further spectral properties affect the compressible modes without touching the full-rank ones: values reach a higher error floor than keys at every ratio, and post-RoPE keys lose $41\%$ - $64\%$ of their pre-RoPE compressibility on both models.

articles.title_zh: 变形器的分解 金鑰- Value Caches: 光谱结构和格式比较
articles.content_zh: 自动递归变压器的密钥-值缓存(KV)可被看做是跨越注意力头,符号,特征和分组层的四等收发器. 我们测量所有四种模式在Mistral-7B-v0.3和LLaMA-2-13B上所展开的单值光谱,并比较四种标准的收分分解: 塔克 CP 高压列车 和T -SVD,在匹配的存储。 光谱将四轴分出为两等. 标志和特征模式带有低等结构,特别是对于密钥. 头和地层模式几乎是全等的,在任何实际错误级别上都抵制压缩. 在四种分解中,塔克在每一次压缩比从2\times$到5\times$之间都实现了最小的重建出错,因为它可以让全名模式不受影响. 与二维流出基线的比较表明,首选的表达方式在密钥和值之间有所不同: 二维方法实现更低的密钥出错,而四向塔克在匹配存储时实现更低的值出错. 一个模式平接定理验证了仅被测量光谱的全名保存. 另外两个光谱属性影响可压缩模式而未触及到全等模式:值在每个比例上达到比密钥更高的出错下限,后ROPE密钥在两种模式上损失了41美元-64美元前ROPE压缩.

articles.title: Evaluating Feedback Focus and Pedagogical Adaptivity in LLM-Generated Feedback on Student Writing
articles.content: We investigate whether state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs) generate feedback that reflects the pedagogical practices of expert teachers in terms of feedback focus and adaptivity. Previous evaluation efforts have examined feedback characteristics, its impact on learning, and its target, yet the focus of feedback and its adaptivity remains largely overlooked. To bridge this gap, we adopt and refine Narciss's taxonomy into seven feedback focus types to annotate teacher and LLM-generated feedback across three university writing courses. We release FeedType, a benchmark containing annotated teacher and LLM feedback from six LLMs under three prompting strategies. We assess the coverage and distribution of feedback focus types, and examine whether LLMs adapt their feedback across draft stages and student performance levels as an expert instructor does. Our findings show that while most LLMs cover most feedback focus types, they fail to reflect teacher feedback distributions and show varying levels of adaptivity, with none matching the teachers' adaptive behavior. We believe FeedType will support future research on pedagogical alignment in LLM feedback generation.

articles.title_zh: 评价关于学生写作的LLM-Generated反馈的重点和教育适应性
articles.content_zh: 我们调查最先进的大型语言模型是否产生反馈,反映专家教师在反馈重点和适应性方面的教学做法。 以往的评价工作审查了反馈特征、其对学习的影响及其目标,但反馈的重点及其适应性仍然在很大程度上被忽略了。 为了弥补这一差距,我们采用和完善了纳西斯的分类学,将其分为7个反馈焦点类型,对教师进行注释,并在三个大学写作课程中通过LLM生成反馈. 我们发布FeedType, 包含附加注释的老师和LLM反馈的基准, 我们评估反馈重点类型的覆盖面和分布情况,并审查法学硕士是否像专家教员那样,在起草阶段和学生成绩水平上调整其反馈。 我们的研究结果表明,虽然大多数LLMS涵盖了大多数反馈焦点类型,但它们未能反映教师反馈的分布,并显示出不同程度的适应性,没有一种与教师的适应行为相匹配. 我们相信FeedType将支持未来在LLM反馈生成中进行教学调整的研究.

articles.title: Evaluating Open-Weight LLMs for Turkish Domain Documents Under Retrieval and Hardware Constraints
articles.content:
Most Turkish-capable large language models (LLMs) are evaluated using general-purpose benchmarks rather than long, structurally complex domain documents. This paper evaluates five open-weight 7B-8B models for Turkish document question answering under a resource-constrained local deployment setting. The primary benchmark contains 100 systematically validated questions derived from a 109-page industrial R&D report, and the evaluation protocol is replicated using a second 112-page public-sector report and an independently constructed 100-question set. All models are evaluated locally on an NVIDIA RTX 3050 laptop GPU with 6 GB VRAM using controlled prompting, decoding, and 4-bit quantisation.
  The principal methodological contribution is an evidence-annotated evaluation protocol that separates retrieval failure from downstream model reasoning failure without requiring additional model calls. On the primary benchmark, end-to-end accuracy ranges from 49% to 75%. Seven lexical, dense, and hybrid retrieval configurations are additionally compared using 95% Wilson intervals and exact paired McNemar tests; none significantly outperforms the character TF-IDF baseline on either document. Evidence recall saturates differently across the two reports, showing that retrieval and effective context capacity can be binding constraints for some documents but not others. These results demonstrate that model selection, retrieval behaviour, and hardware limits must be evaluated separately when deploying open-weight LLMs for Turkish domain documents.

articles.title_zh: 评价在检索和硬件限制下土耳其域文件的开放-重量LLMs
articles.content_zh:
大多数具有土耳其能力的大型语言模型(LLMS)是使用通用基准而不是长而结构复杂的域文件进行评估的. 本文评价了土耳其在受资源限制的本地部署设置下回答文件问题的5个开放式7B-8B模型。 主要基准包括100个从109页的工业研发报告中得出的经过系统验证的问题,评价协议是利用第二个112页的公共部门报告和独立的100个问题集复制的。 所有型号均在NVIDIA RTX 3050笔记本电脑GPU上进行局部评价,并使用受控的提示,解码,并使用4位分数来进行6GB VRAM.
主要的方法贡献是附有证据说明的评价协议,将检索失败与下游模型推理失败区分开来而不需要额外的模型调用. 在初级基准上,端到端的准确度从49%到75%. 使用95%的威尔逊间隔和精确配对的McNemar测试进行额外比较的有7个词典性,密度和混合检索配置;在两个文档上,没有任何一个显著的成绩超过了字符TF-IDF基线. 证据表明,这两份报告的饱和程度不同,表明检索和有效的上下文能力可能对某些文件而不是其他文件具有约束力。 这些结果表明,在为土耳其域文件部署开量的LLMs时,必须分别评价模型选择、检索行为和硬件限制。

articles.title: Controlled Attribute-Specific Summarization of Interrogative Dialogues
articles.content: Effective summarization of interrogative dialogues is a critical task in forensic and investigative settings, requiring high factual accuracy, coherence, and attribute-specific relevance. In this work, we introduce CASPER, a novel Chain-of-Thought Attribute-Specific Prompting for Evaluative Summarization framework that leverages structured prompting and iterative refinement to generate high-quality summaries of interrogator-witness interactions. We construct MINDSum, a dataset extending the MIND corpus, comprising 6,000 utterance pairs annotated with event details, factual statements, character descriptions, and fillers. CASPER employs RoleEval, a hierarchical evaluation mechanism where multiple roles (officer, inspector, senior inspector) iteratively assess summaries based on predefined criteria. By integrating entity extraction and structured feedback loops, CASPER significantly improves factual consistency and contextual completeness compared to existing baselines. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework outperforms standard summarization models on both lexical (ROUGE) and semantic (BERTScore) metrics, while human evaluation confirms its alignment with expert reasoning. Our findings underscore the potential of controlled summarization in high-stakes domains, paving the way for AI-driven forensic intelligence.

articles.title_zh: 受控属性 -- -- 讯问对话的具体摘要
articles.content_zh: 有效总结审问性对话是法证和调查环境中的一项关键任务,要求事实准确性高,一致性高,属性相关性高. 在这项工作中,我们介绍了CASPER,这是一个新型的 " 思维属性链 -- -- 具体促进评价总结框架 " ,利用结构化的促动和迭接改进,生成高质量的审讯与证人互动摘要。 我们构建了MINDSum这个数据集,扩展了MIND教程,由6000个词组组成,附有事件细节、事实陈述、人物描述和填充符。 CASPER使用LocusEval,这是一种分级评价机制,多种角色(官员、检查员、高级检查员)根据预先确定的标准反复评估摘要。 通过整合实体提取和结构化反馈回路,CASPER比起现有的基线,大大提高了事实的一致性和背景完整性. 实验结果表明,我们的框架在词汇学(ROUGE)和语义学(BERTScore)指标上都超过了标准归纳模型,而人的评价则证实了它与专家推理的一致性。 我们的调查结果强调了在高吸取领域进行有控制的汇总的潜力,为AI驱动的法证情报铺平了道路.

articles.title: Risk-Controlled KV-Cache Eviction: From Memory Budgets to Risk Targets
articles.content: KV-cache eviction is typically evaluated through average quality-memory trade-offs, yet a small average loss can hide requests whose utility degrades materially. We reformulate eviction as a deployment risk-control problem: a material degradation occurs when eviction lowers task utility by more than a deployment-specified tolerance relative to full-KV inference on the same request, and deployment risk is the population frequency of such events. Given a reliability contract specifying a target risk level and confidence requirement, we use a compressor-agnostic post-hoc certification procedure to select a retention policy from calibration data with a finite-sample guarantee, falling back to full KV when no compressed policy is certified. Across multiple eviction methods, Llama and Mistral models, and LongBench and RULER-32K, the same contract supports substantially different levels of eviction: on Llama, it certifies SnapKV at 75% retention on LongBench but no tested compressed policy on RULER-32K, triggering full-KV fallback. Policies with empirical degradation rates below the 5% target can still fail finite-sample certification; on Llama LongBench, empirical thresholding selects uncertified policies that retain 5-10 percentage points less cache across fixed-budget methods. The proposed framework converts a deployment-level reliability requirement into a KV-memory operating point.

articles.title_zh: 风险控制 KV- 缓存退出: 从内存预算到风险目标
articles.content_zh: KV-cache驱逐通常通过平均质量的取舍加以评估,但一个小的平均损失可以隐藏其效用在物质上下降的请求。 我们把驱逐重新确定为部署风险控制问题:当驱逐比同一请求的完全KV推论更具有部署规定的容忍度,降低任务效用时,就会发生物质退化,部署风险是此类事件的人口频率。 鉴于一项确定目标风险水平和信心要求的可靠性合同,我们使用压缩机-不可知码后认证程序,从有有限样本保证的校准数据中选择保留政策,在未验证压缩政策时,回落到完整的KV. 通过Llama和Mistral模型以及Long Bench和RULAR-32K的多种驱逐方法,同一合同支持的驱逐程度大相径庭:在Llama,它证明SnapKV在Long Bench上保留了75%,但在RULR-32K上没有经过测试的压缩政策,引发了完全KV倒置。 经验降解率低于5%目标的政策仍可能无法通过有限样本认证;在Llama Long Bench一案中,经验阈值选择未经认证的政策,在固定预算方法中保留5-10个百分点的缓存。 拟议框架将部署级别可靠性要求转换为KV-模拟操作点。

articles.title: Six Layers Less: Encoder Pruning for Whisper with Label-Free Recovery
articles.content: Pruning large pre-trained transformer-based ASR models such as OpenAI's Whisper has seen great adoption, as pruning the decoder led to significant end-to-end transcription speedups. For instance, the {\tt whisper-large-v3-turbo} variant reduced the decoder from 32 to 4 layers, while Distill-Whisper similarly reduced the decoder to only 2 layers. Although some attention has been put towards reducing the size of the encoder, no approach has seen wide adoption. This could be due to the need for custom inference implementations to take advantage of the compressed model. We present an approach that ranks encoder layers by the leave-one-layer-out change in Word Error Rate (WER). The six layers that cause the least change are removed, corresponding to $18.5\%$ of the encoder stack. The pruned model requires no custom inference code as it is simply a more shallow encoder with fewer layers. We further distill using unlabeled monolingual speech data to recover performance degradation caused by the zero-shot layer pruning. Mean WER across four languages increases to $20.1\%$ after distillation, compared to $21.9\%$ zero-shot, going from a baseline of $18.2\%$. We release all of our code (https://github.com/rasgaard/whisper-encoder-layer-prune) and the pruned model (https://huggingface.co/rasgaard/whisper-large-v3-turbo-encoder-pruned).

articles.title_zh: 减少六层: 编码器 Pruning for Whisper with Label - 无标签恢复
articles.content_zh: 跑出OpenAI"Whisper"等大型预装变压器ASR等型号后,由于跑出解码器导致大量端到端的转录速度加速. 例如,XXtt低语-大-v3-turbo}变体将解码器从32层降低到4层,而Distill-Whisper同样将解码器降低到只有2层。 虽然已经对缩小编码器的尺寸给予了一定的注意,但没有一种方法得到广泛采用. 这可能是由于需要从定制推论中利用压缩模型。 我们提出一种方法,将编码器层按字数错误率(WER)的一层变化排序。 造成最小变化的六层被去掉,相当于编码器堆栈的18.5美元. 被打磨的模型不需要自定义推论代码,因为它只是比较浅的编码器,分层较少. 我们利用无标签的单语语音数据进一步分解,以恢复由零射层穿透造成的性能退化. 4种语言的平均WER在蒸馏后增至20.1美元,而从18.2美元的基准量来看,是21.9美元零发。 我们公布我们所有的代码(https://github.com/rasgaard/whisper-encoder-layer-prune)和被pruned的模型(https://huggingface.co/rasgaard/whisper-large-v3-turbo-encoder-pruned).

articles.title: Evaluation of pre-trained models for pedagogical assessment of novel AI-assisted educational questions
articles.content: The surge in AI-assisted generation of educational materials has outpaced our capacity to validate their pedagogical quality. Automated evaluation using Bloom Classifier models is a promising approach to assess educational materials at scale. These models show high accuracy within-distribution dataset (IID Dataset). However, applying the same models to new out-of-distribution (OOD) datasets such as AI-assisted generated questions could show performance degradation. To identify robust classifiers under dataset shift, we evaluated traditional Machine Learning (ML), transformer, and Large Language models on the Bloom level classification task. We also explored feature-engineering strategies incorporating NLP metrics, appending the learning objectives as part of the input, and text splicing to stabilize OOD performance. Our baseline tests show that TFPOS-IDF ML models perform poorly on OOD (Macro F1-score 0.48) compared to BERT (0.55) and LLMs (0.79). Text splicing improved macro F1-score performance of ML and BERT models (0.59 and 0.62, respectively). Appending the learning objectives with the input increased model performance on specific dataset. Model retraining provided the largest improvement across models and datasets. Overall, these findings highlight the trade-off on the use of pre-trained models with novel AI-assisted educational questions and how strategic feature enhancements help address loss in performance.

articles.title_zh: 评估经过培训的新型AI辅助教育问题教学评估模式
articles.content_zh: AI协助制作的教材激增,超过了我们验证其教学质量的能力。 使用Bloom分类模型进行自动化评价是评估大规模教育材料的一个很有希望的办法。 这些模型显示在分配内部的数据集(IID Dataset)中精度很高. 然而,将同样的模型应用于新的分配外数据集,如AI协助生成的问题,可能显示性能退化。 为了确定数据集转换下的强分级器,我们评价了传统的机器学习(ML),变压器,和大语言模型在Bloom级别分类任务上. 我们还探索了将NLP指标纳入的特征工程战略,将学习目标作为投入的一部分,并用文字拼接来稳定OD性能。 我们的基线测试显示,与BERT(0.55)和LLMs(0.79)相比,TFPOS-IDF ML模型在OD(Macro F1-score 048)上的性能不佳。 文本分解改进了ML和BERT模型的宏F1-分数性能(分别为0.59和0.62). 将学习目标与投入相配合,提高特定数据集的模型性能. 模式再培训在模型和数据集方面提供了最大的改进。 总的来说,这些调查结果突出了在使用经过预先培训的模型与新的AI辅助教育问题以及战略特征增强如何帮助解决绩效损失问题上的取舍。

articles.title: SkillGym: Internalizing Human Skills into LLMs for Real-World Problem Solving
articles.content: Human-written agent skills encode rich workflows for real-world problem solving, but are typically used as external inference-time instructions rather than internalized as reusable model capabilities. We introduce \texttt{SkillGym}, a framework that transforms these skills into executable, verifiable training environments for large language model agents. Its skill-to-task pipeline instantiates concrete tasks, verifies outcomes with code-based checkers, and assesses empirical skill dependence through contrastive executions. We construct and release 2,756 environments across 12 categories and collect 8,364 successful trajectories from multiple models and harnesses, averaging 49 tool calls and over 60k logged text tokens. These resources support supervised fine-tuning on verified workflows and reinforcement learning with outcome-based rewards. Under Claude Code, supervised fine-tuning improves Qwen3.5-35B-A3B by 199 Elo on GDPval-AA v2, 19.10 percentage points on Terminal-Bench 2.1, and 28.13 and 12.38 points on SkillsBench v1.1 with and without skills, respectively. Our 35B \texttt{SkillGym-Agent} reaches 51.47\% on skill-assisted SkillsBench, exceeding reported scores for Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.4 Mini, and DeepSeek V4 Pro. Without skills, it also surpasses skill-assisted bases under Codex and Claude Code, suggesting reusable procedural competence.

articles.title_zh: SkillGym:将人类技能内部化为解决现实世界问题的法学硕士
articles.content_zh: 人文作案代理技能为现实世界解决问题编码了丰富的工作流程,但通常被用作外部推断时间指令,而不是内部化的可再用模型能力. 我们引入了\textt{SkillGym},这个框架将这些技能转化为大语言模型代理的可执行,可核查的训练环境. 其技能与任务之间的管道将具体任务即时化,用基于密码的检查器核实结果,并通过对比性处决评估经验技能依赖性. 我们构建和释放了12个类别的2 756个环境,收集了多个模型和工具的8 364个成功轨迹,平均49个工具呼叫和60多克记录的文字符号。 这些资源支助监督对经核实的工作流程进行微调,并强化学习,提供成果奖励。 根据克洛德法典,监督的微调改进了Qune3.5-35B-A3B,在GDPval-AA v2上分别改进了199 Elo;在终端-Bench 2.1上分别提高了19.10个百分点;在技能-Bench v1.1上分别提高了28.13和12.38分。 我们的35B\textt{SkillGym-Agent}在技能辅助技能Bench上达到51.47X,超过了Claude Sonnet 4.6,GPT-5.4mini和DeepSeek V4 Pro的报告分数. 没有技能,它也超越了《法典》和《克洛德法典》规定的技能援助基础,表明可重复使用的程序能力。

articles.title: Consequential Behaviour and Representational Fairness in the Validation of Synthetic Research
articles.content: Researchers in industry and academia use synthetic survey respondents powered by large language models as substitutes for human samples. These synthetic populations require validation against real-world data, so researchers often address them using ad hoc comparisons with human surveys. Inspired by the intention-behaviour gap in behavioural science, we argue that these validations test the wrong thing for most applied cases where decision makers commission synthetic research to anticipate consequential behaviour. To address this problem, we propose a validation framework with two requirements. First, every validity claim must state its level of correspondence with human data: does the sample predict what the represented people do, which of four diagnostics (location, dispersion, response process and structure) does the validation address, and does the validation compare against experimental effects? Second, researchers must report validity claims for subgroups, since these groups are often the most affected by consequential decisions and aggregate accuracy hides their misrepresentation. Our validation framework operationalises three justice dimensions (distributional, procedural, and recognition) as measurable quantities and defines within-persona counterfactual experiments as a validation requirement. We then apply the framework to electric vehicle charging tariffs, before closing with a reporting checklist that researchers can use to make convincing validity claims.

articles.title_zh: 合成研究验证中的相应行为和代表性公平性
articles.content_zh: 工业和学术界的研究人员使用由大语言模型提供动力的合成调查答卷人作为人类样本的替代品. 这些合成人群需要对照现实世界的数据进行验证,因此研究人员经常使用与人类调查的临时比较来解决. 受行为科学中意图-行为差距的启发,我们主张,对于大多数应用案例,这些验证对决策者委托进行合成研究以预测后果行为来说,测试是错误的。 为了解决这一问题,我们提出了一个有两项要求的验证框架。 首先,每个有效性主张都必须说明它与人类数据对应的程度:样本是否预测了被代表的人所做的,验证地址是哪一种诊断(位置,分散,反应过程和结构),验证与实验效果相比是哪一种? 第二,研究人员必须报告对分组的有效性主张,因为这些分组往往受相应决定的影响最大,而总体准确性掩盖了它们的歪曲。 我们的验证框架将三个司法层面(分配、程序和承认)作为可衡量的数量加以运作,并将人内反事实实验定义为验证要求。 然后,我们将框架应用于电动车辆充电费,然后以一份报告清单结束,研究人员可以利用该清单提出令人信服的有效性主张。

articles.title: Same Scores, Different Decisions: Evaluating JEV and Language Models for Legal Document Understanding
articles.content: Contract inference requires multiple judgments about a shared document, but aggregate accuracy can conceal changes in the individual decisions. Repeated agreement is also insufficient: a model may consistently return the wrong answer. In this paper, we compare Jev with nine language models on ContractNLI, evaluating inference cost, response time, average correctness, and correctness across repeated request conditions. Controlled comparisons vary hypothesis visibility, requested outputs, and output order while keeping the contract and target judgment fixed. Jev has the lowest cost and median response time among the evaluated configurations, while hosted language models achieve higher baseline accuracy. Rankings by baseline accuracy differ from rankings by correctness across every condition and repeat, although small differences in the latter do not establish a general stability advantage. Development diagnostics further reveal compensating corrections and regressions, as well as persistent errors. These findings motivate evaluating cost and response time alongside whether individual judgments remain correct as the request configuration changes. Code: https://github.com/ZF-Utokyo/Jev-Benchmark

articles.title_zh: 相同的分数,不同的决定:评价JEV和用于理解法律文件的语言模型
articles.content_zh: 合同推论要求对共享文件进行多项判断,但汇总准确性可以掩盖个别决定的变化. 一再达成协议也是不够的:一个模型可能始终返回错误的答案。 在本文中,我们比较了Jev与ContractNLI上的9个语言模型,评价推论成本,响应时间,平均正确性,以及反复请求条件中的正确性. 控制下的比较在维持合同和目标判断不变的同时,会改变假设的能见度、要求的产出和产出顺序。 Jev在被评价的配置中成本和中位响应时间最低,而主机语言模型则能实现更高的基线精度. 按基线准确性排列的排名与按每个条件的正确性排列的排名不同,而且重复出现,尽管后者的细微差异并不确立一般的稳定优势. 发展诊断进一步揭示了补偿性纠正和回归以及持续存在的错误。 这些结果促使评价成本和反应时间,以及随着请求配置的变化,个别判断是否依然正确。 代码:https://github.com/ZF-Utokyo/Jev-奔驰.

articles.title: The Path Matters: Evaluating Small Language Models Beyond Answer Accuracy in KGQA
articles.content: Small language models (SLMs) are increasingly paired with knowledge graphs (KGs), yet end-to-end KG question answering conflates graph access, search, navigation, reasoning, and answer generation. This coupling makes it difficult both to determine whether an SLM can faithfully execute the reasoning path implied by a question and to attribute failures to navigation rather than to other stages of the pipeline. We isolate this capability by employing the THESEUS navigation and traceability framework and using frozen, off-the-shelf SLMs as local action policies. At each hop, the environment exposes the legal outgoing graph actions, and the model selects one executable graph action and decides whether to stop, without task-specific parameter updates, model-controlled beam search, or free-form answer generation. This controlled setting allows us to evaluate terminal-answer accuracy with Hits@1 together with path fidelity, using Path Edit Distance (PED) as the primary trajectory metric. Across the Kinship and MQuAKE-ST KGQAs, similarly sized local models differ substantially in answer accuracy and path fidelity, with the two metrics sometimes favoring different models. This model-dependent behavior also extends to prompting, as a single demonstrated trajectory can improve or degrade navigation depending on the model. These results motivate evaluating SLM graph reasoning beyond endpoint accuracy alone.

articles.title_zh: 路径事项:在 KGQA 中评价小语言模型超越答案精确度
articles.content_zh: 小语言模型(SLMS)越来越多地与知识图(KGs)对接,然而端到端的KG问题解答集成图解访问,搜索,导航,推理,和答案生成. 这种结合使得难以确定可持续土地管理能否忠实地执行问题所隐含的推理路径,也难以将失败归因于导航而不是管道的其他阶段。 我们利用THESEUS导航和可追踪性框架并利用已冻结的现成可持续土地管理作为地方行动政策,孤立这种能力。 在每次跳出时,环境都会暴露出合法的外出图形动作,模型会选择一个可执行的图形动作,并决定是停止,没有任务特定的参数更新,模型控制的光束搜索,还是自由格式的答案生成. 这种可控设置允许我们用 Hits@1 与路径的忠诚度一起评价终端答题的准确性,使用路径编辑距离(PED)作为主轨迹度量. 在整个Kinship和MQuAKE-ST KGQA中,同样大小的本地模型在答案准确度和路径忠诚度上差别很大,两个度量衡有时倾向于不同的模型. 这种依赖模型的行为也延伸到了催化上,因为单个被证明的轨迹可以根据模型改善或降解导航. 这些结果促使评价可持续土地管理图表的推理超出了终点的准确性。

articles.title: FLEET: From Logits Entropy to Enhanced Trajectories in Text Generation
articles.content: Solutions based on large language models (LLMs) often rely on temperature sampling to improve accuracy and stability by aggregating multiple samples from the completion distribution. However, this memoryless approach is inherently suboptimal: because it lacks awareness of prior generations and their evaluations, it produces an increasing proportion of semantically duplicate answers as more samples are drawn, leading to diminishing returns. To address this limitation, we introduce FLEET, a novel method that integrates a memory mechanism into the generation process. FLEET represents each generation as a sparse trajectory through states whose entropy exceeds a predefined threshold and uses these trajectories to infer per-token utility scores that adjust the logits. Benchmark evaluations demonstrate that FLEET achieves the same accuracy as the repeated sampling baseline, with a 3x speedup, and substantially improves accuracy on complex coding tasks (LiveCodeBench Pass@32 increases from 59.9% to 66.2%) under the same budget. Furthermore, in the greedy-decoding configuration evaluated here, the approach is deterministic and uses a single calibration pass to derive its principal hyperparameters, requiring only minimal modifications to existing LLM pipelines.

articles.title_zh: FLEET: 从逻辑环境到文本生成中的增强轨迹
articles.content_zh: 基于大语言模型(LLMs)的解决方案往往依靠温度采样,通过从完成分布中聚合出多个样本来提高准确性和稳定性. 然而,这种无记忆的方法在本质上是次最佳的:因为它缺乏对前代及其评价的认识,随着取出更多的样本,生成了越来越大比例的精密重复的答案,导致回报率下降. 为解决这一局限性,我们引入了FLEET,这是一种将内存机制纳入生成过程的新型方法. FLEET作为稀疏的轨迹代表了每一代人,穿过了那些 en已超过预定阈值的状态,并使用这些轨迹推断出调整了对数的每位功用分数. 基准评价表明,FLEET实现了与重复抽样基准相同的准确性,具有3x加速速度,并在同一预算下大幅提高复杂编码任务的准确性(LiveCode Bench Pass@32从59.9%增加到66.2%)。 此外,在本文评价的贪婪-解码配置中,这种方法具有决定性,使用单一校正通关来得出其主要超参数,只需对现有LLM管进行最小的修改.

articles.title: Brain-to-Language Decoding: Tasks, Signals, Methods, Evaluation, Practical Use and Beyond
articles.content: Brain-to-language decoding translates neural activity associated with language production, internal speech and perception into linguistic or expressive outputs. It offers a route to restoring communication after speech loss and a means of studying how the brain represents language. Advances in neural recording and representation learning have expanded the field from constrained recognition and acoustic reconstruction to text generation, streaming personalised speech and facial animation. This survey synthesises these developments across invasive and non-invasive measurements, drawing on a search without a lower year limit and source-led updates through September 2026. We connect Articulated, Inner and Perceived tasks to the neural populations they engage, the representations available to decoders and the outputs those representations can support. We examine model development, public resources and the evolution of evaluation, and compare published performance and communication costs within their reported protocols. The synthesis identifies complementary routes to progress: phonetic, acoustic and semantic targets preserve different aspects of a message; shared representations support reuse across recording conditions and tasks; and online communication increasingly depends on calibration, feedback and user control alongside decoding accuracy. Shared benchmarks enable algorithmic comparisons, while longitudinal studies reveal the demands of sustained use. We discuss these developments and their remaining limitations, then outline a prospective five-level trajectory from commands and language to meaning, scenarios and bidirectional cognitive exchange

articles.title_zh: 脑到语言解码:任务、信号、方法、评价、实际使用及以外
articles.content_zh: 大脑到语言解码将语言制作,内部语音和感知相关的神经活性翻译为语言或表达性输出. 它提供了一个在语音损失后恢复通信的路径,以及研究大脑如何代表语言的方法. 神经录制和表现学习的进步将领域从受限的识别和声学重建扩展到了文本生成,流出个性化的演讲和面部动画. 这次调查综合了这些在侵入性和非侵入性测量方面的发展,利用了没有下年限的搜索和2026年9月由源头主导的更新. 我们把人工、内部和感知任务与它们参与的神经人群、解码器可用的表达方式以及这些表达方式能够支持的产出联系起来。 我们审查模型开发、公共资源和评价的演变,并比较其报告协议中公布的业绩和通信费用。 综合查明了进展的补充途径:语音、声学和语义目标保护信息的不同方面;共享的表示支持在记录条件和任务之间重复使用;在线通信越来越依赖于校正、反馈和用户控制以及解码准确性。 共同的基准可以进行算法比较,纵向研究则揭示了持续使用的需求。 我们讨论这些动态及其剩余的局限性,然后概述从指令和语言到意义、情景和双向认知交流的五级轨道。
